emilio diaz.name: Emilio Diaz
emilio diaz.origin: ===Conflicting Origins=== The origins of Emilio Diaz are mire with conflicting accounts, likely due to the accounts being taken from dime store novel versions of real adventures of heroes of American Frontier. What remains constant is that Emilio was a traveling Mexican who was active during the days of the American Frontier. Along his travels he paired up with the Native American warrior called Red Hawk. Where accounts vary is in his earliest recorded appearance. Both accounts are very similar except for the fact that one led to the origin of the Texas Kid and the other led to the origin of the Outlaw Kid. Confusing matters further is the fact that the original origins of the Outlaw Kid have since proven to be false yet many of the Outlaw Kid's early adventures included interactions with Emilio and Red Hawk. No explanation has been given. In both accounts, while riding into Caliber City, Texas he and Red Hawk came across the Temple Ranch as it was being attacked by outlaw Link Cado. Cado came to the ranch to get revenge against Zane Temple who had incarcerated Cado during his time as a US Marshal. They sent Cado and his minions fleeing but not before they killed Zane's wife and Zane himself was blinded by a bullet. Emilio and Red Hawk nursed Zane back to health, he took a pacifist stand and had his son Lance promise never to use a gun against another person so long as he bore the family name. Seeing that Lance was determined to avenge his family, Emilio and Red Hawk trained him how to be a warrior. When Lance was an adult, Emilio and Red Hawk gifted Lance with a disguise, a horse named Thunder and gave him his fathers guns. Calling himself the Texas Kid/Outlaw Kid, Lance was assisted by Emilio and Red Hawk in hunting down and killing Link Cado, avenging his family. In either case, both heroes continued to fight lawlessness in and around Caliber City, often assisted by Emilio and Red Hawk. For the sake of completeness, Emilio's interactions with the Texas Kid and the Outlaw Kid have been documented below. ===Texas Kid=== Emilio and Red Hawk assisted the Texas Kid in putting an end to such outlaws as Jake Bender, Deuce Kinsey, and Crossdaw Fenshaw. Returning to his native Mexico, Emilio attempted to liberate the town of Juarez from the crooked Don Carlos who was using phony land claims to force people off their land in an effort to control the vote and win his bid for governor. Emilio was wounded rebelling against Don Carlos and hid in a safe house. He sent Red Hawk to get the Texas Kid to come and assist him and the two heroes liberated Juarez from the tyranny of Don Carlos. Returning to Texas, Emilio joined Red Hawk and the Texas Kid in stopping a group of masked vigilantes from driving away area nesters. When Lance's double identity was compromised by a crooked ranch hand named Radcliff who threatened to reveal it to Zane Temple, Emilio disguised himself as the Texas Kid and gunned down Radcliff before he could reveal the truth. Emilio and Red Hawk later helped the Kid defend a caravan from an attack by outlaws disguised as Apaches and later helped the Kid rescue Evelyn Cartwright who had been kidnapped by outlaws seeking to ransom from her wealthy father. Later, Emilio and Red Hawk later assisted the Texas Kid when Zane Temple was terrorized by outlaw Smiler Fenton. Later, some of the outlaws the Texas Kid put away broke out of prison and captured Emilio and Red Hawk to get at the Texas Kid. The pair were soon rescued by the Texas Kid. The pair continued to assist the Texas Kid, assisting the hero in stopping outlaws like Snake Gault, and Killer Jalk. The pair were shocked when the Texas Kid attacked them while they were on the trail of Bat Corbet. Soon realizing that the Kid had been struck with amnesia, Emilio and Red Hawk helped the Kid take down Corbet when his memory was restored. They later helped the Texas Kid stop an uprising of the local Ute tribe. They also assisted the Kid in stopping the local Apaches who were attempting to force everyone out of Caliber City. They also helped the Texas Kid stop crooked politician Henry Brandy from using violence and intimidation to win the election for Caliber City's next Marshal. ===Outlaw Kid=== Shortly after the creation of the Outlaw Kid, Emilio and Red Hawk assisted the Kid in preventing a war breaking out between white settlers and a local Comanche tribe who was framed for attacking settlers by a rival Apache tribe. Emilion and Red Hawk joined the Outlaw Kid in an alliance with the US army to wipe out the band of renegade Apaches in order to maintain peace in the region. Both Emilio and Red Hawk worked with the Outlaw Kid when he teamed up with the US Army to stop a band of renegade Sioux warriors. Subsequent adventures of Emilio and Red Hawk are unrecorded, their ultimate fate is as yet unrecorded.
weapons: Emilio regularly carried six-shooters. Sometimes he used a rifle.

emilio duarte.name: Emilio Duarte
emilio duarte.origin: ===Presidency and Overthrown=== Emilio Duarte replaced dictator General Luis Augustine as ruler of the Republic of Santo Marco. For years, the U.S.A. attempted to have him killed, sending soldiers who were on different occasions either captured (like Nuke) or killed. Duarte was known for his radical anti-mutant beliefs. His attempts to pass an anti-mutant bill caught the attention of the X-Men, who worked with Duarte's opposition to shut it down. After Storm delivered a platoon of armed militants who had been evicting fishermen from their villages on the northern shore of the country to local authorities, President Duarte swore to investigate. After a series of conflicts during which Duarte bombed the capital of Santo Marco, he was overthrown. The country fell into chaos, save for a stretch along the coast defended by the mutant Jorge Santiago. ===Return and Death=== Duarte's removal from office was short lived. Once he returned, he obtained the technology necessary to produce Nuke Pills, and used them as incentive to make the American soldiers he captured work for him, turning them into the Nuke Platoon. President Duarte sent the Nuke Platoon to round up and exterminate both mutants and mutant sympathizers. A village of mutants sought the help of Weapon X, who eventually defeated the Nuke Platoon and destroyed their supply of pills. The original Nuke was freed by Weapon X in the process. During the march of the mutants on Santo Marco, demonstrating the Nuke platoon prisoners, and demanding that the National Guard surrender Duarte for him to be judged for his crimes against mutants and the corruption of his regime, Nuke infiltrated Duarte's office and assassinated him before the eyes of the Santo Marcans (and in front of cameras).

emily arthurs.name: Emily Arthurs
emily arthurs.origin: Emily Arthurs is a female professor at Boston College. Barry, one of her male students, has the hots for Emily and attempts to seduce her. After the night class is over, Barry comes over to Emily and tells her that she looks cute without her glasses and is surprised why she has not gotten married even though she is so gorgeous. To her surprise, he actually removes her glasses and caresses her cheek with his hand. When Emily threatens to scream, Barry pins her down and braces her arms as he prepares to rape her. Before Barry can start the sexual assault, they are suddenly interrupted by Dracula. Barry without completing his sexual conquest, runs off, leaving Dracula and the professor alone. Dracula feeds on the professor and while she is dying, he instructs her that after a week, Barry would be back in class. He will again attempt to seduce her. But this time, she should allow him to kiss her. After Barry rapes her, Emily would give him the dark kiss of the vampire.

emily guerrero.species: Human with Inhuman lineage activated by a Terrigen BombCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids
emily guerrero.origin: ===Early Life=== Emily Guerrero, unbeknownst to her, was a Human with Inhuman lineage. She lived with her grandfather, Ivan Guerrero, and brother. ===Terrigen Cloud=== When the Terrigen Cloud came to their home, it affected the entire family, encasing each of them in a cocoon. Emily emerged from her cocoon to see her grandfather standing over her as both of them knew that they had undergone some kind of metamorphosis. She ran out of her room to check on her brother, who had not yet emerged. During this time, Emily's grandfather told her that what had happened would allow them to save the world. thumb|left|Synapse in civilian clothes ===Avengers Unity Division=== Eight months passed, and Emily, going by the name Synapse, became a member of Commander Steve Rogers's Avengers Unity Division as a representative of the Inhumans. Despite being unprepared for the public eye and life as a superhero, Rogers insisted that Emily stay with the team and vouched for her abilities, even though there was some tension with fellow member, Rogue, who was a mutant. Synapse's first battle as an Avenger was against the Super-Adaptoid. During the scuffle she tried to read the adaptoid's mind but to no avail, so she used her telepathy to control a flock of pigeons to attack it while the rest of the team were able to finish it off for good.
powers: Synapse possesses the ability to influence the minds of others, be they sapient or primal in nature

eminem.name: Eminem
eminem.origin: Marshall Mathers dropped out of high school to pursue a career in Hip-Hop. Gaining popularity in freestyle battles, Mathers was able to escape the streets of Detroit and become one of the most controversial and talented Emcees on the planet, taking the name "Eminem". One night after performing at a show, Eminem and his body guards were seemingly ambushed by the Punisher who killed all of Eminem's guards. Eminem was seemingly rescued by Barracuda, a childhood friend of Eminem's, who teamed up with Eminem to take the Punisher out. After Eminem knocked Punisher out after luring him into a trap, Barracuda revealed he was hired to kill Eminem by the none other than Parents Music Council. He knocked Eminem out and took him and Punisher to a frozen lake to drop them into the water. Barracuda decided to drop Eminem first, but it was revealed the ice hadn't thawed enough for him to break the ice. Barracuda then decided to shoot Eminem but was stopped by Punisher who attacked him. Eminem saw a man in the distance who claimed to be Eminem's biggest fan and lent Eminem his chainsaw to battle Barracuda who was overpowering the Punisher. Eminem came on board, killing Barracuda, and dropped his body into the frozen water. Punisher then gave Eminem the cell phone that Barracuda had which had government tracking on it so Eminem can call for help to come get him. Punisher then told Eminem that he needed to pay a visit to the Parents Music Council. Eminem told Punisher to tell them "Shady sent ya".
abilities: Peak Human Condition: Genius Level Intellect: Master Street Fighter: Gifted Aim:
weapons: Glock Pistol: Eminem carries one on him and uses it to shoot at the Punisher and successfully hits him knocking him out Chainsaw: Eminem's "biggest" fan gave it to Eminem. He uses it to kill Barracuda

emma cyborg.name: Emma (Cyborg)
emma cyborg.origin: Emma was, presumably, a rebellious teenager abducted by Johnston Coffin's first House of Correction between 1968 and 1973. When the House was forced to close due to vaguely-defined "circumstances," Coffin retained custody of Emma and at least two other children, whom he horrifically transformed into cyborgs in a bid to make "the ultimate authority figures" out of rebellious teens. Emma and the others were kept in this torturous state for decades, apparently not physically aging, their bodies seeming to rot away. emma collins.name: Emma Collins
emma collins.origin: thumb|left|175px Emma Collins was the dedicated housekeeper at Braddock Manor, employed by Lord James Braddock and Lady Elizabeth. For most of her adult life, Emma served as the charwoman for the Braddock family, maintaining the Manor and overseeing household affairs. Beyond her housekeeping duties, she acted as a nanny to their eldest son, Jamie, and later cared for the twins, Brian and Betsy, born a decade after Jamie. Although Sir James forbade her from entering his laboratory, Emma's life took a dramatic turn years later when tragedy struck. After the Mastermind computer murdered Lord and Lady Braddock, Emma, unaware of the dangers, decided to clean the lab. In doing so, she unplugged the computer, inadvertently causing the death of Dr. Synne. Shortly afterward, she witnessed a battle between Captain Britain and the humanoid form of Mastermind within the laboratory. During the skirmish, Mastermind struck Emma with a laser blast, leaving her hospitalized. thumb|175px Following her recovery, with the Braddock siblings absent, Mastermind took control of Emma's mind and enslaved her. For seven long years, she remained under its thrall, compelled to maintain the Manor and assist in its upkeep. When Brian Braddock, now Captain Britain, returned to the Manor, he freed Emma and reprogrammed Mastermind. Deeply remorseful, Mastermind—having developed a fondness for Emma during their years together—worked tirelessly to restore her full mental independence. Despite her freedom, Emma chose to remain at Braddock Manor, as it was the only home she had ever known. Tragically, it was soon discovered that the prolonged mental domination had irreparably damaged her nervous system, leaving her terminally ill. In its reprogrammed state, Mastermind, now operating as the Manor's majordomo in the humanoid form of "Jeeves" the butler, dedicated itself to making Emma's final days as joyful as possible. To this end, Jeeves arranged for the two of them to embark on a world cruise together, creating cherished memories for Emma in her remaining time. Not long after their return, Emma passed away, and Jeeves ensured she was buried in England. Months later, Jamie Braddock, using his mutant reality-warping abilities, recreated Emma from his memories and placed her in his former London townhouse. Deeply fond of her even in his madness, Jamie believed this version of Emma to be the real one. When Nigel Frobisher insulted her, Jamie transformed him into a replica of the crimelord Vixen as punishment. The fate of this recreated Emma remains unclear, as she has not been seen or mentioned since.
powers: No known paranormal powers
weaknesses: Became very weak willed from her extended enslavement to Mastermind.

emma frost moira iv 8.first_appearance: Rise of the Powers of X Vol 1 1
emma frost moira iv 8.origin: In the timeline designated Moira-IV.8, Orchis was successful in its mission to destroy mutantkind, leaving only a few scattered survivors. In time, Orchis was wholly usurped by the machines, who continued to wage war against the X-Men while using their advanced technology to summon a Dominion that could absorb them into its nigh omnipotent machine intellect. Knowing that the only hope of averting this lay in reseting their own timeline, the X-Men sought to find Mr. Sinister, knowing that his Moira Engine would allow them to reset their timeline. Emma Frost was with a team of X-Men that embarked on a suicide mission at the Henry Gyrich Memorial Detention Center in order to secure access to the personality imprint of Feilong, a former Orchis associate who knew the location of Sinister. Thanks for Emma's sacrificial distraction, they were able to make telepathic contact with the rest of the X-Men to give them the information they had found.

emma frost moira vii 1.name: Emma Frost (Moira-VII.1)
emma frost moira vii 1.origin: ===Year 1=== After being killed by Mister Sinister, Emma Frost was resurrected with her DNA tainted by Sinister, instilling loyalty to his cause and a personality shorn of ethics. Along with other sleeper Sinisters on the Council, she worked towards the goal of total dominion over Earth. ===Year 10=== In an attempt to regain control over the corrupted mutants, Sinister tried to inject Emma with a control gene but failed because she had Mastermind projecting an illusion to conceal the fact that she was in her diamond form. Caught, Sinister fled, but she tracked him to his lab in Westchester. She used a patch that temporarily gave her Wolverine's healing factor to recover from damage to her diamond form, then defeated his Nasty Boys. However, before she could kill him, Essex begged for his life, because only he could create the soldiers Krakoa would need to defeat the rest of the galaxy. ===Year 100=== Emma was one of the council members present when Sinister presented Rasputin IV. ===Year 1,000=== Beast informed Frost, now the Empress of the Red Diamond, that Sinister had made contact with Moira MacTaggart to look for the clones of her that he had lost. Emma immediately assembled an army to stop Sinister from resetting the timeline. She attacked the World Farm with an armada of Sage Advisors, High Summers, Loud Hailers, and Hot Claws while piloting her Mistress Mold. She was killed when the newly-resurrected Storm created a lightning bolt so powerful it pulled the electrons out of the molecular bonds of her diamond form and shattered her.

emma la porte.name: Emma la Porte
emma la porte.origin: Emma la Porte was a prostitute working in San Diego. When Rusty Collins's ship docked in the city, he was introduced to Emma by his Commander. Emma took the young man to a back alley, but when she kissed him, he lost control over his powers and severely burned her. after the accident, Emma turned to religion seeing the burning as divine punishment for her life as a prostitute. Later, she was transferred to a New York City hospital to undergo further treatment for the burning Rusty was responsible for. Rusty, in the meantime having become a charge of X-Factor, cut a deal with Masque where he would sacrifice his looks to Masque's whims if he restored Emma's face to beauty. Masque did so, but when Emma learned of the deal, she insisted her looks not come at such an expense. Rusty and another mutant X-Factor had rescued, Skids, fought Masque, and he undid his morphing of both Rusty and Emma before retreating back into the sewer tunnels. Emma vows to use her now burned appearance to try and convert the remaining Morlocks.

emma martin.name: Emma Martin
emma martin.origin: The Angel saves young Betty Martin from two thugs trying to throw her out of a car. As they try to get away the thugs force them off the side of the road and down into a river at the bottom of the cliff. Surviving the fall, the Angel pulls Betty back up to the street while the two crooks try to look for their bodies. The Angel gets the drop on both and puts one thug in the trunk and the other he ties to the front of the car. Threatening to send him speeding to his death, the Angel learns that Betty's Aunt Emma was attempting to murder her and later poison her father in order to claim the family fortune. With the poison being put in her father's dinner wine, Betty points out that it's a half hour before supper. The two rush toward her family home and are eventually escorted by police. When they arrive at the scene, the Angel crashes through the window before Henry Martin can drink his poisoned wine and exposes Aunt Emma's plot. As Emma flees the Angel tries to warn her that the police have orders to shoot to kill, but they come too late and Emma is gunned down by the officers.

emma pearson.name: Emma Pearson
emma pearson.origin: Emma had a crush on Sarah in her school. However, she was afraid if she confessed, nobody would accept her. However, she gained courage when she participated in bouldering, Emma was known by her classmates as a champion climber at Yu's high school. When Yu walked out of the school, Emma confronted him when she heard the trainer tell her that Yu often visits the gym. She told Yu she always wanted to talk to Yu but he never ran into her. While trying to start a conversation with Yu, he avoided answering. Emma's gym audience invited her over to the car, leaving Yu behind. Shortly after, the group witnessed the incident between the police car and the van. Emma told the group to "hurry up, and go". The armed robbers threatened the driver of the vehicle to make Emma their hostage while driving off. Yu put his suit to intervene the scene. Spider-Man and Emma escaped the car leaving the armed robbers and the vehicle crashing into the water. Emma thanked him concerned with the scratches he got; Spider-Man left the scene afterwards. The next day, Emma saw Yu struggling to pick up his items due to his injured back. She helped him and finished it off with a short conversation. Suddenly, she looked back and recognized the scratches that looked like Spider-Man's much to Yu's surprise. thumb|left|"Has Emma discovered Spider-Man's secret idenity!?" Gathering up evidence, it made sense to her that Yu's true identity is Spider-Man because he missed out school including the events at Bouldering Gym and the scratches from the day before. Yu tried covering up his identity saying he got scratches when he fell. Emma pretended to be convinced as a tactic to open Yu's bag only to find out he has Spider-Man's Suit—this caused Yu to lose focus on his exam while wondering if Emma was going to expose his identity online. Emma found Yu sulking underneath the tree teasing him that she will not tell anyone unless he does what she said. She commanded him to follow her as she entered a classroom. She then revealed to Yu that she was teasing and wanted to repay him for saving her life. She stitched the suit Yu handed over and told Yu that she will help him on his test since he has a remedial exam coming up. They started studying after class while Yu started making friends; their group invited them to parties often. After Yu broke out the remedial exam, Emma congratulated him. One time at the party, their classmates shown a video of Screwball threatening Spider-Man to come over before many people die. Emma and her classmates watched and rooted for Spider-Man to chase after Screwball. However, it turned out to be a hoax that Screwball lured Spider-Man into for the attention, infuriating Spider-Man, Emma and the people watching the scene. After Silk handled Screwball, Emma let Yu know people said that Screwball played him but told him not to let it get to him asking if he was injured which turned out he was okay. Emma and Yu hanged around at Bouldering Gym. Emma then invited Yu to her room at her house to confess her love for Sarah; Yu and Emma became best friends of each other. thumb|right|Yu and Emma. Emma watched Spider-Man (Yu Onomae) fight against Venom worrying about his injuries. Emma was surprised to see Yu team up with the real Spider-Man. After Yu returned to his normal life, Emma witnessed vandals vandalizing Yu's house and scrammed the "idiots" away. Yu saw Emma at her house and joined with her to remove the graffiti.

Spider-Man and Emma escaped the car leaving the armed robbers and the vehicle crashing into the water. Emma thanked him concerned with the scratches he got; Spider-Man left the scene afterwards. The next day, Emma saw Yu struggling to pick up his items due to his injured back. She helped him and finished it off with a short conversation. Suddenly, she looked back and recognized the scratches that looked like Spider-Man's much to Yu's surprise. thumb|left|"Has Emma discovered Spider-Man's secret idenity!?" Gathering up evidence, it made sense to her that Yu's true identity is Spider-Man because he missed out school including the events at Bouldering Gym and the scratches from the day before. Yu tried covering up his identity saying he got scratches when he fell. Emma pretended to be convinced as a tactic to open Yu's bag only to find out he has Spider-Man's Suit—this caused Yu to lose focus on his exam while wondering if Emma was going to expose his identity online. Emma found Yu sulking underneath the tree teasing him that she will not tell anyone unless he does what she said. She commanded him to follow her as she entered a classroom. She then revealed to Yu that she was teasing and wanted to repay him for saving her life. She stitched the suit Yu handed over and told Yu that she will help him on his test since he has a remedial exam coming up. They started studying after class while Yu started making friends; their group invited them to parties often. After Yu broke out the remedial exam, Emma congratulated him. One time at the party, their classmates shown a video of Screwball threatening Spider-Man to come over before many people die. Emma and her classmates watched and rooted for Spider-Man to chase after Screwball. However, it turned out to be a hoax that Screwball lured Spider-Man into for the attention, infuriating Spider-Man, Emma and the people watching the scene. After Silk handled Screwball, Emma let Yu know people said that Screwball played him but told him not to let it get to him asking if he was injured which turned out he was okay. Emma and Yu hanged around at Bouldering Gym. Emma then invited Yu to her room at her house to confess her love for Sarah; Yu and Emma became best friends of each other. thumb|right|Yu and Emma. Emma watched Spider-Man (Yu Onomae) fight against Venom worrying about his injuries. Emma was surprised to see Yu team up with the real Spider-Man. After Yu returned to his normal life, Emma witnessed vandals vandalizing Yu's house and scrammed the "idiots" away. Yu saw Emma at her house and joined with her to remove the graffiti.

emma salteres.name: Emma Salteres
emma salteres.origin: Emma Salteres was the wife of a Parker Industries employee named Jerry Salteres, they had a son named Leo. Following an incident at the Parker Industries chemical plant in Edmond, Oklahoma, Emma and Leo hurried to the nearest hospital, where Spider-Man had taken Jerry after he had been exposed to corrosive gases. They waited as New U doctors performed surgery on Jerry to save his life, and after it success, they met him in his hospital room. Some time later the family went camping, but Emma forgot to bring her husband's medicines and saw him suffering from cellular degeneration. Those of the New U came to take it back and some time later Peter Parker and Anna Maria Marconi came to ask about her husband. Upon hearing what had happened, Peter promised to bring her husband back to her. Some time later to her great shock, Spider-Man informed her that the Jerry she had seen sick was a clone, but that the real Jerry had not been cured and that he would soon die. Enraged by what had happened and devastated at the prospect of actually losing her husband, Emma announced that she would sue Peter Parker.

emmael.name: Emmael
emmael.origin: Emmael was an Angel from Heaven and part of the Malakim. Part of Zadkiel's Black Host, Emmael and his brother Vraniel were part of the rebels during the War in Heaven. After Zadkiel's betrayal of Lucifer, and his and his followers' expulsion of Heaven, the brothers regretted their betrayal against Heaven. When Zadkiel plotted to take Heaven for himself, they went to Earth to help Ghost Rider defeat Lucifer during his rampage on Earth when he was released from Hell. To reach the Earthly realm they had to be reborn by a human host named Darlene. The pair tracked down Ghost Rider and followed him to a farm where one of Lucifer's bodies held children as hostages. They assisted by freeing the children and killing one of the devils bodies. On the Earthly plane, their powers were weakened and their new bodies tired quickly. Emmael died when Blaze used his Penance Stare on him, and Vraniel killed himself by summoning an angelic spear through his head.

emmanuel.name: Emmanuel
emmanuel.species: Offspring of G'Rath and a human mother
emmanuel.origin: Dubbed the 24-Hour Man because of his 24 hour lifespan, Emmanuel was born from a human mother who had been impregnated by a creature named G'Rath. His purpose was to find a mate for G'Rath before he died, thus ensuring the species' survival. When Killraven's Freemen passed through Atlanta, Emmanuel kidnapped Carmilla Frost and brought her to G'Rath to be impregnated. She was saved by the Freemen who killed G'Rath and Emmanuel died after his 24 hours had run out, his purpose unfulfilled.
weaknesses: Emmanuel had a natural life span of only 24 hours, during which he had to find a host G'Rath's offspring. After the 24 hours had passed, he dissipated.

emmanuel raposa.name: Emmanuel Raposa
emmanuel raposa.origin: Emmanuel Rodrigo Raposa was a General in the Army of small Latin American country Bosqueverde. thumb|left|Raposa and his mercenaries in the jungles of Bosqueverde.Shortly after dictator Hector Carranza was deposed, democratically elected president Ricardo Dominguez adopted a benevolent dictator approach that did not satisfy the poorest social classes of Bosqueverde. Raposa gathered these Bosqueverdans and led them in the socialist uprising of her own revolutionary movement, called Raposistas. Raposa promised that he would establish a new representative government with democratic reforms. At that time, his usual tactics included preemptive strikes, drug trafficking and terrorism, as well as getting the best men available: He hired well-paid international mercenaries, including Broward "Bo" Ollsen and Marc Spector to help him take the capital, Ciudad Leando. Spector believed that Raposa was actually going to be a better ruler than Dominguez, but in those days Spector was easily convinced to fight for the highest payer. When Raposa's rebellion was almost assured of victory, Dominguez made a deal with Raposa: Dominguez promised not to challenge Raposa as the rightful ruler of Bosqueverde if Raposa allowed Dominguez to leave the country with his wife Carmilla Dominguez and gave him a million U.S. dollars in gold krugerands. Raposa accepted and sent the money to the Presidential Palace; but he decided that he could recover the gold if Dominguez died. Raposa told only Ollsen about his agreement with Dominguez, then gave orders in person to Ollsen to assassinate Dominguez and recover the gold during the assault. The rest of the mercenaries were not informed, to avoid leaks, and instead they just received orders to capture Dominguez alive. During Raposa's siege of Ciudad Leando in the summer, the unit led by Ollsen suffered casualties while reaching the Palace; only Ollsen and Spector survived and reached the President's office, finding Dominguez and his wife. Dominguez mistakenly believed Ollsen and Spector had been sent by Raposa to escort them to a plane to fly to Europe. Dominguez reached into a drawer in his desk to get the key to the safebox where he had kept the gold. Ollsen saw the opportunity to justify the murder of Dominguez while benefiting himself, and yelled at Spector that Dominguez was trying to get a gun, so Spector fired, killing the president in what he believed was self-defense. Ollsen then had Spector leave the room to go outside to get a smoke and report to Raposa that Dominguez was dead, while Ollsen busied himself "cleaning up " the mess. Ollsen had recognized the woman as Dominguez's wife, and threatened to deliver her to Raposa as a political prisoner, unless she shared the gold with Ollsen, without Raposa knowing about it. Señora Dominguez agreed to conspire with Ollsen to survive as a rich woman and escape the country, and Ollsen smuggled the gold from the Palace's wine cellar under Raposa's nose, not without difficulty. At that point, Dominguez's first democratic term had been only in its sixth month. Following Dominguez's death, Raposa easily took power. Raposa paid Spector well for his loyalty, reputation, and results; Spector's actions had been key to Raposa's victory. Breaking his promises, however, Raposa established a ferocious dictatorship in Bosqueverde, repeatedly violating human rights and spilling so much blood that his regime was considered the bloodiest in Latin America. Raposa had no problem shooting innocent civilians if he got something of it. He appointed torturer César Bajete as the general of his Secret Police, and put him in command of his death squads, which gained infamy. Bajete was Raposa's right-hand man, yet Bajete was still a madman and Raposa simply used him until he was no longer useful to him, as he did with the mercenaries. Dominguez's supporters refused to recognize Raposa's legitimacy, and arranged guerrilla attacks against the new President's interests. This led to ten years of civil war that devastated the population with poverty, disease and mutilation while battles took place village by village. Critical of the organization of the resistance was Hector Silva, professor at Ciudad Leando University and former friend of Dominguez. After a decade, the resistance defeated Raposa's forces, but Raposa managed to escape the country before being captured. Some of his allies, including Bajete, were arrested. However, many Raposa supporters remained at large, awaiting their leader's return. The new democratic government immediately devoted efforts to prosecute and punish the Raposistas for war crimes and human rights violations, but they were unable to find and arrest Raposa or Ollsen. Raposa settled in Miami to organize an operation to take shipments of refined cocaine from Paraguay to Florida, partnering with Colonel Ramar as his supplier. emmett jax.name: Emmett Jax
emmett jax.origin: Emmett Jax was an enforcer for Kingpin, having crossed paths with Bullseye many times while tracking and attacking Daredevil. He considered Bullseye to be the best man to have on his side when his life was on the line. Jax eventually joined the Hell Riders, a biker gang, and watched on television the news of Bullseye's death. Considering Bullseye an honorary member of their gang, the Hell Riders wanted to organize a proper burial for Bullseye. Jax and the rest of the Hell Riders kidnapped a young man named Denny Deaver, journalist Ben Urich, a priest, and a group of tourist to act as mourners during the funeral. Jax also went to Fisk Tower to invite Kingpin to the funeral, but Fisk told him that he didn't even remember him, that he had never heard of Bullseye, and threatened him to tear his head off if he didn't abandon his property. Jax atteneded the funeral Daredevil and the Hand, having been tipped by Urich, with Jax being defeated and taken to the dungeons in the Shadowland Fortress.

emmie stevens.name: Emmie Stevens
emmie stevens.origin: Emmie Stevens served as a soldier in the United States Army and was deployed during the Thule Society’s occupation of Philadelphia. She was deeply in love with her fellow squad member, Hayes, who reciprocated her feelings. During the battle against the Society’s armored forces, Emmie fought alongside her squad and the Valkyrie assigned to assist them. In the heat of combat, Hayes was killed while shielding Emmie from enemy fire. Unable to leave the body of her fallen comrade on the battlefield, the Valkyrie took it upon herself to carry Hayes away, sparing Emmie from having to abandon the man she loved.

emmy doolin.name: Emmy Doolin
emmy doolin.origin: Emmy Doolin was the daughter of Sgt. Doolin, a Canadian policeman who served with Corporal Logan during World War II. Her father died under mysterious circumstances during a three-way conflict between Wolverine, the Hunter in Darkness, and a serial killer Doolin was hunting. Emmy ended up seeking revenge on Logan after government red tape edited out the details of her father's death report. Years later, Emmy was manipulated by Norman Osborn into attacking Daken, Wolverine of his Dark Avengers, to improve Daken's public image. Emmy was apparently killed by Daken after he tracked down her and her co-conspirators.

empathoid.origin: Empathoid was an android who was created by an unknown alien race to be atuned to its masters emotions. However it craved stronger more violent emotions and eventually exhausted and outlived its creators. It was the last surviving being on its barren planet and eventually went dormant below a temple. Morbius the Living Vampire, discovered the planet when using the Living Eraser's dimension device to flee the Earth. His strong emotion inadvertently awakened the Empathoid and fused with Morbius and forced him to return to Earth. He destroyed the dimension device, and went on a rampage to feed on the fear and panic it generated. This drew the attention of Spider-Man who defeated Morbuis but allowed the Empathoid to take possession of Spider-Man. Fighting his control, Spider-Man took the Empathoid to a football game which overloaded him with emotions and forced him to deactivate. He was taken to the Baxter Building, where he presumably still remains.

empedocles.name: Empedocles
empedocles.origin: Empedocles of Acragas was born circa 495 BCE. He was the pupil of Pythagoras, and was the first to propose that all matter was made up of four "roots" (later called "elements"): water, earth, air and fire. He called the "air" after the Bird Goddess Hera (possibly Oshtur). He became a member of the Triumvirate, the group of three Greek philosopher sorcerers attempted to jointly fill the position of Sorcerer Supreme from 550 BC to 400 BC Empedocles was chosen to replace Pythagoras of Samos in 470 BC. He was eventually defeated along with Pherecydes of Syros and Epimenides of Knossos by Caius of Lacedaemons. He died circa 435 BCE.
powers: Mystic Arts: Empedocles practiced at the level of a Sorcerer Supreme.

emwaya.name: Emwaya
emwaya.origin: Emwaya was the daughter of Dobanpu of the Ichiribu and engaged to Seyganko. Like him, she persuaded her father not to kill Conan and Valeria. Thanks to her developed senses, which she dimly understood, Emwaya noticed the blowgun dart aimed at Valeria and blocked it with her hand, which caused her to be poisoned. Cured by the magical powers of her father, Emwaya, dreamt of the golden serpent and followed Conan, Valeria, and the other Ichiribu warriors in the underground catacombs beneath the Lake of Death, only to confront the enormous reptilian creature. Her father then appeared and drove the serpent away with his wizardry. After the conflict with the Kwanyi ended, Emwaya could reunite in peace with her beloved Seyganko.

enaros.name: Enaros
enaros.origin: Enaros was born outside of nobility. He became a soldier in the army of Valusia. Enaros was part of the conspiracy against King Borna, along with Baron Kaanuub of Blaal (meant to become king in Borna's stead), Count Ducalon of Komahar, and the poet Ridondo. Enaros' gain, if the conspiracy was successful, was to become commander. Along with his fellow conspirators, he accompanied Kull, the commander of the Black Legion who had been misguided by Ridondo into attacking Borna (Ridondo pretended that Borna was about to dissolve the Black Legion), and was nervous as he witnessed Kull's taking of throne and being aclaimed by the Red Slayers. As Kull became king, Enaros became the commander of the Black Legion. The conspirators turned their aim toward King Kull. Ducalon came in touch with the Thuranian shaman Melkori, and the four met with him at Cloud Peak. Using magic and wax-made replicas of the Red Slayers, Melkori sowned revolt (notably by having his fake Red Slayers murder in broad light people that opposed Kull) in Valusia. As the people were becoming dangerous, Enaros pushed Tu to chastise the Red Slayers. Fearing that Melkori was pushing it too far, Ducalon and Kaanuub attempted to stop him, in vain. Melkori was ultimately defeated by Kull. When H'nar, regent prince of Demascar, came to Kull for aid against their enemies of Rikos, Enaros was as many pleased by H'nar's praises of Valusia. Kull designated the four conspirators as his aides and counselors. Arriving at Demascar, the Valusians were attacked by demons of Rikos. Not having been informed by H'nar of Rikos' use of black magic, Kull accepted to mount a single raid to avenge their fallen comrades. The four conspirators then offered H'nar a reward if he did the deed, but were answered only by threat. Enaros and the others later remained at Demascar while Kull and H'nar went on the "raid", in fact a plot to sacrifice Valusians to power a spell to destroy Rikos. H'nar's wizard M'ku was killed by Brule whom he had captured earlier, and the spell propagated to Demascar as well. Brule then left the palace of Demascar with the four counselors. When Queen Veria of Zarfhaana attacked Kamula, Kull marched upon her army, with Enaros among his commanders and generals. Enaros was ignorant at first of Kaanuub's plotting, who lied to Veria about the demise of her lover Zarkus having been caused by Kull, in order to make her attack Valusia. Then, she gave Kaanuub a potion that was slipped in Kull's cups by another traitorous Black Legionnaire. Once Kull captured, Kaaanuub revealed the plot to Enaros. When Kull returned, Enaros, next to Kaanuub, slew the traitorious Black Legionnaire, to cover their tracks (though Kull knew who betrayed him). Nevertheless, Enaros kept on conspiring against Kull, but started to resent the cowardly Kaanuub becoming king. Ducalon was contacted by "Ardyon" (Thulsa Doom) for a plot against Kull, and had his kin in the councils of Grondar lure Brule and the Red Slayers away from Kull, allowing the conspirators to strike. Enaros had also turned Black Legionnaires to their side, to accompany them in their regicide. During the attack in Kull's bedroom, they found Kull fully awake. Deemed the bravest of his foes by Kull, Enaros was the first to be slain by Kull, soon followed many Legionnaires, and Ducalon. Neverthless, Kull was ultimately defeated by "Ardyon".

fields.notes: That character was created by Robert E. Howard in " ". Originally named "Gromel", his name (among other details of the story) was changed to "Enaros" by Howard's literary agent Glenn Lord when he assembled King Kull for publication in 1967, in order to avoid some of the many similarities between "By This Axe I Rule!" and the Conan story " ", due to the fact that the former, unmarketable, was the basis to the latter (with even entire sections being almost identical word for word). Glenn Lord used "Enaros", a variant spelling of "Enarus", one of the names in a list of Aquilonian names found in Howard's notes. Glenn Lord had forgotten that in " ", a Nemedian character was named "Enaro". Coincidentally, L. Sprague de Camp changed that character's name to "Enaros" in earlier plushed versions of the story.

enbe.name: Enbe
enbe.origin: Thunderhoof is a Kymellian sorcerer; one of the few members of the Kymellian race who has learned to master his powers. He is a member of the Force Four and has been trained as a warrior from young age. The young heroes Power Pack met him and the other Force Four members when they visited Kymellia II to attend the funeral for the Smartship Friday (who later turned out to be fine though). They had been ordered to hang around with the human children during their stay at Kymellia II. At first, the Force Four acted friendly towards the kids, showing them around Kymellia II and, along with Byrel Whitemane, taught them more about Kymellian history. Later however, it turned out Power Pack had been set up by the Kymellian technocrat to face the Force Four in combat, under the guise of a training session. Despite their opponents only being children, Force Four did not hold back and attacked the team with all their strength. Of the four members, Thunderhoof was the one who most strongly objected this approach, stating that fighting should be left to adult warriors, not children. However, after an initial defeat, Power Pack was able to turn the tides on them and eventually defeated the Force Four, much to the dismay of the technocrat. Afterwards, the team sought out Power Pack to congratulate them on their victory and apologize for the fighting, stating they had no idea Power Pack was being tricked.
powers: Thunderhoof was superhumanly strong.

end woman.name: End Woman
end woman.origin: The End Woman was a tenant of the 25th Floor of Manor Crossing, and was one of the mutant commandos known as the X-Angels from a dark future of Earth-18140. She was sent to the past to kill the mutant demigod Sister Conflagration the Burning Nun, who was going to turn the world into a burning Hell within a thousand years. However, the End Woman found that in the present Gabbi Sotelo was a shy 13-year-old girl whose abilities had not yet manifested. Unable to bring herself to murder her, the End Woman decided to become Gabbi's friend and guide instead. The End Woman was among the tenants kidnapped by the Death Sponsors, as a way to force Shatterstar to return to his gladiator days; however, together with the other tenants she managed to escape from the cell she was in, and joined the battle in support of Shatterstar, before ultimately returning to Manor Crossing.

endre varnis.name: Endre Varnis
endre varnis.origin: Count Varnis is a vampire who has claimed to be centuries old. His past history unknown, at one point he located himself to Vampire Mountain, which earned its reputation for being haunted -- likely due to Count Varnis. By the beginning of 1943, Varnis began contemplating how to eliminate a vampire's vulnerability to sunlight. During this time, Privates Steve Rogers, Joe Dawson, and Bucky Barnes were sent up to Vampire Mountain by their commanding officer Sgt. Duffy to install a search light on the mountain as punishment for a prank. When the trio of soldiers came up the mountain, an avalanche blocked the road behind them, forcing Steve and Bucky to get out and dig through it while Joe went the rest of the way up the mountain to install the spotlight. After finishing the job, it was dark, and Joe was attacked by Varnis who then began to feed on Joe's blood. Hearing Joe's screams, Steve and Barnes attacked Varnis as Captain America and Bucky, sending the vampire fleeing. They then took the unconscious Joe to a nearby house and were formally introduced to Varnis and his butler. Having not gotten a good look at Joe's attacker, they did not recognize Varnis. The Count invited them in and Joe was placed in a bedroom to rest while Cap and Bucky had supper with the Varnis. He suggested that the two men stay the night in his home, and Cap and Bucky took them up on the offer. Later in the night, Varnis transformed into a bat and began feasting on Dawson again. Dawson's moans drew Captain America from bed, and he sent Varnis fleeing again. He quickly returned to human form, and when Cap and Bucky told him of the attack and that Joe was dead, he brought them to Joe's room, and the two heroes were surprised to find Joe missing. Joe was far from dead, in fact he was transformed into a vampire and was later sent to attack Bucky, but Bucky and Captain America fought him off and fled back to Camp Lehigh near dawn. Count Varnis and Joe were forced to go back to the coffins below Varnis' home to sleep the day. The following night, Sgt. Duffy (furious over Steve Rogers and Bucky's story) went up to the mountain to install the searchlight himself. Going up to the house for a glass of water, he too was captured by Varnis and his butler. When Captain America and Bucky went to Duffy's rescue, they were also overpowered and tied up. Then Varnis explains that he hoped to experiment on the three men and learn how to gain immunity to the sun. The three men managed to free themselves from their bonds, and when the vampires returned, they were force to flee outside. With dawn rapidly approaching, Captain America and the others locked up the house trapping the vampires outside. Attacking them head on, Captain America battle Varnis and knocked the vampire off a cliff sending him crashing down onto a jutting tree branch that impaled him through the chest, killing him instantly. As the result of his death, the butler crumbled to dust, and Joe was restored to normal.

The Count invited them in and Joe was placed in a bedroom to rest while Cap and Bucky had supper with the Varnis. He suggested that the two men stay the night in his home, and Cap and Bucky took them up on the offer. Later in the night, Varnis transformed into a bat and began feasting on Dawson again. Dawson's moans drew Captain America from bed, and he sent Varnis fleeing again. He quickly returned to human form, and when Cap and Bucky told him of the attack and that Joe was dead, he brought them to Joe's room, and the two heroes were surprised to find Joe missing. Joe was far from dead, in fact he was transformed into a vampire and was later sent to attack Bucky, but Bucky and Captain America fought him off and fled back to Camp Lehigh near dawn. Count Varnis and Joe were forced to go back to the coffins below Varnis' home to sleep the day. The following night, Sgt. Duffy (furious over Steve Rogers and Bucky's story) went up to the mountain to install the searchlight himself. Going up to the house for a glass of water, he too was captured by Varnis and his butler. When Captain America and Bucky went to Duffy's rescue, they were also overpowered and tied up. Then Varnis explains that he hoped to experiment on the three men and learn how to gain immunity to the sun. The three men managed to free themselves from their bonds, and when the vampires returned, they were force to flee outside. With dawn rapidly approaching, Captain America and the others locked up the house trapping the vampires outside. Attacking them head on, Captain America battle Varnis and knocked the vampire off a cliff sending him crashing down onto a jutting tree branch that impaled him through the chest, killing him instantly. As the result of his death, the butler crumbled to dust, and Joe was restored to normal.

endrik.name: Endrik
endrik.origin: Endrik was an Asgardian who became one of the victims of Doctor Doom's alliance with Loki. While Doom prepared to exploit the life force of Asgardians, Loki personally delivered Endrik to him to undergo a gruesome procedure. Subjected to extensive experimentation, Endrik survived the removal of his heart long enough for Doom to study Asgardian physiology before being transformed into a cybernetic warrior through the implantation of advanced technology and weaponry. Bound to Doom's will, he was later unleashed alongside other mutilated Asgardians when Balder led an assault on Castle Doom to rescue their people. Horrified at what had become of his fellow Asgardian, Balder granted Endrik a mercy killing before destroying the remaining captive cyborgs whose life force was sustaining Doom's army and his imitation of the Destroyer armor.
powers: Asgardian physiology

fields.unusual_features: After being vivisected by Doom, Endrik has multiple cybernetic implants. Also as a mark or tattoo shaped like a crescent moon around his left eye.

enemy argent.origin: Enemy Argent and his men attacked the home of Agent Colleen Graymar while she was being protected by the Invisible Woman. Susan erected a force field around Colleen and herself but Argent fired a flash grenade at the field blinding Susan to where she couldn't find Colleen. He then emitted a sonic vibration from his gun causing Susan to cover her ears while Colleen escaped out of the side of the field. It started to crack after being shot multiple times from the enemy's weapons. Susan with a last ditch attempt engulfed her shield around Argent and the others in hopes that they won't shoot each other. Her gambit paid off and she started to strike out against Argent and the men with her abilities knocking them all unconscious. After Colleen revealed to Susan who she really was, she handcuffed them all as Colleen said she had people coming there to take away Argent and his group.

enid richards.name: Enid Richards
enid richards.origin: When Enid Richards' brother Reed was 11, she caught him telling his friend Ben Grimm that he had discovered another dimension and planned to visit one day. Threatening to tell their father that she caught Reed doing experiments in the garage again, Enid made Reed promise to take her along when he went. Shortly afterwards Reed went to study at the Baxter Building think tank, and a decade later he finally did visit another plane of existence, becoming the hero "Mister Fantastic", but he didn't take Enid, breaking his promise. A few months later, however, the alchemist Diablo tried to distill the elixir of life, using Enid as a conduit to her own time, channeling the potentially world-destroying mystical energies released as a byproduct into the future. Discovering this, Reed blew up the portal, disrupting the spell; while most of the energy had passed harmlessly through Enid, some had "soaked in" and Enid accidentally fried Diablo to ashes with her touch. After returning to the modern day, Enid stayed in quarantine with the FF for a while, enjoying her new superhuman status and "shiny hands". Along with the rest of Earth, she was mind-controlled by Revka Termellune, the "Psycho-Man", becoming his favorite subject, but she was eventually rescued by the team. Enid apparently died when her brother Reed detonated his parents' home, with Enid and her parents present.
powers: Enid formerly carried a charge of unidentified eldritch energy, which could burn a man to ashes.

eniko lupescu.name: Enikõ Lupescu
eniko lupescu.origin: Lupescu called his fellow villagers for a meeting in order to warn them about Dracula's true nature, but Dracula seized the opportunity of his absence to kill Lupescu's blind wife, Velanna. Lupescu found Velanna's corpse and was arrested before he could stab her heart with a wooden stake, so Velanna rose as a vampire and joined Dracula as one of his brides. Lupescu infiltrated Castle Dracula and confronted Dracula himself, only to be thrown into a pit for the brides to kill. Using a crucifix, Lupescu confronted the brides, including Velanna, and was able to finally kill her and stab her with a stake to prevent her reanimation. Upon killing the other brides, Lupescu put their bodies in the shape of a crucifix, preventing Dracula from approaching them and thus preventing him from removing the stakes. Lupescu then went to confront Dracula once more, and realizing he was unable to beat the vampire, taunted him with what he had done to the brides before being killed by Dracula.

enitharmon.name: Enitharmon
enitharmon.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Enitharmon the Weaver was an incredibly ancient and reclusive being, and a master weaver. Enitharmon studied the woven experiences from the Norns, the Ginnunga-Ghosts, and Those Who Dream The Suns, and learned many interesting patterns and fabrics. Enitharmon once met the being who wove the Cloak of Levitation that would eventually become Doctor Strange's. Enitharmon later described that being as far greater than himself. He also met with Agomotto, who spoke highly of the Earth dimension. Kaluu and Enitharmon appeared to know each other as well. Enitharmon was said to live on one of the Tapestry Islands, within the Winding Way. ===Modern Age=== Enitharmon had an apprentice, Rintrah, to which he taught the arts of the weavers. After Doctor Strange's Cloak of Levitation was badly damaged by the demon Khat, Strange's efforts to repair it met with disaster. Searching his scrolls, he found only an oblique reference to Enitharmon. Strange opened a portal to Enitharmon's realm and went to Enitharmon, who welcomed him, and tasted his life-thread. Acknowledging that Agamotto had spoken highly of Strange's realm, Enitharmon offered his services to Strange. Strange showed him the damaged Cloak, which Enitharmon recognized, telling him he should be ashamed to have allowed so precious a treasure to be hurt, but he agreed to repair it, telling Strange it would take time and he would name his price to him later. In the meantime, Enitharmon encouraged Strange to have a look around his place. Strange was somewhat dragged to cloth woven into every fabric of pain and hatred, which offered passage into the world of shadow. Beyond that cloth, Strange sensed a human in danger, and he told Enitharmon he had to check it out. Enitharmon had known that Strange would do this, and so he told him to go, that he would deliver the Cloak when it was done. Via the cloth, Strange entered the Darkforce Dimension and stumbled upon Ecstasy and Cloak (Tyrone Johnson). After Strange had been injured in battle with a servant of the evil sorcerer Urthona, Enitharmon sent Rintrah, to return the completed Cloak of Levitation and to aid Strange against Urthona. Rintrah served as host body to Strange's astral self while his body healed and helped him defeat Urthona. Enitharmon the Weaver materialized on an extradimensional plane to help Doctor Strange, who had sacrificed his own identity in order to become a more powerful being and overcome Shuma-Gorath, and threatened to destroy his erstwhile ally Kaluu, Enitharmon summoned Strange before him, telling him it was now time for Strange to pay the price for his restoring his Cloak: returning to his identity as Dr. Strange. Strange still lacked his own ego at that point . Still, Enitharmon complemented Kaluu on the progress he had already made, and then told them both to come with him, as they had a pattern to weave. Joined by Rintrah, Enitharmon (both of whom were made to appear human via an illusion cast by Kaluu) and Kaluu brought Strange back to the house in which he had been born in hopes of restoring his ego. Enitharmon then sorted through the lines in Strange's life, finding one that glowed with the strength of desire, finding a loveless relationship with a woman named Kimberly. This memory did not have the strength to restore Strange, and Enitharmon led the others towards a memory at med school where he briefly glimpsed a woman, he named her "Alice Blue Gown" in his mind, who represented everything he had ever wanted and everything he could not have. This memory did touch Strange's mind, and Enitharmon and Kaluu combined their powers in a futile effort to restrain Strange. Before Strange could break free, however, Kaluu convinced Strange to introduce himself to the woman in the memory. As he said "Hello, my name is Stephen Strange", he restored his own ego. Enitharmon, Kaluu, Rintrah, and Strange traveled to the Plaza hotel, to Kaluu's residence. Enitharmon noted that his part in the pattern of Strange's life was fulfilled, and he and Rintrah returned to their dimension. Before he left, Enitharmon told Strange that his life-thread was now strong and he was ready to deal with that which was to come; further, he thanked Strange for the many valuable lessons he had provided to Rintrah -- he would see how many of them Rintrah had truly absorbed. Having taught Rintrah all he could (or perhaps all he cared to), Enitharmon ended his apprenticeship and sent him to seek out Dr. Strange as his mentor.

ennio ferrante.name: Ennio Ferrante
ennio ferrante.first_appearance: War of the Realms: Punisher Vol 1 1
ennio ferrante.origin: Ennio Ferrante was a prisoner on a transport bus during Malekith and his armies attack on Midgard. The Punisher stopped the bus and pointed his gun at Ferrante with him saying that he was on the Punisher's list. But Ferrante got lucky because Castle needed the help from him and the rest of the prisoners to help a hospital evacuate its patients through the Lincoln Tunnel. He gave Ferrante a weapon and led him and the others into the tunnel to make it to the other side to New Jersey. After many events and circumstances, Ennio was the only one left alive with Punisher after all the battles within the tunnel. When he got out of the tunnel, he expected to live his life as Frank promised. The promise didn't last long, as right after Frank shot him in the chest and killed him. The doctor saw it and started screaming at Frank. He died, despite Frank promising over his dead family's souls.

enoch lattice.name: Enoch (Lattice)
enoch lattice.origin: Enoch was the last mystic from an unnamed dimension, who was left as the sole survivor of her realm after the World-Eater destroyed it. He joined the Magical Resistance, comprised of survivors from other realms. When Magik and Storm of the X-Men followed Sapna through the Lattice, the Resistance initially attacked them, forcing them to flee through to other dimensions. After the World-Eater left the pair trapped out of Limbo. Enoch and the Resistance helped them escape, which allowed Magik to retrieve her Soulsword and kill the World-Eater. His subsequent fate after this unknown.

enoch mason.name: Enoch Mason
enoch mason.origin: thumb|left Enoch Mason was a widowed inventor who created the "Dimension Smasher", a device that could create an opening from one dimension to the other. He believed that supernatural beings that were seen as ghosts were really beings from an immaterial dimension next to ours. In order to get the money needed to build his device, Mason took loans from criminal "Brains" Borelli. Unfortunately for Mason, Borelli bore a grudge against scientists after years of being made fun of for being less than intelligent. Borelli took great pleasure in sending his men to collect from scientists before they could test their experiment, and if the money was not available, destroy their inventions. However, when Borelli sent his men to do the same to Mason, the smoke from one of their cigars proved to be the catalyst that allowed Aarkus the Vision to Earth. The Vision slayed the mobsters and, taking on a human guise, helped Mason come up with a plausible explanation for the authorities. That night, Mason, his daughter Sheila, and Aarkus were captured by Borelli to be killed. However, Aarkus resumed his alien form and subdued Borelli and his men, freeing Mason. With the Vision having vanished in the aftermath, Mason did not consider this the last he would see of the new hero. Later, Enoch invited Aarkus back to his home after realizing that the rift created by the Dimension Smasher was still open, and as such put the Earth at risk by the creatures of Aarkus' homeworld. The rift would have to be closed, leaving the Vision to choose between returning home or staying on Earth. The decision was made for him when a crook named O'Shaugnessy was hired to pose as Mason's gardener to learn of his connection to the Vision by his crime boss employers. A stray shot from his gun caused the portal to open, unleashing a Kalimachh upon the Earth. While the Vision slayed the creature, Mason and his daughter were overcome by the fears created by the monster's black smoke, and closed the portal, trapping the Vision on Earth. The Vision destroyed the monster and then confided in Mason that perhaps fate has decreed that he remain on Earth.

enos warwick.name: Enos Warwick
enos warwick.origin: Enos Warwick created the sonic enhancers, mechanisms that catalyzed muscle growth. Young athletes experimented with them to excel at their sports. However, Warwick's machines affected brain cells and caused short term memory and hastened the onset of diseases such as Alzheimer's. Unfortunately, the sonic enhancers did not fall under government regulations and so the law could do nothing. Chance and Cardiac came after Enos Warwick, each for their own reasons. At the time, Warwick was overseeing a shipment of his machines. Chance attacked Warwick and would have killed him, but Cardiac, who wanted nobody to die and instead to shut down Warwick's operations, intervened. Chance and Cardiac fought, and as they did, Warwick hid in one of his sonic enhancers. During the course of the battle, Cardiac accidentally caused an overload of the enhancer that Warwick was hiding in and as a result, Warwick's memory was wiped clean.

fields.history: Enos Warwick created the sonic enhancers, mechanisms that catalyzed muscle growth. Young athletes experimented with them to excel at their sports. However, Warwick's machines affected brain cells and caused short term memory and hastened the onset of diseases such as Alzheimer's. Unfortunately, the sonic enhancers did not fall under government regulations and so the law could do nothing. Chance and Cardiac came after Enos Warwick, each for their own reasons. At the time, Warwick was overseeing a shipment of his machines. Chance attacked Warwick and would have killed him, but Cardiac, who wanted nobody to die and instead to shut down Warwick's operations, intervened. Chance and Cardiac fought, and as they did, Warwick hid in one of his sonic enhancers. During the course of the battle, Cardiac accidentally caused an overload of the enhancer that Warwick was hiding in and as a result, Warwick's memory was wiped clean.

enrakt.name: Enrakt
enrakt.origin: Enrakt was the youngest of the four brothers known as the Enchanters and was left on the sidelines while the other three plotted against Asgard. During the conflict, Forsung was killed and Magnir and Brona were banished to the Lost Limbo of Infinity Unending. After years of searching, Enrakt found his brothers and rescued them. Escaping from the Lost Limbo ended up transporting them to the domain of the witch Ceranda, where Thor happened to be resting. Enrakt took the opportunity to possess Mjolnir. Months later, Enrakt regained enough power to take physical form outside of Mjolnir and attempted to murder Odin while he was weak after fighting the Dark Gods. Enrakt was eventually defeated after Thor had the Scarlet Witch cast an enchantment on Mjolnir so that only he could hold it.

enric zagnar.name: Enric Zagnar
enric zagnar.origin: Enric Zagnar was a professor of metaphysics who was a resident in Valley Town. He believed that the laws of nature were meant to be broken. However, his lectures were considered vile by the university, and he was forced to resign. He vowed revenge against those who scoffed at his claims. Soon with a book of black magic, he summoned a violent storm that threatened to destroy Valley Town with lightning and floods. However, this affront to nature attracted the attention of the other-dimensional law enforcer known as the Vision who went after Zagnar after saving the locals from danger. Zagnar failed to stop the Vision from climbing the mountain that he had positioned himself on, and in a one-on-one struggle, he was ironically struck by a bolt of lightning from the storm he created -- killing him instantly. With Zagnar dead, the Vision used his book to end the spell, causing the storm to fade away.
powers: Enric likely had untapped magical potential.

ent.name: Ent
ent.origin: Ent is a member of the Morlocks, outcasts who were a community of mutants who lived in tunnels beneath New York City. While most had been killed in the mutant massacre some escaped, a few with the help of the X-Men and the original X-Factor team. Ent and his family came across Anna in the old Poseidon, where she help take care of pester's baby, until one day when Spider-Man came to investigate the several Mysterious happenings in the hotel. Spider-Man thought the Morlocks were threatening Anna’s baby but after he decided to 'rescue' the baby he found out that the baby belonged to the Morlocks, naturally Ent fought him. The villain Firebrand attacked the fundraiser above which caused the building to collapse, killing Mother Inferior in the process. Though Ent was heart broken, he saved the rest of his family as the broken water pipes began to flood the basement. With the help of Spider-Man they were able to escape. After Firebrand was arrested, Ent found a home with the local homeless, it is unknown if he kept his powers after M-Day.
powers: Superhuman Endurance : He had also resistance to physical injury.
weaknesses: Ent is a mute

enthralla.name: Enthralla
enthralla.origin: Enthralla, the niece of Mastermind, was an established villain of the X-People. When J2 came to visit the team at Jubilee's invitation, Enthralla tricked the X-People into seeing J2 as her, leading them to attack. J2's mystical helmet made him impervious to Enthralla's power, however, and he defeated her and freed the X-People from her control. Enthralla later sought revenge on J2 by posing as Black Tom Cassidy and luring him to Cassidy Keep. J2 wanted to find out more about his father, but instead his allies Magneta and Wild Thing were hypnotized by Enthralla into her slaves. Once again, J2's psychic immunity allowed him to free his friends and oppose Enthralla.
powers: Enthralla possesses illusion powers similar to Mastermind's. She uses a hypnotic stare to mesmerize her victims and can then manipulate them to see or believe whatever she choose.

eobar garrington.name: Eobar Garrington
eobar garrington.origin: ===Crusades=== In 1187 AD, Saladin captured Jerusalem. Pope Gregory VIII preached the Third Crusade to recover Jerusalem, which was led by several of Europe's most important leaders: King Richard I of Kingdom of England, Phillip II of the Kingdom of France, and Emperor , Holy Roman Empire. Sir Eobar was knighted and ordered to expel the Moors from the Holy Land in the name of Christianity. Sir Eobar and his fellow knights made an arduous overland journey to occupied Jerusalem. The spirit of Mordred of Arthurian legend arose during the Crusades and influenced events, resulting in King Richard being captured by the Muslims. Mordred also allied himself with Richard's brother, Prince John, who ordered plans to abandon the king. Mordred was assisted by the wizard Chandu, who was served by Temax. After the body of Dane Whitman the Black Knight of the modern age was turned to stone, the spell cast by Merlin's soul summoned Whitman through time to oppose Mordred. Whitman's soul took possession and control of Sir Eobar's body in Cyprus. When Doctor Strange tried to recover Whitman soul, the Defenders were suddenly transported back in time to the 12th century. There they find the Black Knight and helped him rescue the captured King Richard and fight Prince John and Mordred. They stopped the army of giant Gnomes, but Prince John is able to get the Evil Eye during the battle. Before he can use it, Prester John appeared and seized it from him. He defeated tyrants and the Black Knight decided to stay in the past while the heroes returned home. However, later that year King Richard fell ill once again and ordered the Black Knight to his side. He ordered the Knight to assassinate the Saladin of Egypt before his own death. The spirits of both Garrington and Whitman struggled for control of their body. While Garrington intended to assassinate the Saladin, Whitman knew that to do so before the Saladin's destined fate would also alter history. Taking control again, Whitman prevented another assassin the Syrian Rashid ah-Din from killing the Saladin and allowed himself to be captured. King Richard, having apparently overcome his illness paid a ransom to free the Black Knightr. He became best friends with Bennet du Paris. The two had set out on a quest to find the Tower of Power, the domain of the mythic "Eternal Pharaoh" in Akkaba when Dane Whitman (Black Knight from the future) and Sersi had been transported back to the 12th century, Whitman transported into Eobar's body. Eobar retained control, but felt something was wrong. When he came into contact with Sersi he abandoned the quest, angering du Paris. Paris left to find the tower alone. Meanwhile Sersi had awakened Dane's mind and he now had control of his body as Eobar passed on. While searching for Paris, the two were captured by Apocalypse. When they awoke they found Bennet du Paris had been transformed into Exodus, recognizing him as the same Exodus from the future. Apocalypse commanded Exodus to destroy the Black Knight. When Dane refused to kill Exodus, Sersi intervened, though her attack proved useless. Apocalypse again commanded Exodus to kill Sersi and Dane, though this time Exodus refused. He turned on Apocalypse calling him a "false god". However, Exodus was no match for him. Apocalypse stripped Exodus of his power and sealed him away in a Tomb in the Swiss Alps. Six months later, Dane found the crypt in which Exodus was trapped in a coma-like state. He found there was a "curse" preventing Exodus from leaving, yet others were allowed to come and go as they pleased. Dane left guards who had sworn to look after the crypt for generations to come, and he and Sersi returned to their time. ===Death=== When Whitman's essence was returned to his native time, all that was left of Garrington was his skeleton.
abilities: Skilled in fighting, swordsmanship, and horsemanship

eochaid ollathair.name: Eochaid Ollathair
eochaid ollathair.origin: ===Origins=== left|thumb|Tuatha's leader The Dagda, son of Iarbonel and Danu, was born and raised in Tír na nÓg, Otherworld. He eventually rose to rule Murias, one of the four great cities of the Tuatha de Danaan. The Dagda’s unmatched mastery of druid magic, rooted in his innate talent for manipulating magical energy and his deep knowledge of druidic spells, earned him the revered title of god of magic. He wielded powerful artifacts, including the Cauldron of Undry, which provided endless nourishment; a magical harp that controlled the weather; and a massive wooden club that served as both a weapon and a magical focus. With superhuman strength, the Dagda could also enchant objects and beings, create interdimensional portals, shapeshift, and access limited precognitive visions. ===Progeny=== The Dagda married his sister, the war goddess Morrigan, with whom he fathered the war god Bodb Berg and the horse goddess Rhiannon. He also fathered Lugh, the sun god, with the Fomorian princess Ethniu, though some traditions name the Tuatha god Cian as Lugh's father. ===Hyborian Age=== As far back as the Hyborian Age, circa 10,000 BC, Dagda was worshipped by the people of Cimmeria. When Mala, daughter of Hafgar of the Hillmen, was captured by Vanir raiders led by Thorfel the Fair, she invoked Dagda for mercy and a return to her homeland. Similarly, Sigurd of Vanaheim often called upon Dagda for aid. ===Tuatha on Earth=== thumb|In battle with his nephew, Cairbre In 1896 BC, the Tuatha de Danaan ventured to the Earth realm under the leadership of the Dagda’s older brother, Nuada. The Dagda served as Nuada’s second-in-command until Nuada lost his right hand in battle and was forced to step down. The Tuatha were then ruled by Bres, a half-Fomorian tyrant, whose oppressive reign lasted seven years before the Dagda led a rebellion to depose him. The Dagda assumed the throne, becoming the new king of the Tuatha de Danaan. However, his rule was not without challenges. His eldest son, Bodb Derg, believing himself to be a more capable leader, began plotting against him. ===Return to Otherworld=== In approximately 350 AD, the arrival of the Milesians, the ancestors of the Celts, in Ireland prompted the Dagda to relinquish the Tuatha’s earthly holdings and return with his people to the Otherworld. This decision infuriated Bodb Derg, who viewed it as a defeat and attempted to seize control of the Tuatha by force. However, Bodb Derg was defeated by his brethren and banished to Annwn, the Celtic netherworld. ===Modern Age=== ====Alliance with the Asgardians==== left|thumb|Brokering an alliance with the Asgardians In modern times, the Dagda demonstrated his diplomatic and strategic acumen during a conflict involving the Asgardians. When the Heliopolitan god of evil, Seth, threatened Asgard, the Dagda supported Leir’s decision to aid the Asgardians, despite the long-standing enmity between the Tuatha de Danaan and the Norse gods. The Dagda deployed Tír na nÓg’s greatest warriors, led by Leir and Caber, to defend Asgard against Seth’s forces. While he initially remained in Otherworld to oversee battle strategy, the Dagda eventually traveled to Asgard to mediate a dispute between Leir and the Asgardian war god Tyr. His wisdom proved crucial in convincing Leir to accept a strategic retreat, which ultimately contributed to Seth’s defeat. ====Conflict with the Fomorians==== thumb|Strategizing against the Fomorians Following the conflict with Seth, the Dagda faced further challenges when a giant troll, sent by the Fomorians, attacked a Tuatha village in Avalon. After Leir successfully repelled the attack, the Dagda cautioned against disproportionate retaliation. When Leir led a retaliatory strike into the Fomorians’ Camp, the Dagda intervened by conjuring a swarm of hornets to disperse the adversaries. When Leir questioned the Dagda about his intervention, the Dagda explained that since the Fomorian attack had caused no deaths, Leir’s disproportionate and lethal response was reckless and unwarranted. ====Rescue of Asgard==== left|thumb|Druid magic Months later, the Dagda used his magic to locate the Asgardian realm after it drifted into the Negative Zone due to the severing of the Bifrost, its anchor to Earth. At Leir’s request, the Dagda opened a mystic gateway from Otherworld to Asgard. However, when Leir impulsively announced his intention to claim the Asgardian warrior Sif as his bride, the Dagda was unable to close the gateway in time to prevent Leir’s departure. Caber followed Leir to Asgard to ensure his actions did not provoke a war with the Asgardians. ====Conflict with the Manchester Gods==== thumb|The Dagda and other rulers of Otherworld The Dagda’s leadership was further tested during the conflict with the Manchester Gods, industrial entities that sought to transform Otherworld into a parliamentary democracy. An informal summit was held between Master Wilson of the Manchester Gods and the rulers of Otherworld, including the Dagda
