This decision infuriated Bodb Derg, who viewed it as a defeat and attempted to seize control of the Tuatha by force. However, Bodb Derg was defeated by his brethren and banished to Annwn, the Celtic netherworld. ===Modern Age=== ====Alliance with the Asgardians==== left|thumb|Brokering an alliance with the Asgardians In modern times, the Dagda demonstrated his diplomatic and strategic acumen during a conflict involving the Asgardians. When the Heliopolitan god of evil, Seth, threatened Asgard, the Dagda supported Leir’s decision to aid the Asgardians, despite the long-standing enmity between the Tuatha de Danaan and the Norse gods. The Dagda deployed Tír na nÓg’s greatest warriors, led by Leir and Caber, to defend Asgard against Seth’s forces. While he initially remained in Otherworld to oversee battle strategy, the Dagda eventually traveled to Asgard to mediate a dispute between Leir and the Asgardian war god Tyr. His wisdom proved crucial in convincing Leir to accept a strategic retreat, which ultimately contributed to Seth’s defeat. ====Conflict with the Fomorians==== thumb|Strategizing against the Fomorians Following the conflict with Seth, the Dagda faced further challenges when a giant troll, sent by the Fomorians, attacked a Tuatha village in Avalon. After Leir successfully repelled the attack, the Dagda cautioned against disproportionate retaliation. When Leir led a retaliatory strike into the Fomorians’ Camp, the Dagda intervened by conjuring a swarm of hornets to disperse the adversaries. When Leir questioned the Dagda about his intervention, the Dagda explained that since the Fomorian attack had caused no deaths, Leir’s disproportionate and lethal response was reckless and unwarranted. ====Rescue of Asgard==== left|thumb|Druid magic Months later, the Dagda used his magic to locate the Asgardian realm after it drifted into the Negative Zone due to the severing of the Bifrost, its anchor to Earth. At Leir’s request, the Dagda opened a mystic gateway from Otherworld to Asgard. However, when Leir impulsively announced his intention to claim the Asgardian warrior Sif as his bride, the Dagda was unable to close the gateway in time to prevent Leir’s departure. Caber followed Leir to Asgard to ensure his actions did not provoke a war with the Asgardians. ====Conflict with the Manchester Gods==== thumb|The Dagda and other rulers of Otherworld The Dagda’s leadership was further tested during the conflict with the Manchester Gods, industrial entities that sought to transform Otherworld into a parliamentary democracy. An informal summit was held between Master Wilson of the Manchester Gods and the rulers of Otherworld, including the Dagda

eoffren.name: Eoffren
eoffren.origin: Eoffren was a dwarf of Nidavellir, and one of the realm's most accomplished craftsmen. His ability to give physical form to magic was said to be legendary. Because of his reputation, Eoffren was abducted by the Majesdanian thaumaturge Roxnor to build a world-destroying weapon. When Doctor Strange learned of Eoffren's predicament, he rallied his ally Kanna to rescue him. Strange and Kanna managed to inflitrate Eoffren's workshop and slipped away from Roxnor. During their escape, they were cornered on a cliff. Strange grabbed Kanna and Eoffren and lept into the void. He summoned his Cloak of Levitation to stop the fall, but instead of escaping, he opted to retaliate against Roxnor and his subjects. However, Strange and his allies were overpowered. Kanna used a technowand to teleport Doctor Strange and Eoffren to safety, leaving her behind. Strange and Eoffren appeared in a planet they couldn't identify. Scared by Strange's fit of rage when he confronted the Majesdanians, Eofrren tried to run away. Strange explained himself, but Eoffren called him out on his arrogancy and recklessness. Eoffren agreed to take Stephen to his forge to teach him how to make magical tools of his own to save Kanna.

epeius.name: Epeius
epeius.origin: Epeius was the son of Panopeus. He was one of the warriors who sailed to Troy to help Menelaus retrieve his wife Helen who had been taken by Troy king Priam's son Paris. One night of the last year of war, Athena came to him in his dreams, urging him and the Argives to fashion a great and massive horse from wood, then burn their tents and sail away to Tenedos. While Epeius didn't understood the meaning of the divine orders, Odysseus, helped by Loki, devised that the horse should be hollow, allowing warriors to hide in it, wait for them to come out once the Trojans would have brought it inside the walls of Troy. Epeius was among the Achaean soldiers to hide in the wooden horse, drawing the ladder up and locking the trapdoor once the soldiers had all entered the horse.

ephraim soles.name: Ephraim Soles
ephraim soles.origin: Ephraim Soles was a prospector, scavenger and occasional thief who made his living in the deserts of New Mexico. At one point, Ephraim entered the grounds of an abandoned military base and located plant life within the base and used it to cook his meal. He was not aware the grounds had been used to test gamma-bombs. He He later reached the Defenders' headquarters at Elijah, New Mexico. The Defenders took him in and offered him clothes and a place to spend the night. He was within the headquarters when the radioactive plants he had eaten earlier resulted in a great transformation that mutated into a plant-like gamma creature. Theorizing the plant creature needed moisture to survive, Iceman used his powers to remove all available moisture from the vicinity of Ephraim, causing him finally collapse and die. Some time later, spores left over from the creature were blown away by the wind, resulting in new mutations. Some of the spores infected alfalfa sprouts that were later eaten by Chris Larmouth, who worked at the Defenders Mansion, was infected. He was engulfed in mutated plant tendrils. The mutation was halted with Iceman froze Larmouth in ice. Other spores began spreading and engulfing everything in their path. It wasn't long before they transformed into a massive green blob with no apparent weaknesses. Beast eventually realized radiation was the culprit after studying Larmouth. The blob was eventually destroyed when Gargoyle zapped them with bio-electricity. An unknown amount of spores were able to enter Moondragon during their previous encounter. These spores gradually supplanted the cells of her digestive and circulatory systems as well as her heart and lungs. It was in this moment that she accepted the offer of the Dragon of the Moon, which cured her of the spores while also resulting in her possession. Larmouth was kept frozen to prevent the spores from taking over his body until he was cured by Moondragon using the power of the Beyonder.
weaknesses: In his monster form, Ephraim had an extreme aversion to heat.

epiccrimez.name: EpicCrimez
epiccrimez.origin: EpicCrimez was a burglar who live-streamed his antics. During one of his crimes, he was confronted by Squirrel Girl and her allies. He tried to escape but was restrained by Chipmunk Hunk. In retaliation for his capture, EpicCrimez pulled out an alien gun he had salvaged from a crashed UFO and fired it at Squirrel Girl and Nancy Whitehead, sending them into hyper-time. EpicCrimez was then taken to the authorities by Chipmunk Hunk, Koi Boi, and Brain Drain. When criminal mastermind Melissa Morbeck exposed Squirrel Girl's secret identity of Doreen Green, EpicCrimez was one of the villains assembled by Swarm to attack her at Empire State University. The fight ended when Doreen convinced the villains that attempting to attack her at her lowest was not the best course of action since she would only be motivated to beat them up harder. As a result, the rest of the criminals walked away on Swarm and his revenge attempt.

epicure.name: Epicure
epicure.origin: The Epicure was a master thief who was active during the 1940s. His motivations was not for stealing as much as possible, but stealing rare objects specifically for the thrill of stealing. In the spring of 1945, after reading the latest exploits of the Angel, the Epicure decided that he wished to match wits with the hero. Calling the Angel from a payphone, he informed the hero that he intended to rob the Van Puy mansion the following afternoon. Sure enough, the Epicure was committing the daring daylight robbery and the Angel attempted to stop him. Alerted to the Angel's presence thanks to the reflective surface of his cane, the Epicure turned and faced the hero catching him off guard long enough for one of the Epicure's men (hiding in a suit of armor on the property) to knock the hero out. The Epicure then cracked the Van Puy safe and took only a rare pearl. He then tied the Angel to a chair and left a cryptic note of his next robbery. The Epicure then led a group of men in breaking into the local art museum to steal a gold sculpture of a peacock. The Angel cracked the clue left behind at the previous crime scene and confronted the Epicure at the museum. The villain managed to once more knock out the Angel. In order to try and lose the hero, the Epicure tossed his cane out a window to the ground below to make it appear he fled on foot. However, when the Angel came around he saw through this and caught the Epicure and his men trying to escape from the roof. As the Angel was busy battling the Epicure's men, the Epicure managed to escape alone. Later in his study, the Epicure considered the Angel a worthy foe and looked forward to clashing with the hero in the future. Any later clashed between the Angel and Epicure have been unrecorded and his fate is unknown.
powers: None

era.name: Era
era.origin: Era is a Cosmic Being who was spawned by Eon sometime before the 21st century. At some point before or during the "War of the Worlds" initiated by the Martian invasion of Earth, Era secretly killed his mother and thereby confined her to the White Room with the Protectors of the Universe that she had appointed. Since nobody knew that Eon had died, Era was able to assume her identity and cosmic station. Era soon disposed of Quasar (Wendell Vaughn) by secretly redirecting his final quantum-leap to the Abrogate who mistook Quasar's sudden appearance as an attack and retaliated, killing him. Back on Earth, "Eon" convinced the Silver Surfer to stop fighting the Martians by claiming that it was Earth's destiny to be conquered by them. "Eon" also asked the Silver Surfer to be the new Protector of the Universe but the Surfer's guilt-plagued conscience did not allow him to accept until centuries later. Months later, "Eon" appeared on the planet Vesper only seconds after Kismet had given birth to her and Wendell's son, and kidnapped the infant. Five hundred years later, in the early 26th century, "Eon" arranged for the Silver Surfer to go to Earth and meet Dargo, a mortal who possessed the power of Thor, so that the two of them, by working together, would kill Nova. In 3018 AD, when Norrin Radd, now known as the Keeper, was about to kill Galactus, "Eon" convinced him not to do so and to allow Galactus to consume Arima. "Eon" then convinced the Keeper that he should partner with Galactus and guide him to consume worlds that had no sentient inhabitants. In 3019 A.D., during a confrontation with Starhawk (Stakar) and Kismet, Era revealed his true identity, the fate of his mother, and how he had posed as "Eon" for over a millennium while he had manipulated Norrin Radd, caused the death of Quasar, and kidnapped the infant Stakar. Finding that the combined power of the united mother and son was more than he had expected, Era stated that the tedious combat served no purpose and teleported away. Second later, the Hawk God appeared and revealed that he had empowered Stakar so that he could stop Era who was trying to bring about the prophesied War of the Cosmic Beings, something that the Hawk God had been accused of plotting.

ereshkigal deviant.origin: A Deviant who frequently posed as the Mesopotamian goddess of the underworld Ereshkigal, she was an extra-dimensional explorer like her mother and her mother before her. During her travels, she became aware of the hierarchy of the Multiverse and developed an inferiority complex over being bound by the rules set down by the abstract beings like Eternity and the Living Tribunal. She began a lifelong search for sources of power that would help her break free from these restrictions. When the Celestials' Fourth Host came to Earth, Ereshkigal posed as a human named Lisa and boarded a flight bound to pass by their temple in the Andes. As expected, her plane was captured by Gammenon the Gatherer and brought inside the Celestial's dome. Revealing herself, Ereshkigal got into conflict with several factions, including a secret agent from S.H.I.E.L.D., Ajak the Eternal, and Thor. Sometime later, Ereshkigal posed as the woman H.D. Steckley, taking advantage of the identity after it was abandoned by Moondragon. She worked in Quasar's private firm to monitor his Quantum Bands, but soon realized the greater power was connected to his girlfriend and secretary Kayla Ballantine, and the Star Brand she unknowingly possessed. While looking for an opportunity to steal Kayla's power, "Holly" and Kayla got into numerous misadventures on alien worlds. When Kayla had finally had enough extraterrestrial nonsense, Holly took advantage of her weakness and pressed Kayla to pass the Star Brand to her. Now in possession of a power from beyond the Multiverse, Ereshkigal planned to impose her will on all of reality by tilting the axis of power. She entered the Nexus of All Realities in the Everglades and confronted the Living Tribunal, Master Order, and Lord Chaos with her plans. Quasar and the Silver Surfer found their way into the Nexus as well, and so Ereshkigal and the Tribunal agreed to use pawns to decide the Multiverse's fate. Quasar and the Surfer were each imprinted with the idea that they must fight to the death to preserve the Multiverse. Ultimately, however, Quasar recognized that he was actually Ereshkigal's champion and threw the fight. Ereshkigal apparently self-imploded rather than abide by the bargain and turn the Star Brand over to the Living Tribunal. Ereshkigal eventually returned to life through unknown means. She learned that her fellow Deviants were in a serious crisis: they were no longer giving birth and much of the male population was impotent, leaving the future of the Deviants uncertain. There was several power struggles for leadership breaking out. Ereshkigal saw this as an opportunity to win the favor and control of her people during this time of crisis. To do this, she sought a power to replace the Star Brand she formerly possessed. She took her search to the ruins of Asgard where she sought powers and artifacts. This attracted the attention of the thunder god Thor. Thor was forced to protect Ereshkigal after she triggered Asgardian mystic defensive systems. With Thor preoccupied, Ereshkigal was able to steal a mysterious and small orb-like device, which turned out to be the Unbinding Stone of Oshemar. Ignorant of its true destructive nature, Ereshkigal attempted to use it to earn the support of fellow Deviants. When she was unable to get the device to work, the Deviants gave their support to Kro instead of her. Dejected, she retreated to try and unlock the secrets of her stolen device. Approached by Kro who triggered its power, a deadly consuming destructive force was unleashed that threatened to consume the entire universe. Eventually, the destructive force was halted by the efforts of Thor and the Eternal Phastos. Ereshkigal's current whereabouts and fate are unknown.

ergon.name: Ergon
ergon.origin: ===Borna's rule=== During the Age of Kull (circa 18,500 BC), Baron Ergon was a Valusian noble native of Kamula. Ergon either visited or lived in the City of Wonders, capital of Valusia, where he assisted to gladiatorial games. To test his mettle, King Borna sent to the Northern Shore, to serve as commander of a coastal fort and high commander of this coast. Captain Murom considered that this assignment was possibly proof that Borna intended to appoint Ergon as the next "Baron of the Northern Shores". Ergon was quite displeased by his posting there, despite being allowed to name the wooden fort after him, Fort Ergon, missing his native Kamula, the only place in the North that Ergon wanted to be, and the City of Wonders, particularity the gladiatorial games. After two Atlanteans, Khor-Nah and young Kull, were washed ashore on the northern coast of Valusia, they were captured by Captain Muro, who decided to bring them back to Fort Ergon to be questioned by the commander. Kull fought Sergeant Rendel on the way home. As Rendel wished to take revenge by having Kull tortured, Murom refrained this idea, mentioning the Atlanteans would become unfit for the arena in the City of Wonders. This gave Ergon the idea of setting up an arena at Fort Ergon. Baron Ergon had Kull and Khor-Nah into a muddy back-country arena, but the pair of Atlanteans managed to escape. Ergon eventually became Baron of the Northern Shore. and moved to rule from Kamula. ===Kull's rule=== During Kull's rule, Ergon and his court, including the dancing girl Zareta and Taligaro the poet, were hosted at the Palace in Kamula (either Prince Mandara's or Ergon's). The giant slug-like creature known as Zugthuu the Slitherer was held in the undergrounds of the palace, where the decadent court (including Zareta, Taligaro, and seemingly all the lords and nobles, presumably including Prince Mandara) held twisted rites as part of their worship of the worm-demon. On a visit of King Kull, accompanied by Brule and a few Picts, the delegation was received by Ergon. If either Kull and Ergon recalled their first encounter years ago, neither mentioned the subject. After Ergon retired from Kull's presence, he went on to hold another, more decadent ceremony, snatching one of the Picts, Grogar, for the ceremony. Kull interrupted the rite, slaughtering his hosts, including Ergon . He then attacked the sluggish creature. While slashing it in vain, Kull recognized in its eyes a pain originated from the sadness of an intelligent mind locked in a primeval form. He stopped and instead set the monster aflame, as an act of inspiration or compassion. Before fleeing with Grogar, Kull saw gratitude in the eyes of the creature. ==Religion== Ergon secretly worshiped the worm-demon known as Zugthuu the Slitherer.

eric barlow.name: Eric Barlow
eric barlow.origin: Eric was always directionless in his life, and abusive towards his younger brother Bennet. Despite graduating with honors from college, Eric still lacked direction. He decided to use his advanced knowledge to build a Cobalt Cannon, and promised a group of mercenaries that he hired that they could use the cannon to hold the New York City hostage and acquire great wealth. When he refused to surrender, he was shot and killed by Bennet.
weapons: Damocles used a variety of high-tech weapons, including his airship, the Cobalt Cannon, the Destruct-Drone, and a hand-held energy blaster.

eric bondi.name: Eric Bondi
eric bondi.origin: Officer Bondi was involved in an affair with his partner, Brooke Douglas, when they witnessed an explosion on the waterfront. When they went to investigate, they startled The Hood, who accidentally shot Eric in the neck. Eric went into a coma and later died. His wife Elizabeth took his death very hard, making it her personal goal to find The Hood and make him pay.

eric brooks doppelganger.name: Eric Brooks (Doppelganger)
eric brooks doppelganger.origin: The Doppelganger is a clone of the vampire hunter Blade, he was created; by Deacon Frost. When Blade and Hannibal King resumed their search for Frost, their trail lead them to yet another apartment. Hannibal suggested they enter quietly; but Blade would have none of that; and decided to kick down the front door and burst in; with wood knives drawn. He was in for the shock of a lifetime when he found that the stories of Frost having a doppelganger of Blade were true, and worse this doppelganger was also a vampire. Face to face at last, the vampire doppelganger told Blade that they would fight to the finish and that it will succeed in destroying Blade. Blade fought his vampire doppelganger, and was shocked to find that the two were beginning to fuse together on physical contact. Hannibal King tried to rush to Blade's rescue, however he was too late to stop the merging from completing, with the vampire doppelganger in full control of their unified body. The Doppelganger attacked Hannibal King and despite his savage fury, he was easily fought off; by King; who had stabbed the faux-Blade in the chest; with one of his own wooden daggers, sending the imitator out a window allowing Hannibal to escape. Hannibal King, still fleeing from the vampire doppelganger of Blade, crashed; into Dracula's party. Deacon Frost was among the crowd and watched eagerly as this was all part of his ongoing plan. Furious at Blade's interruption of his party Dracula attacked and was shocked to find his long time vampire hunter foe was now a vampire himself. Blade appeared to have the upper hand; when he had stabbed Dracula in the back; with one of his wooden daggers. But Dracula turned around and mocking the fake Blade's inferior skill to the original, impaled the vampire doppelganger in the chest; with a stake (apparently) killing him.
weaknesses: Fusing with Blade Prime would be a shocking and painful experience for both Blades.

eric cameron.name: Eric Cameron
eric cameron.origin: Cameron attempted to free himself of his weak and sickly body by means of a stolen S.H.I.E.L.D. Master Matrix used to create android human facsimiles (LMDs). When the Matrix overloaded, Cameron was scarred and deformed rather than refashioned into a paragon of virile beauty as he had expected, hence the ironic alias, Adonis. He ran away from the lab and hid in a swamp until the police found him. He killed the cops and started terrorizing civilians, which led Captain America into confronting him at a construction site. When they fought, Captain America knocked him into a construction vehicle, which fell into a lake and electrocuted him.

eric close.origin: Eric Close was the senior vice president of public relations for Roxxon Oil who was addressing the UN about environmental concerns when the Mole Man attacked demanding that Roxxon clean up the oil spilled onto Monster Isle. After Mole Man was defeated by the Fantastic Four he tried to trick the group into becoming spokespeople for Roxxon but Reed turned it around and made Eric agree to the clean-up request.

eric cross.name: Eric Cross
eric cross.origin: Eric Cross was a fellow partner of Hobie Brown at the enterprise they worked on. At some point of his life, Eric had a daughter who was killed during a gunfight. He decided to get revenge on the criminals so no more innocent lives would be put at risk, so he took some technology from the enterprise he was working on and made his own suit calling himself; the Nightcreeper. During his first appearance as a vigilante, Eric was mistaken for the Prowler, who, in an attempt to prove his innocence, chased him to bring him to justice. thumb|left|302px|Nightcreeper meets the Prowler! After a few fights, the two heroes discovered they were on the same side, but when they teamed-up to defeat a bunch of thugs Eric lost control and would have killed them if it wasn't for the Prowler. Some innocents were murdered that night and Eric couldn't forgive himself. Nightcreeper got into a fight with The Vulture, and almost died. He later escaped from the hospital and tried to help Hobie to catch the villain, but he was unsuccessful. It's unknown if Eric is still using the identity of the Nightcreeper.
weapons: The Prowler uses a costume equipped with specially-designed high-tech weapons based on pneumatic technology. Gauntlets that shoot an assortment of projectiles
Sleeping gas pellets, cleaning fluid, steel darts, gas canisters capable of producing a damaging compressed air blast, and magnesium flares. The gauntlets are also tipped with steel claws.

eric gruning.name: Eric Gruning
eric gruning.origin: Eric Gruning was a member of the Exiles, a criminal group of international would-be world conquerors, who were allies of the Red Skull during World War II, as well as in the modern age. Gruning and the rest of the Exiles were later a part of a plot to ambush Captain America, Sharon Carter, Maria Hill, and Victoria Hand. However, they managed to evade them and escaped from the castle and took cover outside the castle while shooting at the Exiles. However, Quake, unaware of other agents being on the field used her powers and seemingly crushed the Exiles when the castle collapsed on top of them.

eric kane.origin: Eric Kane was a convicted criminal serving time in an African prison camp. He faked sickness and was able to knock back the guard and escape into the jungle where he discovered a cave behind a waterfall. The cave descended downwards until Eric discovered the Lizard Man and a giant diamond. They greeted him with hospitality but he tried to steal the diamond. Before he could escape the cave, the diamond transformed him into a Lizard Man, forcing him to live with the other Lizard Men but due to his attempted robbery he was an exile from them too.

eric karlin.name: Eric Karlin
eric karlin.origin: Doctor Eric Karlin was a Nazi scientist that was active during World War II. In 1942, he was dispatched to America to eliminate primary American citizens and also attempt to steal Nazi funds that were frozen in American banks following the outbreak of the war. Using his hypnotic ability, Karlin amassed an army of slaves that brought his enemies to him so that he could dump them in a vat of acid. The sadistic doctor then gathered up the remains of his victims and kept them in jars as trophies. When he was ready to break into the Federal Reserve Bank that held the locked Nazi funds, he stashed the bodies at the museum next door, replacing the bodies of recently recovered ancient Mongolian Aboriginals that were to be cast in plaster and put on display. Unfortunately for Dr. Karlin, this museum was the work place for Elton Morrow who was secretly the costumed hero known as the Blue Diamond. When his minions rose up from the slab and broke into the Federal Reserve, Morrow stopped them. Learning of Karlin's involvement, the Blue Diamond confronted Eric at his lab, and in their struggle against each other, Karlin ended up falling into the same vat of acid that claimed so many of his victims.
weapons: Karlin was armed with a tommy gun, and he utilized a vat of acid to eliminate his enemies.

eric kesselwolfe.name: Eric Kesselwolfe
eric kesselwolfe.origin: Eric Kesselwolfe was a German citizen who was a Prussian loyalist. After the Nazis' rise to power, he was forced to join their military to spare his life as he had no love for their ideals. During World War II, he was sent to Belgium to assist in the take over of the country. During his time as a Nazi, he murdered the parents of Louis Remiens a Belgium resistance fighter, who vowed to get revenge against Kesselwolfe. Following the Nazis defeat in 1945, Kesselwolfe fled to Brazil like many Nazis during the time and started up a spy network under the alias of Mr. M. A German scientist named Hans Ludwig, an associate of Kesselwolfe had alternatively fled to New York and was granted asylum as a refugee. Ludwig had invented a powerful sun-ray and hired Mary Varnheim to transport it to Brazil to Kesselwolfe so that the former Nazi could take over the world and instill his Prussian ideals on the world. However, Varnhiem sought to double-cross Kesselwolfe and sell the formula to the highest bidder. After much misadventures and interference from government agent Miss America, a spy named James Ilse was able to bring the formula to Kesselwolfe. However, the exchange was interrupted not only by the arrival of Miss America, but rival Nazi war criminal Rex Herr and American espionage agents. Outnumbered, Kesselwolfe and the other spies were all apprehended and the formula recovered by the American government. As he was being led away by the authorities, Kesselwolfe and Herr clashed over their differing ideas of the "perfect" German. Kesselwolfe's subsequent fate is unknown.

eric lund.name: Eric Lund
eric lund.origin: Eric Lund invented a wrist-worn thought communicator thinking that it would replace the telephone, but his invention was always rejected because they did not believe in its value, especially Eric annoyed the financier Lloyd Baldwin who considered his invention a toy. Furious at being treated in such a way, Eric began to use his invention to earn money illicitly, initially by having a jewelry store robbed by those who worked inside and then taking it himself, but since it worked he decided to take revenge on Baldwin by having him rob an apartment and then reporting it to the police, but the apartment that Baldwin robbed was Eric's and having recognized Lund's thought communicator, he went to the police who used it on Lund himself making him confess what he had done and thus ending up being arrested himself.

eric lynch.name: Eric Lynch
eric lynch.origin: Eric Lynch was a member of Stark Industries' Board of Directors and one of the company's major shareholders. Although he actually never once had a creative thought, Lynch apparently talked his way onto the company's corporate board, eventually becoming its Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. Following a month of Tony Stark's disappearance when he faked his own death in order to investigate a new villain, Lynch questioned his assistant Friday on whether Stark was truly dead or not in order to take the appropiate legal course of action. He stormed out of Stark Industries when Friday refused to answer. When the board decided to shut down Friday and take control of the company, Lynch hired the Ghost to break into Stark's private lab and overide the secure servers. Their plan was interrupted by Mary Jane Watson, who had assumed the role of executive administrator at Friday's request, and managed to appease Lynch, telling him that Stark was simply on a work retreat. Tony Stark eventually returned, and Lynch and the board confronted him about his antics. Stark irreverently replied to Lynch's retors, prompting Lynch to threaten Stark before leaving. After Stark fell into a coma in the end of the second superhero civil war, Lynch tried to seize control of the company and become its President. He was infuriated when Friday and Mary Jane Watson notified him that the new President was to be Stark's newly-found biological mother, Amanda Armstrong. Lynch confronted Armstrong, and became perplexed when he found out she was world-famous musician Amanda Strong. Strong proceeded to gently yet firmly establish dominance as she removed Lynch out of her sight. Right when Amanda was inaugurating the Stark Expo, Lynch disclosed to MJ Watson that the board had voted to remove Amanda from the position of President, on the grounds that she was supposedly mismanaging the company. Following the disappearance of Tony Stark's comatose body, Lynch led the take-over of the company, sending mercenaries after the armor of Stark's protégé Ironheart, and nominating himself to become the new director of the company. Not long afterwards, Lynch was approached by rising crime boss The Hood, who believed there was a connection between Tony Stark's disappearance and the heroic endeavours of Victor von Doom, who had taken up the mantle of Iron Man. Before The Hood could coerce Lynch into handing him over his share of the company, Robbins and his criminal army were attacked by an army of Doombots commanded by Doom, as well as the recently-resurfaced Tony Stark and War Machine. Lynch apologized to Stark for trying to take over the company, and swore to leave the company.

eric marshall.name: Eric Marshall
eric marshall.origin: An employee of the National Security Agency, Eric Marshall was working security at a Press Corps Christmas party when he hit on Sally Floyd, a reporter. He didn't tell her he had a wife and three kids. When a large explosion went off in Stamford, CT, killing hundreds, the government decided to push the Superhuman Registration Act (SHRA). One of the perpetrators, Speedball, was found alive in Stockton, New York, and Eric Marshall was sent to arrest him, after the doctors, including John, called for help. Marshall introduced himself to the just awakening Speedball, who was still in a hospital bed, as a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent working with the NSA in apprehending unregistered heroes. He explained that Speedball was the only survivor from Stamford, reported the total number of casualties, that Speedball had seemingly lost his powers and was under arrest. Days later, Marshall approached Speedball, who was demanding a lawyer. He offered Speedball a chance to register willingly with the government and be forgiven his crimes, but Speedball refused. Eric Marshall furiously stormed the Alternative newspaper with armed guards in order to gain information on sources from reporter Sally Floyd. Her editor Neil Crawfod and she refused to cooperate, so he placed them both under arrest. Marshall angrily questioned Sally behind a mirror and stormed in when she aggravated him. She got under his skin with details about his personal life, and offered her a deal when Mister Fantastic instructed him to do so.
abilities: S.H.I.E.L.D. Member Eric Marshall has been trained as a National Security Agent and S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.

eric morrell.name: Eric Morrell
eric morrell.origin: Eric Morrell was the sheriff of Doverton Colorado where he lived with his wife and children. The town was taken hostage and occupied by Carnage and they were trapped in the town. Eric managed to escape to a nearby zoo and contacted the Avengers, who sent Captain America, The Thing, Hawkeye, Wolverine, and Spider-Man to capture Carnage. They attempted to attack Carnage; however, Carnage simply bonded to Captain America, Thing, Hawkeye and Wolverine and possessed them. The U.S Army realized they needed other Symbiotes to fight Carnage and sent the Mercury Team to aid Eric and Spider-Man. The ensuing battle resulted in a majority of the town being destroyed, and as a result, Eric's family was killed. After the tragedy, he quit his job as sheriff. Years later, the graves of the casualties of Carnage's attack were all dug up by unknown trespassers, including the graves of his family. Eric contacted the higher officials and Man-Wolf was sent to help him investigate. They suspected a cult that recently arrived to the town, The Cult of Knull. When they interrogated their leader, she invited them to join one of their rituals. When they went there, John was unable to prevent Eric from being bonded to an offshoot of the Dark Carnage symbiote, before being himself bonded to one and forced to become a sleeper agent for the Cult. Eric, now under the sway of Knull, put up no resistance as his spine was removed so his codex could be fed to Carnage.

eric ostergan.name: Eric Ostergan
eric ostergan.origin: Eric Ostergan was a doctor and a member in the Anti-Hitler underground. Eric and his fellow members managed to break Hitler's code and deciphered certain documents, in which one of them, Hitler mentioned the invasion of Poland in the following day. In panic, Ostergan fled and warned the people of Poland, including the deported sergeant John Kowalski who didn't take his advice seriously. After the invasion turned out to be real, Ostergan was hit by a plane, after he contacted the government in Warsaw, and died after he told Kowalski how much he despised him for letting the invasion happen.

eric paulson.name: Eric Paulson
eric paulson.origin: Global economist Eric Paulson wanted to solve humanity's problems like war and disease, years of research made him insane and led him to the conclusion that overpopulation was the problem and if it wasn't solved soon humanity would suffer. To this end, he created the P.R.I.D.E., a system that utilized a new energy type his scientists discovered, they used said energy to transport their field crew between different places to steal Roxxon's Technafoil and the Windstone, these materials were necessary to create the P.R.I.D.E. Generator, a machine to transport all world capitals into other habitable dimensions. He managed to turn on the machine but was stopped by the quick thinking of Spider-Man and Captain Marvel, though Rambeau was trapped in her energy form. Spider-Man considered asking Paulson for help but he had become completely insane by that point.

eric payne.name: Eric Payne
eric payne.species: Human trained by the Devil Cult to develop abilities
eric payne.origin: ===Early Life=== Eric Payne grew up in Queenstown, Illinois, with a drunken father and a quiet mother, filling his time with books, violence, petty crimes, and fleeting relationships. As a boy, he had strong faith in God, finding solace in belief, but his convictions waned over time. His closest friend was Brian Kingston, and the two enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corp together. Payne possessed a mysterious sixth sense that warned him of danger. He later married Cory Payne, an African American nurse, and the couple settled in an apartment on Foster Avenue in Brooklyn, frequently visiting Grandma's Bar. During his service in the Vietnam War, Payne faced harrowing moral dilemmas, witnessing the deaths of countless civilians. One of his fellow soldiers, Colonel McCloskey, massacred a village without reason, and Payne's attempt to have him court-martialed failed. Brian returned from the war with a prosthetic leg, eventually marrying and starting a family.Payne attended the baptism of Kingston's son, Brian Jr.. Back home, Payne struggled to reintegrate, feeling disconnected from his country. He and Cory tried to rebuild their marriage, but they had grown apart. She left him for another man, and they divorced, sending Payne into years of alcoholism. Desperate for work, he sought out mobster Carlo Boccino, who hired him as a hitman. Payne quickly gained a reputation, justifying his actions by telling himself he was only killing criminals. However, he planted a car bomb meant for Ian Fate, only to later learn Fate was a newspaper reporter, and the explosion had killed an innocent woman and child. Realising he had been deceived, Payne abandoned his life as a hitman, burdened by guilt. ===Don't Fear the Reaper=== Payne was recruited by the Cult of Harvester of Eyes as a Reaper of Souls and an Agent of Death. Over time, he embraced their cause, refining his telepathic abilities and gaining the Shadow Cloaks. He was also shown the Cult's secret sanctuary. However, he later uncovered their true purpose, a scheme to resurrect a long-dead race of demons and seize control of Earth. Feeling betrayed, he abandoned them. After a drastic event in Jamaica, he went on the run, vowing to stop the demons return. Seeking closure, he traveled to New York City to find Cory. At John F. Kennedy International Airport, Payne, using telepathic illusion to conceal his costume, remained on edge, expecting an ambush from the Cult. Briefly losing focus, he allowed a bystander to glimpse his outfit but quickly corrected the mistake. Taking a taxi to New Grace Hospital, where Cory worked, he sensed a hostile presence Deathlok. Mistaking him for a Cult assassin, Payne attacked, using telepathy to jam Deathlok's gun. Deathlok retaliated, knocking him through a wall, but Payne countered with his cloak. When hospital staff intervened, he used his powers to scare them off before teleporting away, daring Deathlok to follow. Retreating to another dimension, Payne prepared for battle, but when Deathlok stayed behind, he looked back to see Cory unconscious in Deathlok's arms. Enraged, he dragged Deathlok into the dimension and attacked with an anti-matter mace. Eventually, they realized they were on the same side and returned to Earth, where they found Cory under attack by Cult demons. Payne drew a demon-slaying blade from his cloak, driving them off. Thanking Deathlok, he took the wounded Cory and vanished. ===The Defenders=== After believing the Cult's threat was over, Payne tried to reconcile with Cory, but their lives had drifted apart. She left for Europe, eventually following David Kessler in Israel, who claimed to be the "Messiah". When Doctor Strange warned Payne of the Six-Fingered Hand, Payne suspected Kessler was involved and sought the Defenders' help. The team traveled to Israel, where Kessler performed miraculous healings. Cory was glad to see Payne until she realised he was there to stop Kessler. When Kessler exposed Gargoyle and Son of Satan's true forms and summoned demons disguised as angels, the heroes fought back. Strange revealed Kessler was possessed by the demon Hyppokri, who attacked Cory. Kessler regained control and sacrificed himself on Payne's blade. Cory, still devoted to Kessler's ideals, chose to stay. The Defenders then joined the Avengers to investigate Hand activity in Citrusville, Florida. Discovering the town trapped in the Nexus of Realities, they fought Unnthinnk, a demon possessing Man-Thing, and later breached the Hand's dimension, rescuing several heroes. The villains challenged the heroes to contests to decide Earth's fate. Payne, haunted by his past in Vietnam, was overwhelmed by guilt but survived the illusions. The team combined their power to force the demons to retreat and restore the world. After the battle, Payne wandered the streets, struggling with his purpose. However, he planted a car bomb meant for Ian Fate, only to later learn Fate was a newspaper reporter, and the explosion had killed an innocent woman and child. Realising he had been deceived, Payne abandoned his life as a hitman, burdened by guilt. ===Don't Fear the Reaper=== Payne was recruited by the Cult of Harvester of Eyes as a Reaper of Souls and an Agent of Death. Over time, he embraced their cause, refining his telepathic abilities and gaining the Shadow Cloaks. He was also shown the Cult's secret sanctuary. However, he later uncovered their true purpose, a scheme to resurrect a long-dead race of demons and seize control of Earth. Feeling betrayed, he abandoned them. After a drastic event in Jamaica, he went on the run, vowing to stop the demons return. Seeking closure, he traveled to New York City to find Cory. At John F. Kennedy International Airport, Payne, using telepathic illusion to conceal his costume, remained on edge, expecting an ambush from the Cult. Briefly losing focus, he allowed a bystander to glimpse his outfit but quickly corrected the mistake. Taking a taxi to New Grace Hospital, where Cory worked, he sensed a hostile presence Deathlok. Mistaking him for a Cult assassin, Payne attacked, using telepathy to jam Deathlok's gun. Deathlok retaliated, knocking him through a wall, but Payne countered with his cloak. When hospital staff intervened, he used his powers to scare them off before teleporting away, daring Deathlok to follow. Retreating to another dimension, Payne prepared for battle, but when Deathlok stayed behind, he looked back to see Cory unconscious in Deathlok's arms. Enraged, he dragged Deathlok into the dimension and attacked with an anti-matter mace. Eventually, they realized they were on the same side and returned to Earth, where they found Cory under attack by Cult demons. Payne drew a demon-slaying blade from his cloak, driving them off. Thanking Deathlok, he took the wounded Cory and vanished. ===The Defenders=== After believing the Cult's threat was over, Payne tried to reconcile with Cory, but their lives had drifted apart. She left for Europe, eventually following David Kessler in Israel, who claimed to be the "Messiah". When Doctor Strange warned Payne of the Six-Fingered Hand, Payne suspected Kessler was involved and sought the Defenders' help. The team traveled to Israel, where Kessler performed miraculous healings. Cory was glad to see Payne until she realised he was there to stop Kessler. When Kessler exposed Gargoyle and Son of Satan's true forms and summoned demons disguised as angels, the heroes fought back. Strange revealed Kessler was possessed by the demon Hyppokri, who attacked Cory. Kessler regained control and sacrificed himself on Payne's blade. Cory, still devoted to Kessler's ideals, chose to stay. The Defenders then joined the Avengers to investigate Hand activity in Citrusville, Florida. Discovering the town trapped in the Nexus of Realities, they fought Unnthinnk, a demon possessing Man-Thing, and later breached the Hand's dimension, rescuing several heroes. The villains challenged the heroes to contests to decide Earth's fate. Payne, haunted by his past in Vietnam, was overwhelmed by guilt but survived the illusions. The team combined their power to force the demons to retreat and restore the world. After the battle, Payne wandered the streets, struggling with his purpose. eric schmitt.name: Eric Schmitt
eric schmitt.origin: Eric Schmitt was a German scientist who worked for Nazi Germany during World War II. Of Jewish descent, Schmitt would keep this a secret from his superiors. When Abraham Erskine defected to the Untied States, Schmitt was one of the scientists that took over trying to develop a super-soldier serum for Project: Nietzsche in Berlin. In the summer of 1941, his Jewish ancestry was discovered by the Red Skull who ordered Schmitt to be taken to a concentration camp. He placed his formula in a specially rigged beaker that required a combination to open. Opening the wrong combination would douse the formula in acid, destroying it. When Schmitt refused to give his secrets to the Nazis, he was tortured and, near death, was tossed in a cell in Strohm Prison. His cellmate was recently incarcerated American journalist Kevin Marlow who was suspected of being a spy. Dying, Schmitt gave Marlow the formula and the combination telling him to use the abilities gained from it to fight Nazi tyranny. Schmitt died, and Marlow ingested the formula having his natural abilities heightened to human perfection. He became the Destroyer and fought Nazi tyranny until the end of the war, giving Schmitt a legacy to be proud of.
abilities: Eric Schmitt was a brilliant scientist. His only known achievement was a form of the Super-Soldier Serum that would endow it's drinker with physical attributes at the peak of human perfection.

fields.notes: In his writings on the rise of super-heroes during the 1940s, the Angel would recount Eric Schmitt's fate. In his accounting of events, he states that it was Brian Falsworth under the alias of "Keen Marlow" who was given the formula by Schmitt. This accounting also states that Schmitt was gunned down by Nazi soldiers and that Falsworth fled Strohm Prison with Schmitt's body and buried him. However, this is contrary to the original account of Keen Marlow's becoming the Destroyer. It is also contrary to the original accounts of how Falsworth gained his abilities. Texts indicate that Marlow was indeed the individual who was given Schmitt's version of the formula directly by Schmitt himself. Due to the fact that there were three different individuals active as the Destroyer during World War II to sow confusion amongst the Nazis, this recounting of events was likely due to misinformation provided to Thomas Halloway at the time that he wrote his story "The ".

eric von himmel.name: Eric von Himmel
eric von himmel.origin: Eric von Himmel was a master spy, who worked for Nazi Germany in World War II. He planned to cripple American industrial centers, one by one, with the purpose of making America weak, so that Hitler can strike America, thus bringing it to Nazi Germany's side. His first target was the Wenton Aviaton Works, after they did that, they targeted the Boling Works. This failed miserably, after the Young Avenger crossed their plans, and defeated the sent saboteurs. After hearing in the news, that the saboteurs were captured, von Himmel sent two of his henchmen, Otto and Hans, to watch on the walls after the Young Avenger. One of them was defeated but the other one captured him with gas and brought him, in chains, to von Himmel. Unknownst to von him and his henchmen, Young Avenger freed himself and easily overpowered them. In shock, Eric went into a biplane and crashed into his base, killing all, expect him and the Young Avenger.

eric ward.name: Eric Ward
eric ward.origin: Eric Ward was the step-brother of Mr. Ward, one of the men in charge of the Mount Rushmore monument. Near the monument's completion in 1943, Eric -- a Nazi sympathizer, was contacted by Nazi spies and ordered to blow up the monument. He attempted to comply but was opposed by the visiting Human Torch and Toro. They were briefly opposed by Mr. Ward who wanted to protect his step-brother; however, Eric ran off to set a bomb on the massive monument. He was chased by the Human Torch who sent Eric falling to his death with the explosives falling with him. When he hit the ground the explosives went off, certainly killing him if the fall had not done so.

eric willis.origin: Eric Willis, like his son after him, was entrusted to guard the several ancient magical artifacts. One was a casket of great destructive power, another was the ring that once belonged to the dwarf Andvari, which let its owner see through all lies and illusions. Years later he became acquainted with Thor when the forces of Malekith tried to steal the casket so that they could let Surtur into the world. erica fortune.species: Natural human telekinetic, powers further amplified by magic
erica fortune.origin: Erica Fortune was a New York University teacher who discovered she possessed great telekinetic power when her boyfriend, a parapsychology professor, tested her. Soon after, she and her boyfriend came across two otherdimensional aliens who had used a pair of "power rings" to escape their servitude to a "spellbinder," Zxaxz, and had detected Fortune as another spellbinder. Zxaxz demanded his power rings back, and Fortune battled him, donning the rings herself to amplify. Fortune joined forces with the New Mutants and Lila Cheney to defeat Zxaxz. Later, a third, more powerful spellbinder, the Other, came to Earth, and Fortune joined forces with Zxaxz to battle this new threat, with the help of her brother Roy, who used the rings to amplify his own latent powers. thumb|left|Imprisoned Erica's powers drove her insane, causing her to turn on her family. She was imprisoned in a crystal by her brother Roy, who became Spellbinder Supreme.
weaknesses: Spellbinder's power has a harmful effect on her mental state, making her increasingly megalomaniacal and distant from the rest of humanity unless she resists its effects.

erich eisenhardt.name: Erich Eisenhardt
erich eisenhardt.origin: Erich Eisenhardt was the uncle of Max Eisenhardt, later known as Magneto. Erich lived with his brother, Jakob Eisenhardt and his family in Nuremberg, Germany. Erich was a carefree personality and encouraged his nephew to love, as he was known for chasing women himself. One day, Erich was beaten and forced to wear a sign saying that he had shamed a German woman, after the laws were changed that Jewish people were not to interact with other races ( ). Originally wanting to leave Germany, his brother decided for the family to stay in Nurnberg and figure-out the rules. After November 7, 1938, when assassinated the German attaché, and the Nazis started to terrorize Jewish people in the , Erich and his family fled to Warsaw, Poland. In Warsaw they lived in a Jewish section where the Nazi built in October 1940. His time at the ghetto molded Erich into a smuggler of food and supplies and gave him the courage to fight back. After the Nazis started to deport the ghetto inhabitants to , Erich told Jakob and Max that Jews were gassed there and he convinced his brother to flee. While his family was escaping, Erich stayed behind, to fight against the Nazis. His ultimate fate is unknown.

erich paine.name: Erich Paine
erich paine.origin: Dr. Erich Paine was a eugenics specialist who worked as chief gene-engineer at the mutant labor community of Genosha who specialized in controlled genetic mutations as well as psychological lobotomization, turning baseline humans (Homo sapiens) into mindless Mutates to serve as slave builders for their Utopian society. When that went bust after the X-Men tore down the fascist monarchy, Paine eventually skipped continents and came to work under the current Nigindan Government. Paying off then monarchical overlord who oversaw the nation with a huge bribe, he would go to work building an illegal lab where the run off from his lab had poisoned the local environment. This arrangement fell through however as the Nigandan Government was left in tatters as Black Panther removed its former overseer M'Butu, one pound of flesh at a time, from leadership position when the latter tried to invade Wakanda. Thus power to his unethical facility was cut releasing a great many of his mutant wildlife experiments onto the local populace, figuring the children of the atom would come for him down the line, Paine would modify himself using his own experimental practices to emulate similar powers to Anna Marie in case they showed up. In the end his suspicions proved true as the escaped lab animals began rampaging across Niganda, killing and eating many of its inhabitants. Since they were registered as mutants Cerebro lit up at the first sign of their activity but they were beaten to the punch when the Wakandan King infiltrated his facility and beat Mr. Paine senseless while combing through his personal files but Paine managed to get away at the last minute due to a misunderstanding with Storm's teammates and family, after which they went on to pursue him, Erich had ambushed them in a hallway and set them up for sale to his newest client; The Red Ghost.

erich von wolff.name: Erich Von Wolff
erich von wolff.origin: Captain Erich Von Wolff -- also known as the Barracuda -- was a Nazi U-Boat captain who was active during World War II. In 1942, he was assigned to the channels of the Atlantic Ocean and took great pleasuring in sinking civilian ships and gunning down the survivors as they attempted to flee aboard life boats. On one such occasion, he sunk an American cruise ship and ordered his men to gun down the survivors and take out their radio tower before they could call for help. His attack a success, Barracuda ordered his men to submerge and depart to find another target. Unknown to von Wolff at the time was that the slaughter was witnessed by the undersea hero known as the Fin. The Fin tracked down the Barracudas U-Boat and forced his way inside. Fighting off the crew and listening in on the captain's quarters, the Fin then overheard Von Wolff gloating over his victory. The Barracuda was laughing about how he caused a young woman and her infant child to drown in the water, taking great pleasure in the act. This admission angered the Fin, who then stormed the room and fought off Von Wolff's men. Not wishing to be captured, Von Wolff grabbed two live wires from the ship's electrical panel and attempted to electrocute the hero. The Fin forced them out of Von Wolff's hands, causing them to land in a puddle of gasoline, igniting the fuel. In order to stop flames from spreading, the Fin used Von Wolff to douse the flames and them smash his head into the ship's bulk head, knocking the Nazi out. The Fin next radioed a nearby British destroyer and had it come and capture Von Wolff and his minions. The fate of Captain Erich Von Wolff following the war remains unknown.

erik czerny.origin: Victor von Doom awoke from dreams of pain to find himself in Latveria in the year 2099. He quickly made his way to the capital and found a new ruler, the cyborg Tiger Wylde, enthroned in his place. Wylde explained to him that he was in the year 2099 and that after his absence Latveria was left leaderless, and it was only Wylde's intervention that saved it from being annexed by the corporations. Doom, however, was still furious and demanded that Wylde remove himself from his throne. When Wylde ignored him, they fought, but in the end Wylde's advanced technology triumphed. Doom was defeated and Wylde pulled off his mask to reveal his face, but found that he had the unscarred visage of a young man, in spite of what history had taught about Doom. Wylde then burned Doom's exposed face to match history's description. Thinking him a cheap impostor, Wylde ordered his tarot card reader, Fortune, to dispose of him, and thus Doom was ejected from his own capital city. left|thumb|Without an armor Instead of letting Doom die, Fortune saw him as her only chance to overthrow Wylde, and so she took him back to her Romani clan, Zefiro, Doom's own descendants. There Doom found new allies, and together they flew to the headquarters of the Pixel corporation on the Isla Lobos de Afuera. They found a doctor there named Celia Quiñones, who they persuaded to enhance Doom with nanotechnology, increasing his motor responses and neural capabilities. Combined with stolen Pixel technology that he built into a new suit of armor, the man who called himself Doctor Doom now dubbed himself, simply, Doom. thumb|right He then began his campaign to win back Latveria. Doom first stole a shipment of tritonium that was being sent to Wylde, increasing tension between Latveria and the Pixel corporation. Then he handed out food to the Latverian masses in order to earn their loyalty when the eventual overthrow happened. Finally, when Wylde came after Doom instead, he coerced him with a tritonium bomb to fight him alone, and eventually when their fight remained a standstill, Doom detonated the tritonium, bringing down a mountain upon the two of them, and then using his armor's phase shifter, he saved himself and passed unharmed through the mountain. Latveria, again, was under the control of Doom. Doom's next adversary was the Pixel corporation itself, and its head, Eduardo Devargas. Devargas, uncomfortable with Doom's rise to power and the theft of the tritonium, sent a cyberspace being known as Fever against Doom, infecting his computers and even the systems of his armor. This forced Doom to enter cyberspace with the netglider Romani, Wire, and face Fever. The human virus attacked Doom first by sending him into a gameism in which he fought a twisted and far from historically-accurate version of the 20th Century's Fantastic Four. Only after absorbing the info-gathering abilities of a discarded program named Paloma, was Doom able to gather enough power in Cyberspace to face off against Fever directly, and finally, destroy him. In the process, Doom accidentally allowed the program Paloma to become sentient, but despite a brief struggle, they both realized that they needed each and came to a compromise. With Paloma's help, Doom was able to take physical control of Pixel and defeat its former head, Devargas. And with Doom's help, Paloma was able to run free in cyberspace. During this confrontation, Doom also faced a computer simulation involving a series of fictional and historical figures such as Jack the Ripper and Professor Moriarty in an attempt to regain his lost memory, but the attempt failed, leaving him more confused. Doom later fought a pair of strange foes. First, was the resurrected patriarch of the future nation of Wakanda, a king named Thandaza, whose granddaughter, Princess Okusana, built him in a cyborg body to bring him back, so that she could avoid the pressures of leadership. Doom finally defeated Thandaza, returning him to a grateful death, but not before plugging in and ransacking Wakanda of its technology, including the design of their Environmental Maintenance Platforms that kept its air clean of pollutants. Next, he fought an ancient being known as Necrotek, who was once defeated by the three Eyes of Agamotto, in the hands of Caius the Spartan. With the help of the Romani's young adept, Vox, and his single Eye of Agamotto, Doom banished Necrotek with a Caius Circle drawn in cyberspace, where Necrotek had anchored himself, using information Doom found in a hidden library of mystical texts. When the man-beast Ravage stole the plans from Alchemax's floating city Valhalla, Doom appeared to him and deciphered them, finding that the thrusters were its weakness. Doom traveled to Valhalla and met up with one of Avatarr's nano-engineered superheroes, Loki, as well as the body of Heimdall, defeated by 2099's X-Men. Avatarr's Thor appeared shortly later and attacked Doom, angered by Heimdall's death. In an attempt to stop Thor, Doom overloaded

erik delano.name: Erik Delano
erik delano.origin: Erik Delano was the son of the astronaut Michael Delano, who disappeared upon reentry from space, during which time he two fellow astronauts were killed in a grisly fashion. Erik was working at M.I.T. and was writing books on particle physics and a "dark universe" when he had a break-down. He began to believe he was being given instructions by his father to travel to different states and murder triplets. This eventually brought the attention of the Daimon Hellstrom who visited Erik. Erik had been forewarned about his visit by his "father" and the two had a short conversation, before Erik tried to shoot Daimon but Daimon overpowered him and Erik was arrested. While being carted away Daimon commented something may have taken Mike's voice and used it to get Erik to do the killings.

erik lonnroth.name: Erik Lonnroth
erik lonnroth.origin: The events of Erik Lonnroth's early life have not been recorded. By 1945, Lonnroth, then a young adult, had reached the rank of Oberstleutnant as a member of the Luftwaffe, and was the leader of his own squadron. During an aerial battle against American forces, Lonnroth and his plane were pulled out the sky moments before his aircraft collided with a plummeting American plane, and transported to the limbo-like dimension that houses the "rivers of time". Lonnroth soon learned that he had been transported to New York City in the year 2003 by Dr. Strange in order to help Thor defeat ancient Viking warrior Harald Jaekelsson. Lonnroth further learned that he was was chosen for the task, along with Sigrid the Battlemaiden and Sir Magnus of the Dannes, because they were the distant descendants of a Norse wise man from the town of Lakstad, who had haphazardly cursed Jaekelsson and his Viking crew with a rune stone, which had left the Vikings unable to die. According to Strange's reasoning, since the blood of the wise man had powered the rune curse, the descendants of his bloodline should be able to counter the curse's power. While Sigrid and Magnus were on board with the plan, Erik found the entire story doubtful, and questioned if he was dreaming or drunk. After discussing the plan with Sigrid and Magnus, Erik decided to help in the fight, remarking that it'd "be nice to fight for something decent". Contributing his blood to a magical brew whipped up by Dr. Strange, Erik reluctantly took the potion, and headed out in his aircraft. While Thor, Sigrid and Magnus took on Jaekelsson's Vikings on the ground, Erik attacked Jaekelsson and his flying longboat near the Woolworth building. Despite numerous attempts to bring the longboat down, Erik's attacks made no impact. After a close call with a Viking arrow that crashed through his windshield, Erik tried to flee, only to have a number of Vikings jump onto his plane. Despite using a number of aerial maneuvers and his side arm, Erik was unable to remove the Vikings from his ship. As Erik parachuted away to safety, his plane crashed down into the Viking longboat, engulfing them both in a fiery explosion. Erik landed safely and rejoined his comrades in time to see Thor launch Jaekelsson's body into orbit. After saying his goodbyes to the rest of his comrades, Erik was sent back to his own time by Dr. Strange. The Rivers of Time show that Erik eventually died in combat during World War II, when his plane was blown up by Allied Forces. He was also shown to have entered Valhalla, the Norse realm of heroes, upon his death, along with Sigrid and Sir Magnus.

erik nicieza.name: Erik Nicieza
erik nicieza.origin: Ratbag was a homeless man who wandered into Deadpool Inc. headquarters presumably looking for a job. When handed a job application he repeatedly scrawled "RATBAG" on the page, which was soon found to be the only thing he was capable of writing, only once also managing a poorly drawn hangman pictogram. Deadpool hired him on the spot as his biographer. Ratbag spoke almost exclusively in nonsequiturs so he rarely uttered a sentence that made complete sense in context, and he exhibited infantile traits like incontinence and a tendency to put random things in his mouth. Despite his cognitive disability, he also seemed to have some situational awareness, being able to follow basic instructions, understand when Wade and Sandi were in trouble, be able to convey urgent news if exerting significant effort, and recognise threatening figures; this was further demonstrated when upon regaining his cognitive faculties, he was able to clearly recall names and phone numbers. He likely remained a paid employee of Deadpool Inc. all the way up until Wade's presumed death. After a painful restructuring of his mind by Black Swan, Ratbag seems to have regained all regular cognitive faculties, remembering the rest of his life including his name, soon after which he called up Sandi to tell her that Wade seemed to be purposefully embarking on a suicide mission. Later on, Erik was the ringbearer at Deadpool and Outlaw's wedding.

erik wender.name: Erik Wender
erik wender.origin: Erik Wender and his twin brother Lars were energy-wielding mutants that acted like a living conduit. They could transfer massive amounts of energy between themselves. Erik and Lars had been raised by the Department of Defense since they were kids in order to further expand their abilities by gradually building up the power so they could manifest it collectively. The brothers would venture out with covert ops teams to the targeted cities of the government's choice and have them black out the entire area and then send the power they had absorbed back to the other so they could target those specific countries and unload that exponential energy as a weapon to destroy them. Erik ended up going on a mission to the newly established country of Sharzhad which was ruled by the superhuman Dagan Shah so he could establish a pipeline back to his brother so they could cripple Sharzhad without anyone knowing. But the unit was attacked by an unknown creature who killed everyone except for Erik who ran off into the desert to find some place to hide. The organization F.A.C.T. was tasked with rescuing Erik so they recruited the Dark Avengers to do just that. But after a scuffle between Luke Cage and the team, he took it upon himself to lead them as he didn't trust any of the parties involved. During the briefing, F.A.C.T. reported that Wender with his energy transferring ability, believed that Shah was going to use him as a power source so he could unleash the superior alien technology within Sharzhad upon the rest of the world, specifically the United States in his quest of power. So the Avengers were teleported inside the impenetrable dome but communications became blocked due to the interference. But they had planned for this deterrent so they gave some of Wender's belongings to Toxie Doxie so she could extract his essence which would act as a homing beacon to where he was being held at. After an encounter with Sultan Magus, the Avengers were able to leave Cage and Skaar behind as they ventured on to find Wender. Toxie was able to locate him beneath the surface so Ragnarok threw his hammer at the rock side busting open a hole so they could enter. Wender being scared tried to run off in the opposite direction but Trickshot fired a bola arrow which wrapped around Wender's legs knocking him to the ground. Wender was so exhausted that he asked Trickshot for some water and began gulping it down as fast as he could. Ragnarok then unleashed a lighting blast at Cage and Skaar's location keeping them busy with Magus as the team made off with Erik. left|thumb|Pipeline merging with the Rigellian pod The Avengers fought their way through the Sultan's Inner Circle to a main structure within the castle. Wender's eyes began to glow a bright orange as he detected the power that was being given off by the technology below their very feet. Ragnarok broke through to the underground cave that was the source of Shah's power. They found a subspace pocket containing a little universe built by the Rigellians who left it behind thousands of years ago after an attempt to colonize the Earth. The crystal formations in the pocket were what gave Shah his power. On Toxie's direction, Wender begun to channel all of the energy. Erik was seen in the alien pod draining it of all its power when Sultan Magus appeared after he sensed the drain through his connection to the country. He battled against the Dark Avengers as they tried to give Erik the ample time to finish his objective. The Avengers eventually gained the upper hand as Ragnarok pinned down the Sultan but were taken by surprise when the Juggernaut crashed through the dome with the Thunderbolts in tow. Erik remained in the pod as both teams battled each other but ended up being killed by Centurius who stabbed him in the chest with Skaar's sword.

The Avengers eventually gained the upper hand as Ragnarok pinned down the Sultan but were taken by surprise when the Juggernaut crashed through the dome with the Thunderbolts in tow. Erik remained in the pod as both teams battled each other but ended up being killed by Centurius who stabbed him in the chest with Skaar's sword.

erika benson.name: Erika Benson
erika benson.origin: Erika Benson was the mother of Gilbert Benson and an unidentified daughter. When Gilbert reached puberty, she discovered that he possessed mutant abilities that allowed him to absorb energy. Both were subsequently recruited by A.I.M., which intended to gather the residual energies of Proteus and use them to resurrect the reality-warping mutant. Erika was equipped with a specialized combat armor that enabled her to control her son and compel him to absorb the energy, even when the process caused him considerable pain. Operating under the identities of Harness and Piecemeal, the two were initially accompanied by the Alliance of Evil, a group of mutant mercenaries assigned to protect their mission. Their first known target was Saint Simons Academy in Vermont, where Piecemeal's senses had detected traces of Proteus's energy. While the Alliance dealt with the local authorities and the X-Terminators, Erika remained with her son in their helicopter. She forced Gilbert to collect the energy, using an energy noose and whip to overcome his reluctance, then took him to their next destination. At Niagara Falls, she lowered him over the edge with an energy tether so that he could absorb the remaining energy halfway down the falls. When X-Force intervened against the Alliance, Erika escaped with Gilbert by leaping from the ledge and activating her armor's teleportation system. Continuing the mission without the Alliance's assistance, Erika took Gilbert to Anchorage, Alaska, where she discovered that the teleportation mechanism had malfunctioned. Frustrated with A.I.M.'s equipment and her son's unwillingness to cooperate, she tore the device from her armor and threatened Gilbert with a large blade until he resumed absorbing the energy. Afterward, she traveled with him to Tokyo, Japan, where he collected further remnants of Proteus's power atop the Kodansha Building. With the preliminary stages complete, Erika announced that they were moving on to Edinburgh, Scotland, where the greatest concentration of energy remained. In Edinburgh, Gilbert had become so saturated with Proteus's energy that it flowed into him without any further effort, causing his body to expand uncontrollably. When local police attempted to intervene, Erika killed them with the weapons built into her armor before identifying the energy's principal concentration near the castle overlooking the city. She and her son were soon confronted by X-Force, the New Warriors and the Muir Island X-Men, who had joined forces to prevent Proteus's resurrection. During the ensuing battle, Erika fought back with her armor's repulsor ray and weapons array, injuring several of her opponents. The heroes eventually overwhelmed her, and a powerful blow from Warpath shattered her helmet, exposing her identity as a woman. The revelation was quickly overshadowed by Gilbert's catastrophic condition. Unable to contain the immense amount of energy he had absorbed, he begged his mother for help. Erika ordered him to hold it inside, showing little concern for his suffering, but he could no longer obey her. His body ruptured, merging with the residual energies of Proteus and the essence of Kevin MacTaggert. The resulting being identified itself as the combined existence of Gilbert Benson and Kevin MacTaggert before unleashing an explosion that devastated Edinburgh. Following his rebirth, Proteus reshaped the ruins of the city into a new reality and trapped the assembled heroes within it. Erika and Moira MacTaggert were kept at his side as he began expanding his creation. When Moira attempted to appeal to the better aspects of his nature, Proteus condemned both women for their treatment of their sons. Erika, however, showed little inclination to engage with his accusations and wanted to be left alone.
powers: She had the mutant ability to produce an energy tether. This line could be used like a whip or leash. It was apparently augmented or focused by her armor.

erika graham.name: Erika Graham
erika graham.origin: An anti-establishment activist, formerly the singer in the band "The Boy Eaters," Riot Grrl discovered her mutant powers while on stage. She was recruited by Fight-Man to form the extremely short-lived super-team, the Fight Brigade. Over time she lost interest in genuine activism as she got more and more paid public speaking engagements. When the second Hooded Eye put a ten-million dollar price on Fight-Man's head, sending every villain in the city and many angry civilians after him, Fight-Man called the former Fight Brigade members for assistance. Riot-Grrl's response was to tell Fight-Man that she hoped the villains killed him.

erika kelley.name: Erika Kelley
erika kelley.origin: thumb|left|Ms. America Ms. America was a member of the Liberteens, the Pennsylvanian team of the 50-state Initiative. She was inspired by Miss America. She was with the Liberteens when they saved the Liberty Bell from Flag-Smasher and Ultimatum terrorists. Ms. America and her fellow Liberteens 2-D, Iceberg, and Hope later left the Liberteens and formed their own team called the Fantastix to replace the disbanded Fantastic Four, and she changed her codename to Ms. Fantastix. They were also able to gain ownership of the Baxter Building. The Fantastix's first mission was stopping the Wrecking Crew from robbing a jewelry store that just across the street from the Baxter Building. The real Fantastic Four later showed up and revealed that the robbery was actually staged by the Fantastix's manager and publicist Brenda Bannicheck in order to boost the team's popularity. Ms. Fantastix and her team then got the blessing of the Fantastic Four to continue using the Baxter Building. The Fantastix saw little action during their subsequent career, mostly due to being stand-ins for the Fantastic Four with the Fantastic Four being around. When the powerful alien Cormorant scoured the Earth in search for a mysterious artifact, he unceremoniously destroyed the entirety of the Baxter Building to unearth Container Zero. When the Fantastic Four, Doctor Doom and Victorious arrived to confront the Cormorant, the Fantastix joined the fight. After the destruction of Container Zero ended with the creation of the Forever Gate and the Cormorant left, Mister Fantastic decided to reclaim what was left of the Baxter Building so his team could guard the portal. Despite being offered to help carry this duty, the Fantastix decided to leave it all to the Fantastic Four.
powers: Superhuman Physiology: High Speed

erin cicero.name: Erin Cicero
erin cicero.origin: Erin Cicero is a Zzzax / human hybrid experiment. Cicero was a military prisoner, but was given the option of negating her sentence by signing up for dangerous experiments by a group of Army scientists under John Ryker. Staff Sergeant Erin Cicero signed up for the experiment because she was going to be put to death for the murder of 6 people, including her husband and 2 children. Before returning home, she had seen her entire platoon killed during peace-keeping operations and shipped home. She was likely suffering post traumatic stress which led her to believe her family were insurgent spies and killed them. Her first mission with Gamma Corps: Black was to apprehend Lyra and Boudicca. After taking over a small desert town in California, she absorbed most of Lyra's bio-electricity, but after Lyra made her angry, Axon found herself weaken so she returned them. Before Lyra could kill her like she had with the rest of Gamma Corps, General Ryker had her remotely terminated for being seen by too many civilians.
weaknesses: Axon appears to need to "feed" on others' bio-electricity.

erin hasko.name: Erin Hasko
erin hasko.origin: Erin Hasko was an actress since she was three months old. While she was portraying Spider-Woman in a movie, a filming session was interrupted by the arrival of Octavia Otto and an army of Spider-People from all over the Multiverse. Octavia didn't notice that Hasko was an actress and not a super hero, and tried to recruit her and her co-star who portrayed Spider-Man, Felix Lifson, into the army. After clearing up the misunderstanding, Octavia still offered them to join. Erin agreed, feeling suitable for having learned three different types of martial arts for a previous role. Afterwards, Erin was trained as a member of the Web-Warriors. She was recruited by the S.H.I.E.L.D. of Earth-41940 into the Spider-Men, a group of Spider-Man analogs assembled to combat the Multiversal Sinister Six. She also joined the Spider-Force. After Spider-Queen escaped custody, Erin asked a panicked Spider-Man about why she didn't feel her influence. Realizing she wasn't a Spider-Totem, he sent her to Horizon Labs to collect a device that would suppress Soria's powers over spiders.

eris alien.name: Eris (Alien)
eris alien.origin: Eris was a space pirate who set out to collect Groot's bounty but instead captured Rocket Raccoon. thumb|In her armor Rather than wasting fuel and resources chasing Groot, Eris decided to instead take Rocket back to her ship and use him as bait. Sure enough, Groot, along with a ragtag group of allies, attacked Eris's base in an effort to rescue Rocket. Eris and her crew maintained the upper-hand at first but two of Groot's allies were able to turn the tide: the Skrull Laz was revealed to be a Super-Skrull and Mantron fell in love with Eris's robot crewman A.P.E. and convinced them to switch sides. Facing defeat, Eris triggered a number of explosives as a last-ditch attempt to defeat Groot and his allies but Mantron, sacrificing himself, grabbed Eris and the explosives and carried them out of the ship. Eris was revealed to have survived the explosion and declared she would meet Groot and Rocket another time.
