ernest lee.name: Ernest Lee
ernest lee.origin: Prof. Anton Gofonopolis summoned many astrophysics luminaries to the Mount Olympus Observatory to announce a discovery he had observed. Once the luminaries had gathered at the observatory, the Professor said that in the past few days he had observed how a celestial body was devouring other smaller celestial bodies, such as asteroids or meteors, and becoming larger and larger as it devoured them with the fear that once it had become of an adequate size it would begin to devour the planets and after making this statement he invited the scientists to observe with the telescope to see if what he had said was true. Everyone observed and remained astonished, except Prof. Ernest Lee of the Mount Whitmore Observatory who had understood that what they were observing was not a celestial body that was devouring other celestial bodies, but rather some small animal, in this case a spider, which when placed on the lens of the telescope had given the impression of an aggressive celestial body while in fact it was the spider that was devouring other insects. In fact, by washing the lens, the phenomenon disappeared, leaving all the bystanders to enjoy a peaceful vacation at Mount Olympus.

ernest popchik.name: Ernest Popchik
ernest popchik.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 107
ernest popchik.origin: Ernie Popchik was a World War II veteran living in the Aunt May's boarding home in Queens. He was spotted by May's nephew Peter Parker in Manhattan, just after cashing his social security check, and was shopping in the city. A moment later he was assaulted and bruised by a street gang, but he was promptly rescued by Spider-Man and taken to the hospital to check for concussion. He later attended with May and Peter the public criminal hearing where the assailants, defended by Matt Murdock, were released on their own recognizance by Judge Horace Rosenthal. Ernest couldn't believe the judge let them go without bail, but as soon as he left the court, the Sin Eater appeared in the streets and he ran for cover, assisting Aunt May while Spider-Man made the killer flee. Some days later, he was harassed by four teenagers on a subway train; these criminals used the nicknames John, Paul, George, and Ringo, apparently after the Beatles. Popchik shot at least three of them, and then turned himself in, claiming it was self-defense, even though the boys weren't armed. Matt Murdock made sure to provide him a lawyer for free, but Popchik was still imprisoned. The Grand Jury refused to indict him for his actions, so Popchik had been already released by Christmas Eve, giving him a chance to spend the holidays with his son. Suddenly hailed as a hero and besieged by journalist wanting interviews, which he didn't want to give, Popchik left his son's for May's boarding home; unfortunately his grandson revealed where he was going, and the journalists tracked him there. Even Daily Bugle city editor Kathryn Cushing compelled photojournalist Peter Parker to use his influence with his Aunt May so that journalist Joy Mercado could interview Popchik. Before they could reach Queens, the four delinquents who had been shot by Popchik, also familiar with him through the press, entered the building through a window to rough him up. The ruffians were seen by May's friends Anna Watson and Mary Jane Watson, who called the police. Lieutenant Kris Keating (later revealed to be an impostor) sieged the house, while the criminals held the seniors hostage with guns. May's fiancee Nathan Lubensky confronted "John", only to be battered; Popchik, instead, tried to negotiate, admitted to have been scared after being mugged and tried to empathize with a man who, like him, used a gun to feel he was strong. Popchik suggested that John release the other hostages. Meanwhile, Spider-Man snuck into the house, knocked out the other criminals and, when he revealed himself to John and blocked his gun, Lubensky opened a shade to give the police a clean shot. Popchik then decided to leave May's boarding home, as he thought his presence would endanger May and his associates; Anna Watson supported his position, while May and boarder Martha Lund did not. Nonetheless, Popchik was no longer seen at May's boarding home.
powers: None, human.

ernest shackleton.name: Ernest Shackleton
ernest shackleton.origin: In 1915, Sir Ernest Shackleton, sent by Winston Churchill, sought out vibranium in the Antarctic. His ship, the Endurance, was lost. President Woodrow Wilson from his deathbed asked Leonard McKenzie to find the remains of the Endurance in 1920. Leonard using explosives to find the ship led to his endangering Atlantis and meeting Fen whom he later married and who bore his firstborn son Namor. Leonard McKenzie's grandson Leon would later find and attempt to plunder the ship.

ernest st ives.name: Ernest St. Ives
ernest st ives.origin: Ernest St Ives was a French soldier in World War I when he fell into a trench and mustard gas flowed in. When Death came to take St Ives, he refused to go and Death did not take him. Death left a parting gift that St Ives discovered when another soldier came to his aid. The moment that St Ives touched him, the soldier fell, dead. St Ives now killed whomever he touched with his skin. He sadly killed his wife by merely hugging her. St Ives eventually realized that he was immortal and he began to enjoy his power. He amassed a rather powerful base by the time that he moved to Quebec. There, he became a powerful criminal with no interference until he killed Raymonde Belmonde, an old friend of Northstar's, and took Aurora captive. Northstar stormed Deadly Ernest's home only to be knocked out when he saw Aurora flirting with him. When he awoke, he was met by the blade of Nemesis. She was sworn to slay him and apparently did so by cutting him into several pieces. St Ives was still not taken by Death. Instead, his remains were taken to the same Montreal hospital that housed Scramble. Scramble put Deadly Ernest's body back together and he returned to life. Alpha was finally able to beat him, again with the help of Nemesis. His body was seemingly completely destroyed so it is unlikely that he could come back once again.

ernesto guevara.name: Ernesto Guevara
ernesto guevara.origin: In 1958, Logan embarked on a covert mission to monitor the activities of revolutionary leaders Guevara and Fidel Castro , accompanied by his partner Hendricks. However, their carefully laid plans are thrown into disarray when Hendricks falls victim to mind control at the hands of giant bugs. With Hendricks compromised and the revolutionary leaders at risk of succumbing to the same fate, Department Zero swiftly intervened to assist Logan. In a tense and frantic battle against the monstrous insects, they managed to thwart the creatures' insidious agenda before they can infect Castro and Guevara.

ernesto karnelli.name: Ernesto Karnelli
ernesto karnelli.origin: Ernesto Karnelli was the long-hidden leader of the shadow arms of the Maggia, the Undermob. Being known as the Underboss, Karnelli operated completely from a lair located in a secret network of underground tunnels near the New York City Hall. Since he lived completely off the grid, the Underboss' oly company was his loyal servant Renaldo. As part of a contingency to eliminate either a mayor or a grand jury that could cause the Maggia trouble, Karnelli used his connections in City Hall to have erected outside the building a statue made completely of tritium, which could be used as a destructive explosive when exposed to a specific kind of charge. The statue was made to commemorate the Battle of Blood Creek, a fabricated event from the Revolutionary War, with digital evidence of it also being forged to go with the deception. Reporter Ned Leeds started to look into Blood Creek, but the investigation went nowhere following his death. However, when Ned was brought back to life by the new Jackal, he left his wife Betty Brant a voicemail which ended with the words "Blood Creek." The Enforcers witnessed when Leeds sent the message, and later visited the Underboss to warn him that the investigation could resume. Karnelli had the Enforcers kidnap Leeds' contacts from when he was investigating Blood Creek, historian Dr. Childs and a city constructor named Mr. Prescott, as well as Ms. Brant. The three were taken to the Underboss' underground lair, where he explained he was going to set off the statue to ensure his anonymity since the truth was close from being uncovered. Karnelli escaped on a small train with the Enforcers and a remote detonator while he ordered Renaldo to get to the surface and access the bomb's manual detonator as a back-up plan. Spider-Man managed to rescue Karnelli's hostages, and followed his train. After the defeat of all the Enforcers except Montana, Karnelli decided to detonate the statue even if he wasn't outside the blast's radius. Spider-Man convinced Montana to turn against the Underboss, and he snatched the detonator from Karnelli's hand. Meanwhile, Renaldo had been stopped by Brant. Karnelli and all of his associates were later apprehended and imprisoned. Betty wrote an exposé on the truth behind Blood Creek, and the statue was taken down.

ernesto ramirez.name: Ernesto Ramirez
ernesto ramirez.origin: The South American dictator, Generalissimo Ernesto Ramirez, was the only one who offered funding for research to the scientist Andre LeClare. LeClare was on the verge of breakthrough regarding the drawing of energy from other universes, but when he discovered that the Generalissimo was intent on using his discovery as a weapon, LeClare tried to dissuade him from doing so, but when he failed, he decided to abandon the project and flee Ramirez's country. At that point, Ramirez hired LeClare's assistant, Felipe Picaro, to continue the project, which Picaro did on an old Roxxon's oil rig in the Gulf of Mexico.

ernesto robles.name: Ernesto Robles
ernesto robles.origin: General Ernesto Robles was the dictator of Terra Verde. He rose to power approximatly fifteen years prior to his death, he led a bloodless coup d'état to fix what he believed was an inefficient government, installing himself as dictator. During his time he defeated all resistance groups and outlawed the worship of the Mayan Gods. Diablo led a revolution of the peasants by making them believe that Crystal was the goddes Ixchel. He kidnapped the General and brought him to his base in the Temple of Ixchel. Here, Diablo was confronted by the Fantastic Four and went to unleash a destructive potion, but the General, angry at the prospect of loosing his rule attacked Diablo and knocked the potion on the ground. The General is presumed to have died in the ensuing explosion.

ernst nazi.name: Ernst (Nazi)
ernst nazi.origin: The man that adopted the identity of Yitz Perlman was a Nazi soldier named Ernst. During Germany's invasion in Czechoslovakia, he was approached by a Jew that attempted to feed him false information to earn his family passage to America. Even though he was aware of the man's ploy, Ernst believed that Hitler's end would eventually come, so he agreed to help him in exchange of escaping with him, evading capture by the Allies disguised as the man's long-lost rabbi friend, Yitz Perlman. Ernst shot the man dead before joining the rest of the group, since he was the only person that knew of Ernst's new identity. Perlman then fled to America with the man's wife and their son, Elias Spector. As years went by, the Spectors and Perlman settled in Chicago, Illinois. Yitz and Elias were extremely close, and Elias became a rabbi thanks to his teachings. Elias' son, Marc, even regarded Yitz as an uncle. Perlman had been part of a cabal of Nazis responsible for the creation of the Red Skull and the Hate-Monger. He had discovered a method to elongate his life, so long as he sufficiently stimulated the dark, primordial pleasure center of his brain on a regular basis. He achieved this by killing Jews, becoming a serial killer in secret. One day, Marc stumbled upon a secret room in Perlman's synagogue where he carried out his murders, and caught Perlman red handed. After Perlman revealed to Marc his true nature, the young boy's fighting spirit emerged for the first time in order to escape, though Ernst swore to come back for him if Marc revealed his secret. The following day, Perlman disappeared, allegedly having been transferred to another synagogue. No one in his circle of friends saw him again. Years later, Ernst had become the leader of an underground cult of people who shared a fixation for sadism in all its shapes and forms, the Société des Sadiques, and Marc Spector had become the vigilante Moon Knight. Ernst expected Marc to come for him eventually, and faciliated Marc's hunt for him. Marc infiltrated the Société's biannual feast and revealed himself. To his surprise, he was personally invited by Ernst to join the Société. Marc and the other inductees were put through a series of trials. After defeating the other contestants, Ernst revealed he planted the seeds for their encounter, since he saw potential in Marc and wanted him by his side. Ernst then gave Marc the instruction for the final trial, to murder an innocent child. He had the choice to either confront the entirety of the Société's in their full might, or abstain and have his own daughter Diatrice murdered. Marc struggled with his personalities but eventually refused to kill the kid. Ernst observed with disappointment and walked away as he ordered his men to take Marc down. Marc was shot with drugs and taken away by Ernst on a tour through Brooklyn, where Ernst attempted to subjugate Marc to become his heir. Marc managed to reject Ernst and walked away from him after injuring him, leaving him to be killed by an apparition of Khonshu.

ernst fleischer.name: Ernst Fleischer
ernst fleischer.first_appearance: Captain America Theater of War: Operation Zero-Point Vol 1 1
ernst fleischer.origin: During WWII, Captain America was sent on a secret mission within Nazi occupied Poland. He was to assist Dr. Ernst Fleischer in defecting from the Nazis and destroy anti-gravity vehicles that Fleischer created with the assistance of Polish rebel fighter Lior Eschel. Cap did not believe the story about the anti-gravity devices until his plane was destroyed by just such a ship. Bailing out in time, Cap managed to find Lior and saw that the area was under the command of a enhanced Nazi soldier named Der Metzger (The Butcher). It turned out the Lior had sold Cap out to the Nazis, and he was captured at the cost of Lior's life. After being examined, Cap was tossed in a cell where he met with Fleischer. Breaking himself and Fleischer out of their cells, Cap proceeded to destroy the hover crafts. Fleischer was killed in the crossfire.

eros olympian.name: Eros (Olympian)
eros olympian.origin: Cupid is a member of the Olympian gods worshipped by the Ancient Greeks and Romans. He was born the son of Hephaestus Aetnaeus, the smith-god and Venus, the love-goddess called Aphrodite. Raised predominantly by his mother, he was groomed into being his mother's ally in affairs of the heart, especially in schemes that benefited herself. He fired the arrow which caused Helen of Troy to fall in love with Venus' young ward, the Trojan Prince Paris, but he did balk at forcing the Phoenician princess Psyche to fall in love with a mortal beyond her dignity. Psyche's beauty had caused mortal men to turn away from worship of Venus, whose temples fell into ruin. Venus sent Cupid to Earth to punish her by making her fall in love with an undeserving wretch. Scratching himself on one of his own arrows, he fell in love with Psyche himself and spirited her off to live in secrecy with her. Cupid was stripped of his godhood for a while for disobeying Aphrodite, but after Psyche proved her worthiness by outsmarting Venus and earning her right to be a goddess, Cupid and Psyche lived happily for the rest of her brief mortal life. In recent years, Cupid encountered the Avengers as they came to Venus for assistance against Zeus, who blamed them for Hercules' severe injuries at the hands of Baron Helmut Zemo's Masters of Evil. Cupid tried to keep them away, but was tossed aside. Shortly thereafter, Ares used the Amulet of Amuk to control and manipulate Venus to convinced Cupid that the Avenger Mockingbird was the reincarnation of his wife Psyche. Cupid attempted to force Mockingbird to remember him, and battled and defeated the Avengers West Coast when they opposed him. Eventually, with the aid of Hercules, the Avengers stopped Cupid, and convinced him of the error of his ways. They traveled to Mt. Olympus, where they stopped Venus and Zeus from falling prey to Ares' plot. Cupid gave Hawkeye one of his magic arrows as a token of himself, to the finest archer he had ever seen. In order to prove to his mother that he had not lost his matchmaking skills, Cupid was charged with finding a suitable mate for the time-traveling warrior Mahkizmo. Under the watchful eyes of his Uncle Dionysus, Cupid tried to match the warrior with Jennifer Walters, The She-Hulk, but Mahkizmo interceded the arrow and abducted Walters to the future. The Thing and Wyatt Wingfoot followed and learned that Mahkizmo was planning to kill off the women of the Twentieth Century, and stopped his plans. Cupid removed the arrow after seeing how much damage it had caused.
abilities: Cupid, like all Olympians, has had some training and experience in both armed and unarmed combat. However, he rarely gets involved in combat situations. He also has extensive skills in shooting love arrows.
weaknesses: Ambrosia Consumption: Despite his immortality, Cupid still needs to consume the Olympian Ambrosia to remain deathless and virtue otherwise he will start to age or even die by turning to dust.

fields.unusual_features: At will, Cupid can grow a set of feathered wings on his back.

erwin krause.name: Erwin Krause
erwin krause.origin: Captain Krause (also known as Captain Storm) was a member of the Nazis who was active during World War II. By the summer of 1943, he was in command of a Gestapo unit that patrolled the Berlin countryside searching for spies, defectors, and other refugees that might be attempting to flee the country. During this time, he found a pair of spies attempting to escape with secret plans stolen from the Nazis. Before he could get his men to execute the spies, the Destroyer mowed down Krause's men with a machine gun and stole the Nazis patrol car. Before they could escape, one of the spies was shot dead, but they continued on without him. Krause sped by motorcycle to a nearby airfield, and after calling troops to try and stop the Destroyer and the spy, he went after them in a Luftwaffe fighter plane. Dogging them, Krause watched as his shots caused the getaway car to crash. Landing his plane, he was caught by surprise when it turned out that the Destroyer and the spy were playing dead. Krause put up a fight but was easily knocked out by the very wrench he tried to use against the Destroyer. With Krause unconscious, the Destroyer stole his plane allowing the spy to flee to Britain with the stolen plans. The subsequent fate of Krause remains to be revealed.
weapons: When on patrol, Krause used a rifle with a bayonet attachment.

erwin schrodinger.name: Erwin Schrödinger
erwin schrodinger.origin: right|thumb|Tony Stark quoting Schrödinger Erwin Schrödinger was a Nobel Prize-winning Austrian physicist who developed a number of fundamental results in the field of quantum theory. ===Schrödinger's Cat=== Schrödinger famed theory is the proposed "Schrödinger's Cat" thought experiment which theorized that a cat put in a box with poison in it would be observed to be both dead and alive at the same time. ===Referenced=== 250px|thumb|left|Schrödinger's Cat experiment Quantum-Tunnel Drill Bits were used by the Assault Pterosuit Flock to try to kill Monica Rambeau, of the Nextwave Squad. They landed one successful hit before Monica killed them all. Mockingbird's S.H.I.E.L.D. appointed psychiatrist wore a T-Shirt saying; "Schrödinger's Cat is Dead!". Dr. Donald Blake referenced Schrödinger's cat in describing the Odinsleep, saying the sleeper is in a state between life and death. Amadeus Cho found himself playing a deadly Role-Playing Game, in which his character, Mastermind Excello, encounters a box containing a cat that is literally both dead and alive in the lair of a Mad Scientist. Tony Stark quoted Schrödinger's Cat when he attempted time travel. When Break Room of Tomorrow was invented Schrödinger's theory was used to explain it's functioning.

erwin shane.name: Erwin Shane
erwin shane.origin: Shane was the scientist in charge of the Psychoville project, which consisted of taking psychopaths, murderers and serial killers from various parts of the country and transfer them to the reconstructed Chicane, a West Virginia town completely destroyed by a fire ten years before, where they suffered brainwashing and mental conditioning to make them perfect sleeping killers to use in their service through the use of a trigger word. Among the people taken and brought to Chicane where he was brainwashed there was also the Punisher, but when Castle regained his mental faculties with the help of Microchip, he went to the control room where Shane and his closest collaborators controlled the progress of the whole project, and there Castle killed everyone except Shane who nonetheless was killed by the other psychopaths who had regained their memory.

erynys.name: Erynys
erynys.origin: Erynys was created out of Elektra's dark essence and thoughts through a ritual performed by the Snakeroot, an organization associated with the Hand. As a result, she knew each of Elektra's own moves and carried the same memories, but was more mercilessly violent and hateful. The Snakeroot used her to hunt down Daredevil and destroy him, unaware that the true Elektra had returned. In a battle between the two, Erynys was fatally wounded and reabsorbed back into Elektra, making her "whole" again.
abilities: Erynys had the same fighting style and acrobatic skills as Elektra herself.
weapons: Erynys fights with a pair of sai.

Masacre threw his machetes at the Especialista, then took them out and cut the Especialista's arms off with them.
fields.notes: "Especialista" translates to English as "Specialist."

esperanza ling.origin: Esperanza Ling was a Cuban citizen who along with her family took a trip to Swiss Alps. There, she and her family encountered a Phalanx invasion. Her parents and grandfather were absorbed into the hive but she could not, due to her mutant nature. Hope was kept as prisoner by government Project Mainspring along with a monkey, Chi-Chee, who was also infected with the Transmode Virus. It was during Warlock's infiltration of the Project Mainspring in order to destroy all techno-organic material. He felt guilty for bringing it to Earth. Warlock prevented the creation of the Babel Sphere. Warlock then freed both Chi-Chee and Esperanza. She ran from him, fearful of what her powers would do. She however fled with Warlock upon finding his good intentions. Hope, Chi-Chee, and Warlock ran from the Project Mainspring's mechanical guards. While in museum they ran into Iron Man and Warlock had to use all his energy to defeat the mechanical guards. Hope and Chi-Chi give him a bit their lifeglow so he could continue fighting. But after the destruction the mechanical guards he and Hope were kidnapped by the Psi-Cops. While inside the Psi-Cops' base, Hope, Warlock, and Chi-Chee were places within a sphere and a sad Esperanza spoke of her inability to control her powers and wish to die in order to stop the spread of the virus. Psimon listen to her story and theory that what the Psi-Cops were doing was wrong. She then freed them and just as Mainspring and his robotic guards attack their base. All them fled together, but in the last minute Chi-Chee was lost.
weaknesses: She had no control of her infectious powers. If she infects a living person, she is connected to them and will suffer any of their pains.

espumar.first_appearance: Nick Fury, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. Vol 3 20
espumar.origin: Espumar was a Mexican drug lord who was smuggling drugs into the United States across the southwestern border. The DEA could not figure out how he was bringing it in, so S.H.I.E.L.D. got involved. Espumar had built a great tunnel that ran from his mansion to his warehouse in New Mexico. It was a tunnel that was at 50-100 ft tall and wide, large enough for at least three convoys of trucks to pass through it side by side. The tunnel was discovered by Nick Fury and Mexican government agent Antonio Gobier, who rolled in guns blazing. The S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier then broke through the dirt and rocks above the tunnel via the use of excavators, and SHIELD personnel charged into battle. Nick Fury and the troops pulled out, and left a large bomb. Which took out the tunnel, the blast reaching all the way to Espumar's mansion.

esrit.name: Esrit
esrit.origin: Esrit was the Demon-Familiar, having agreed to serve for a given term Vacharn, a necromancer living on the Isle of Na'at with his sons Uldulla and Wokal, in exchange for the blood of a living man chosen for his strength and valor. After Conan's ship crashed on Na'at, Conan and Sigurd were saved by the undead servants of the necromancers to serve as the sacrifices for Esrit. As Conan was shown his future fate as Sigurd was sucked, he overcame the spell that kept him still and threw Esrit at Vacharn, who repelled the demon using the word "Agor". Uldulla and Wokal eventually allied with Conan to slay Vacharn. Equipped with scimitars with lethal runes and inscribed with death-spells, they attacked Vacharn. Wokal was wounded by Vacharn, and Esrit drank his blood until he died. As Vacharn killed Uldulla before being achieved by Conan, Esrit attacked Conan, who slew it using his enchanted scimitar.

esteban beach.name: Esteban Beach
esteban beach.origin: ===Early Life=== Esteban Beach, often called “Spider” by those around him, was a spirited and adventurous teenager living in Los Angeles. He was the younger brother of aspiring actress Ginger Beach and quickly developed a fascination with superheroes, particularly Wonder Man, who lived in the same apartment building. Esteban's natural enthusiasm and relentless energy made him endearing to his sister’s social circle. Their mutual agent, Neal Saroyan, assigned Spider to Wonder Man as a self-declared sidekick in an attempt to generate positive publicity. Though initially annoyed by the teen’s persistent presence, Wonder Man eventually grew fond of him. ===Exposure to Ionic Energy=== Esteban was among the eight individuals present when Wonder Man, having been attacked by Angkor, experienced a massive and uncontrolled burst of ionic energy. While there were no immediate effects, each of the eight—including Esteban—underwent subtle and permanent changes due to their exposure. Esteban later discovered that he had developed the ability to generate electromagnetic duplicates of himself—replicas made of pure ionic energy that could act independently at his command. He embraced these new powers with enthusiasm and began referring to himself as “Stat.” ===Role in the Crazy Eight=== Esteban was instrumental in encouraging the formation of the Crazy Eight, the informal superhero team formed by those affected by Wonder Man's outburst. Though young and relatively inexperienced, he persuaded Alex Flores to step up as the group’s leader, demonstrating surprising emotional intelligence and a desire to contribute meaningfully. As Stat, Esteban joined the rest of the team Dreamer, Snap, Buff, Visionary, Attractive Lad, Glamour Girl, and Auteur—in fighting the corrupt enforcement unit Armed Response. His duplicates were especially useful for reconnaissance and distraction tactics. When Lotus Newmark retaliated by sending assassins Splice and Rampage to eliminate the Crazy Eight, Stat played a key role in defending his team. ===After the Team=== During the mystical confrontation involving Mephisto, Blackheart, and the Grim Reaper, Wonder Man reabsorbed the ionic energy he had unintentionally shared with the others. However, Stat and Dreamer secretly resisted the process and retained a portion of their powers. While most of the Crazy Eight returned to civilian life, Esteban quietly continued practicing his abilities and exploring the idea of becoming a superhero in his own right. Following Wonder Man's apparent death during the Scatter conflict , Esteban moved in with Gloria Angel, who became his legal guardian.
powers: Beach could create electromagnetic duplicates of himself and whatever else he was holding.

esteban carracus.name: Esteban Carracus
esteban carracus.species: Human, Mutate, altered by Kree technology
esteban carracus.origin: Esteban Carracus was a petty thief from Mexico City who lived with his family. However, while his brothers worked to support the family, Esteban would sit at home all day, refusing to work because he felt that, as a man, he would not demean himself by slaving for the touristas. Esteban was a friend of the bandit Raoul Escheverra and the two of them believed that American capitalists had made the Mexican people into their slaves. Esteban would often tell his mother that he and Escheverra would accomplish many great things but she never heard anything but talk. One day, while sitting at home arguing with his mother, Esteban was struck by an energy beam directed at him by Sentry 459, an advanced Kree robot that had re-programmed itself by absorbing Escheverra's brain patterns. Deciding that it needed an ally, the Sentry had used Escheverra's memories to select Carracus and endow him with superhuman powers. The energy beam physically transformed Carracus, making him faster and stronger than any human, and giving him claws on his fingers and a costume. Adopting the name of Cheetah, Carracus became a super-villain, and he and the Sentry traveled across the border into the state of Texas where they began to carry out their anti-capitalist agenda by destroying any factories in their path. During one such attack, they were opposed by the first Captain Marvel but they defeated him and left him for dead. The following morning, the Cheetah and the Sentry continued their rampage across Texas until they came close enough to a crashed Kree spacecraft and fell under the mental domination of Ronan the Accuser who was imprisoned within the wreckage. The two arrived at crash site at the same time as Captain Marvel, and Ronan used them to delay Marvel in senseless battle long enough for him to free himself. The ploy worked and the freed Ronan then attempted to execute Marvel. However, during the battle, Marvel manipulated Ronan into blasting the head off the Sentry, deactivating it. Deprived of the Sentry's power, Carracus immediately reverted to his original human form, losing both his powers and his costume. Carracus then fled while Marvel defeated Ronan. Despite the loss of the powers that he had received from the Sentry, Carracus decided to keep the uniform and the secret identity, replacing the natural paws with artificial claws, and with more limited fighting abilities. Carracus was contacted by Gary Gilbert, a former costumed criminal turned business agent for criminals. Gilbert was worried about the Scourge of the Underworld, a masked figure who was killing costumed criminals such as Gilbert and Carracus. Gilbert organized a meeting in the Bar with No Name, Medina County, Ohio, to discuss potential counter-attacks. As the Scourge was known to use weapons instead of powers, weapons were to be left at the door. However, the Scourge infiltrated in the meeting disguised as the bartender and shot down all the seventeen criminals (including Cheetah) wielding a cut-down .50 submachine gun in each hand. Cheetah was later resurrected by the Hood to kill the Punisher, but failed and died again.
powers: As an agent of the Kree, the Cheetah had superhuman abilities he would later lose. His powers included: Improved fighting abilities, strength, stamina, agility and speed. Razor-sharp natural claws at the ends of his fingers
weapons: After losing his powers, the Cheetah used artificial claws to replace the previous ones
they were functionally identical to the original ones.

ethan allen.name: Ethan Allen
ethan allen.origin: Ethan Allen is an American historical figure who lived from 1738 to 1789. He was best known for his involvement in the American Revolutionary War and being one of the founders of the state of Vermont. He was also a commander of the Green Mountain Boys. He died on February 12, 1789 of Apopalexy. ===World War II=== The spirit of Ethan Allen and members of the Green Mountain Boys were summoned by wartime hero Mister Liberty to help thwart a plot by Nazi Fifth Columnists who were targeting American munitions plants. The combined efforts of Allen and the Green Mountain Boys led to the defeat and capture of the Nazis.
powers: As a spirit, Ethan Allen could become immaterial or invisible at will. He could become solid to interact with the environment around him. He could also float.

ethan edwards.name: Ethan Edwards
ethan edwards.origin: ===Origin=== Many years ago Galactus had chosen to devour Tarnax IV, the Skrull capital. The planet's chief scientist and creator of the Super-Skrull, knew the planet was doomed. He devised a plan to ensure the safety of his newborn son. The scientist imbued his son with powers far greater than any previously seen in the Skrull race. The child was then placed inside a specially designed craft and set course for a new planet. Upon arrival the child would disguise itself as a native until it was deemed ready to conquer the planet. The craft landed in Iowa one night and a couple witnessed its arrival. Upon inspection of the craft it opened, and the couple was amazed to see a child inside. They considered it a divine gift and decided to adopt him, unaware of his true nature. Named Ethan and raised on the farm, he had a strong moral upbringing. After realizing Ethan had incredible powers, his parents taught him the importance of keeping them a secret. Eventually once Ethan had become a young man he felt he had a greater purpose in life and so left the farm. ===Becoming Virtue=== After moving to New York, Ethan landed himself a job at the Daily Bugle, and was soon being referred to as their 'new star reporter' by J. Jonah Jameson. Peter Parker was at the Bugle in time to be introduced to Ethan and was then teamed up with him for a feature on Spider-Man after landing himself a new full time position. On Peter's first day back, he and Ethan were taking a trip downtown when they spotted a man hanging from a window ledge. Peter quickly found a place to change into Spider-Man but the man fell from the window. He was caught in the air by a hero wearing a green cape. Inside the building Spider-Man tangled with the Absorbing Man. The green caped hero reappeared and sent Creel halfway across Manhattan with a single blow. The two had a rendezvous atop a building, where the hero revealed himself to be Ethan and that he knew Spider-Man's identity. Ethan also revealed he wanted to use his powers for the good of mankind and Peter reluctantly agreed to be Ethan's superhero mentor. Wanting to discover the full extent of Ethan's powers and their origins, Spider-Man took his new friend to the Baxter Building. Following some tests by the Fantastic Four, Ethan (now calling himself 'Virtue') proved to be in the same strength bracket as The Thing, able to see in any light spectrum, and able to match the Human Torch's speed and maneuverability in the air. Later that day Ethan's face was captured and broadcast on TV. Upon returning to the Bugle everyone knew who this new hero was and wanted his story. ===Revelation=== Peter got a call from Mister Fantastic. Reed explained he and the FF had found the craft that brought Ethan to Earth. In Iowa near the site, the Fantastic Four were quizzing Ethan's father when Ethan arrived. The craft suddenly began to talk to Ethan in Skrull. He attacked the Fantastic Four before his father defused the situation. Ethan then flew away, but with his mind not right due to the mind mending on his mind. Back in New York, Ethan was now seemingly operating on a new set of directives, again appearing as Spider-Man was investigating Absorbing Man and the Owl. Ethan destroyed the building, unknowingly killing an informant Spider-Man was looking for. Back at the Daily Bugle, Ethan researched who and what the Skrull are, coming to think he was a "murderous Skrull". thumb|left|True form He returned to the Baxter Building and demanded to see Reed Richards again. However, the Fantastic Four were still examining the craft back in Iowa. After smashing through the exterior of the building, the New Avengers (who had been alerted by Spider-Man) arrived to try and stop him. Seeing the events on TV, Aunt May and Jarvis arrived from Stark Tower. They managed to talk Ethan down by convincing him of the good he could do in the world by helping the needy. Following this advice Ethan moved overseas to help the less fortunate. He began to heal the sick and wounded. Hearing this from Parker puzzled Mister Fantastic; the craft did not mention any healing powers. ===The Revengers=== Simon Williams, Wonder Man, managed to convince some super heroes to take part in his Anti-Avengers team called the Revengers, one of them was Virtue, who joined so he could avenge his people following their failed invasion. The Revengers defeated the New Avengers at Avengers Mansion, and later, they called a press conference at the court, where the Avengers appeared to confront them. After failing at discuss with Wonder Man, Iron Man trapped him in his ionic form in a containment unit. Not willing to fight with too many civilians near, Thor teleported the Revengers to the City Field, where they where subdued by both the Avengers and the New Avengers and later imprisoned. ===The Kree/Skrull Alliance=== Virtue resurfaced years later as a member of the Kree/Skrull alliance under the leadership of Emperor Hulkling. fields.trivia: The character's similar origins and abilities show a strong influence of (albeit parodied so that everything that usually works for Superman fails miserably or just seems plain stupid when Ethan does it), particularly with regards to an alien origin, a sole survivor of a race, and his arrival in the countryside of Earth, where he was taken in by an older couple. His powers also reflect those of Superman, such as super strength, flight, super speed and maneuverability, x-ray vision, and the ability to project energy beams (though from his hands rather than his eyes). However, he lacks the character's invulnerable 'aura', meaning that although he himself is never injured his costumes always end up in tatters. Ethan's healing power can also provide a link between Superman and (the very religious figure that Ethan was raised to believe in). His name may be derived from 's character from 's film .

ethan myers.name: Ethan Myers
ethan myers.species: Human Mutated in an attempt to recreate Spider-Man's powers.
ethan myers.origin: Ethan Meyers left his home in Cincinnati due to family problems and traveled to New York City where he lived homeless. The first person to show Ethan any kindness in New York was a mysterious man who offered to make him a superhero. Ethan was experimented on and soon discovered that he was developing powers similar to those of Spider-Man and was given a Spider-Man suit to wear before being left on a rooftop. Ethan decided to try his luck at some heroics and attempted to stop a man from seemingly breaking into a building before discovering that the man was actually an undercover NYPD officer and that he found himself trapped in a sting operation. Ethan allowed himself to be arrested and for his identity to be revealed as well as telling his story to Detective Fogg. The real Spider-Man Peter Parker, learned about him and came to free him from his cell so he could learn about his copycat. When Parker arrived he found Myers in great pain as his body was continuing to mutate, sprouting half formed limbs from his body, and rushed him to Metro-General Hospital where he called Reed Richards to meet him nearby instead to avoid the authorities. Richards was able to reverse his metamorphosis with an antidote produced by Dr. Curt Connors

ethan shields.name: Ethan Shields
ethan shields.species: Immunodeficient human who wield the Galahad suit
ethan shields.origin: ===Origins=== Ethan Shields was born with a rare disease that resulted in the complete lack of any form of immune system, leaving every moment exposed to the elements a potentially fatal one. He and his family lived in an ancient 20th century home, until a fire engulfed the building. An unknown Watchdog pulled the young Shields from the flames, but gave his life attempting to rescue others trapped inside- a moment that deeply affected the young Shields. Ethan decided to commit himself to creating new equipment to ensure that no public servant would have to die for their service again. Ethan was able to gain employment with Stark-Fujikawa, who provided him with a state of the art hermetically sealed laboratory, allowing him to both live and work in safety. Shields developed the high-tech combat armor, Galahad, to the apparent praise of his employers, though they privately criticized the man's hermitage lifestyle and lack of people skills once his presentation was over- criticism that prompted a recent addition to the Stark-Fujikawa team, Suzanne Carter to begin visiting him. During one of her nightly visits to Shields' lab, Carter was assaulted by one of her own designs; a heavy mech designed for construction and infrastructure, which had been stolen and used to assault Shields' work. Seeing Carter was in danger, Ethan activated the Galahad armor via a subcutaneous chip in his brain, rescuing her and stopping the robot. During the battle, the rampaging robot was knocked out of the window and into the streets below- forcing Ethan to sacrifice the original Galahad suit to stop the fall from killing anyone below and minimizing public damage, while vowing that he would continue to work on new iterations of the suit in order to protect Suzanne and the rest of his fellow man in accordance with his code of chivalry. ===2099 A.D. Apocalypse=== 125px|left|thumb|Ethan Shields' agony Galahad would rebuild and continue to operate, with at least six more publicly recorded appearances, and over this time, he and Suzanne would begin a romantic relationship. After the downfall of Doom's America, President Rogers assumed strict control over the country, backed by the military force of SHIELD. Rogers made a public declaration to every network connected to the grid that the recently expanded costumed vigilante population were public enemies, and issued a universal kill order for them. Unwilling to risk the wrath of the new administration for harboring one of these heroes, and looking to earn some easy brownie points, Stark-Fujikawa tipped SHIELD off to their connection with Galahad and set Ethan up to die. Wielding experimental HERF weapon systems, or High Energy Radio Frequency weapons, a SHIELD kill squad cornered Galahad outside of the Stark-Fujikawa offices and quickly overwhelmed him. Due to his neural link to the machinery within the Galahad suit, Ethan was especially vulnerable to the electronic attacks, which caused him a slow and agonizing death as they blew apart the armor, which created a feedback loop that cooked Ethan's brain in its own fluids. Galahad's final stand was recorded by Mirielle Radley, an intrepid NyFax reporter, who had stumbled into the crossfire of the battle. As she recorded the execution, she found the hiding place of Suzanne Carter, and was able to interview her- allowing Carter the opportunity to publicly eulogize her lover over the network, before the two were able to escape. ===Legacy=== Radley's footage of Shields' public execution caused great debate within NyFax's offices- Ruth Cambridge, the studio's manager, scoured every public record of Galahad's past appearances to find some way to potentially spin the story, but was frustrated to discover that Ethan's few public appearances consistently displayed the classic nobility of the Heroic Age. Regardless, Cambridge ordered the studio continue to cover his death as a state criminal in accordance with Rogers' statements, calling him a "dangerous subversive"; something refused by Jack Whitlow who refused to let his news broadcast turn into a propaganda arm and wanted to record the man's death as the execution of a hero. Whitlow would ultimately go live with his interpretation of the events, showing footage of Galahad's death alongside other heroes until SHIELD officers stormed NyFax and executed its staff as well. Due to the effects of time travel, Doom's conquest of the Americas and the events that would follow were wiped from the timeline, undoing the deaths of everyone who died in President Rogers' kill orders- including Ethan Shields. Shortly after this event, the Multiverse was destroyed and reborn in Doctor Doom's image, then subsequently undone and rebuilt by Reed Richards and his family, who went about reconstructing the multiverse piece by piece. Due to this long chain of interferences, the newly created 2099 timeline was wildly different and even more dystopic than the original, leaving Ethan's further status unknown. Regardless, shor
weaknesses: Ethan Shields has no immune system and so, when not in his armour, has to live in a protective enclosure in the Stark-Fujikawa building.

ethan warren.species: Mutant transformed into a fiery skeleton
ethan warren.origin: ===Origin=== Warren was a POW with Wolverine in Japan during World War II. They teamed up to escape and found a Japanese woman in the woods. Warren wanted to kill her, but Logan threatened to kill him if he did. They parted company and Logan spent some time with the lady, finding she would not have harmed them. Warren reappeared and shot Logan, then tried to rape the woman. She grabbed a sword and attacked him, but Warren managed to stab her with his bayonet. Logan recovered from his wound and attacked Warren. They each discovered the other was a mutant, incapable of being killed. Then a plane dropped a nuclear bomb on them. ===Death=== In the present, Warren, now a flaming skeleton man, found Wolverine in Japan and attacked him. After some fighting, Warren ripped out Wolverine's heart and ate it, restoring his human appearance. Wolverine stood up and continued the fight, shocking Warren, who tried to kill Logan with a searing energy blast. Logan was unfazed and advanced. Warren begged for mercy, but Logan killed him, then passed out. ===Hell=== Because of his past actions, Warren's soul was sent to Hell, and after the criminal organization known as the Red Right Hand sent Wolverine's soul to Hell, Warren was sent by Satan to fight against him alongside several villains killed by Wolverine through the years.

etienne villiers.name: Etienne Villiers
etienne villiers.origin: ===Early adventures=== Etienne met Agnes de Chastillon in a forest where her father had taken her after she killed her bride-groom at the altar. Etienne confused Agnes, in robes, her face and the dagger she was holding bloody, for a ghost. Agnes was mentored in fencing by Guiscard de Clisson, who was eventually murdered by Renault de Valence, a henchman of the Duke d'Alençon. Etienne and Agnes became enemies of the Duke d'Alençon and were both searched for capture by his men. On at least one occasion, Agnes saved Etienne's life. He and Agnes helped Françoise de Foix when pirates kidnapped her lover. Etienne considered Françoise to be (among other women) the love of his life. At some point, Etienne and Agnes planned to go to Italy, join a free company, and eventually retire to live off the riches they would had plundered in their careers. They were separated at some point afterwards. Etienne wandered, debauching here and there, such as when he cheated the Baron de Lyon and seduced his wife, and evading the Duke's henchmen. ===1521=== In 1521, he was captured by the Duke of Alençon's men, and sentenced to death by beheading in Chinon on the charges of stealing, cheating, gossip, corruption of the innocent, seduction, and adultery, heresy, public poaching, and murder, whom Etienne mostly denied, rejecting the one of murder towards the Duke d'Alençon. Agnes heard about his capture while she was in Orléans, came in Chinon, slew and impersonated the executioner, and freed Etienne. They fled, passed the forest where they first met, before arriving at the Pewter Pot (Pot en Etain) inn where Agnes was recognized on dead-or-alive five hundred francs-payed bounty. Agnes scared the pretenders and sat down, quickly falling asleep on the conjugated effects of alcohol and tiredness. Awakening in the middle of the night, Agnes saved Sister Marie, a nun, from a rapist. The nun, traveling with a young lady named Helen de la Mère, hired Agnes to escort them on the road towards Fontainebleau, the household of the Duke d'Alençon. Despite Etienne's disapproval, Agnes accepted. On their way, the two clerks scared the previous night, intended to collect the bounty offered by the Duke d'Alençon, Renault de Valence, and others, including Sister Marie, who slew one of the two assailants rather than having him to talk. At Fontainebleau, Etienne and Agnes met again with Françoise de Foix, and with Helen's sister Isabel de la Mère. Agnes planned to kill Renault, present there, the next day, at the masquerade. Agnes was drugged, an a masked man approached her posing as François, and pursued her in the gardens' maze, where she was found unconscious by Françoise and Helen. As they returned inside, Isabel was killed, and Renault, on Queen Claude' orders, instituted a lock-down over the palace until the killer would be unmasked. The remainder of this adventure remains to be fully recounted, and details are sparse: Agnes acted towards revenge, while a plot was set in motion against her. Etienne was framed for murder but Agnes was determined to prove his innocence before the Duke's return, which would mean Etienne's death. The Duke d'Alençon finally returned, and the killer was revealed. ===1522=== In 1522, in Poitou-Charentes, seven miles south of the Canal du Curé, Agnes and Etienne fought a group of assassins. Etienne was wounded. The two went to the next village, Charron, where the villagers, cultists of Set awaited her, as her coming had been announced by their god. She was to be sacrificed to a Man-Serpent. Evading the monster, she managed to break her bonds and arm herself, and battled the reptilian horror. Agnes was transported into the Hyborian Age for a quest against Set. Etienne was taken care of by the true villagers of Charron, and asked them to look out for Agnes. Once she returned from her quest, she was welcomed by villagers who brought her to Etienne.

eton.name: Eton
eton.species: One of the original six A.I. spawned from Pym's Anti-Ultron Virus
eton.origin: Eton the Gardener was one of the original six A.I. spawned from Pym's Anti-Ultron Virus. From within her gardens in the Wunderkammer, Eton is responsible for all growth within The Diamond. Using her quantum precognition, Alexis predicted that Eton would give birth in 10,000 years, which influenced Eton's decision to develop a female form. With Alexis and others, Eton opposed Dimitrios and his war on humanity. When Alexis left the Diamond and lost her memories, Eton waited for her return to aid her in regaining her memories because Alexis had previously predicted these circumstances and events. With Eton's help, Alexis was able to see 10,000 years into the future to get information from her future self and save the Avengers Empire and humanity.

eudora.name: Eudora
eudora.origin: Eudora was a Atlantean scientist that accompanied the former Atlantean king Namor to the underwater human colony Dry Man's Land. Eudora tried to help the humans suffering in Dry Man's Land by converting an Atlantean power generator that only operated underwater to run on dry land but was so far unsuccessful. She then accompanied Namor and Captain America to New York City and witnessed a fight break out between the citizenry and Namor's guards. The fight ended when the Human Torch unexpectedly appeared. Eudora told Namor that the Torch's power to ignite could be used to solve the human colonies' energy woes. Namor and Luke Cage decided to go after the Torch while Eudora tracked the Torch's movements. Eudora was able to locate the Torch's location to what remained of the country of Latveria and reported this to Namor. While experimenting with the Human Torch's molecules, she was suddenly grabbed by the Awesome Android who forcibly took her to the surface so she would suffocate. Using the Human Torch's molecules, Eudora hit the Android with fire, allowing her to escape. Eudora fled to Dry Man's Land and met with Captain America. She then contacted Namor and told him what happened to her. After learning from Namor that the Torch posed no threat, she briefly talked with Captain America about his past with Namor and the Torch. Later, Dry Man's Man was destroyed by Machine Man. Only Eudora survived the attack and informed Namor what happened. It was later discovered that the robots' attacks were the work of Attuma who reprogrammed the robots to launch the attacks as an excuse to wage war on the surface. Attuma was killed, but Namor was also exiled from Atlantis by Queen Namorita. Eudora chose to join Namor in Latveria to help him and his allies rebuild society on the surface.
abilities: Skilled scientist.
weaknesses: Like all Atlanteans, Eudora can only survive out of the water for 10 minutes.

eugene everett.name: Eugene Everett
eugene everett.origin: Eugene Everett, aka "The Kid", was a dice tossing young juvenile delinquent who was frequently in trouble with the law, he regularly detained at the Bronx's 53rd Precinct. During a period in which the Fantastic Four had broken up, the Thing was arrested for an apparent rampage that caused property damage and he shared a cell with Eugene. When the Thing was found guilty, he was locked in a cell with Eugene again. Later when Ben's lawyer Matt Murdock explained that the costumed hero Daredevil (secretly Murdock himself) was investigating the frame job, the Thing broke out of jail to find the man responsible himself. Taking this as an opportunity to get free himself, Eugene followed after the Thing to see what happened next. The Thing and Daredevil were later captured by the Mad Thinker who had predicted that in framing the Thing he lure someone with precognitive abilities which the Mad Thinker hopes to utilize in his schemes to eliminate the "X-Factor" that often thwarted him in the past. The Thinker erroneously believed that Daredevil was the person he sought. When Eugene was caught and captured by the Thinker he was held prisoner so that he could force Daredevil to capture the Vision from Avengers Mansion, as the Thinker plotted to build an army of Visions to take over the world. However with the help of the Vision and his fellow Avenger known as Yellowjacket, Daredevil managed to spring a trap and defeat the Thinker and rescue the Thing and Everett from his clutches. In the aftermath of the battle, the heroes noted Eugene's intuitive ability to predict odds, they quickly realized that the Thinker's computers were referring to Eugene and not Daredevil. After the Kid helped the Thing get cleared of all charges, the Thing thanked the boy by making him a pizza. After getting to share a meal with the Thing, Murdock, and Yellowjacket, Everett grudgingly agreed to go on the straight and narrow and go back to school. The thing accompanied Everett to his school where he was surprised to see his old ally the Black Panther teaching there under the guise of Luke Charles. The Thing later sat in on one of Everett's classes on African history being taught by "Charles". Everett's subsequent activities are unknown.
powers: Eugene is an intuitive who has the power to predict odds, or the behavior of others.

eugene mason.name: Eugene Mason

eugene mason.first_appearance: Power Man and Iron Fist Vol 1 105
eugene mason.origin: Eugene was doing a 30-year sentence in Louisiana for arson and murder. He started off in the Little Alcatraz prison when Luke Cage was in there. One day while out working on a railroad, he faked an illness, knocked out or killed the two guards, and escaped in a truck and headed for New York. He found a cheap apartment to rent in Pottersville and the landlady sold him a suitcase of old clothes left by her previous tenant who was the original Crime-Buster who had died in the Skrull-Xandar War. Figuring he could do the same as Luke Cage, he donned the costume and a wig so no one would recognize him and started to promote himself as a Hero for Hire. His first outing as a hero was when he 'helped' Power Man and Iron Fist by capturing Firefly while they were fighting and claiming the reward for himself. Crime-Buster began to rival the original Heroes for Hire in business, but he would also take on not so innocent clients and was often brutal in his methods, for example he once charged a kid to stop another kid from bullying him, and he shattered the thirteen year old bully's kneecaps. Luke Cage was sure he recognized his voice but couldn't remember where from, the rivalry eventually climaxed when the terrorist group known as the Black Tigers planted a bomb in Madison Square Garden the police called Heroes for Hire and Crime-Buster offering a reward for whoever overpowered the terrorists and disarmed the bomb. They both managed to take down the terrorists, but when it came to disarming the bomb, Crime-Buster ran away when he saw there was only 15 seconds left on the timer, leaving Power Man and Iron Fist to deal with it. After the humiliation, Crime-Buster drifted out of the public limelight, saying he was going to bide his time and that there would be a reckoning for Power Man and Iron Fist. ===After Civil War=== After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative, and joined the Cavalry, the Georgia Initiative team. Crime-Buster was mentioned as serving in the board of directors of the Penance Corps. Fellow board of directors members included Águila, Black Tiger, Justin Alphonse Gamble, and Thunderbolt. The Penance Corps board of a directors reportedly posed for a picture. He was murdered, and his girlfriend, Iron Fist's former P.A Jennie Royce, was convicted of the crime, but with some doubt as to her guilt. The circumstances of his death were later depicted. Muhammad Zebari, the founder and leader of the Penance Corps, was murdered by his underling Joseph Duffy. Duffy took over the Penance Corps after the murder. Crime-Buster eventually discovered that Duffy was really neo-nazi Gerry Kammill. He kept this information to himself and tried to blackmail Duffy, expecting payment. Duffy tasked Crime-Buster with a potentially dangerous mission in Venice, hoping that his blackmailer would be killed. In Venice, Crime-Buster faced Commedia Dell'Morte (The Comedy of Death), a group of villains based on commedia dell'arte characters. They wore enchanted masks, which tasked them with killing at least once every day. Crime-Buster managed to escape with his life, in the process stealing the enchanted mask of Columbina. Jennie later wore the mask and was compelled to kill her boyfriend.
weaknesses: Self-preservation and greed.

eugene stivak.name: Eugene Stivak
eugene stivak.origin: Stivak was a prominent U.S. Senator, but his background is largely unknown. He rose to power as the head of the Corporation's east-coast branch. In addition he maintained an alliance with the Dire Wraiths. The Wraiths required his help in creating a battlesuit that would be capable of besting their archenemy Rom in combat. Stivak entrusted this task to his own nephew Michael Stivak, but lied to the young man about the true purpose of the suit. He also deceived his own superiors in the Corporation, who were convinced that the suit would be an asset for their organization. Michael created the Torpedo Armor as planned, but he somehow learned part of his uncle's evil schemes. He delivered an inferior version of the Armor to Eugene, while keeping an improved version for himself. Eugene realized the deception and tried to acquire the Armor's design notes for study. Michael assumed the vigilante identity of Torpedo, and set out to destroy these notes. Michael was killed before completing his mission, but the task was completed by his successor Brock Jones. Eugene Stivak and the Corporation could neither control the Torpedo Armor, nor duplicate it without these design notes. Stivak had ordered the assassination of the Defector, but he was informed that his initial assassin had failed. He wanted his associate Veda to pass the task to her pet assassin, the Night Flyer. She praised the assassin's perfect record and his solid reputation, but Stivak confided to her that he had doubts concerning the Flyer's reliability. He thought that the Flyer was "too weird" to trust, and he alluded to having heard some wild rumors about this assassin. Stivak used his inferior version of the Torpedo Armor to create derivative battlesuits for a new group of operatives, the Rocketeers. The Rocketeers were tasked with retrieving the improved Torpedo Armor, but they were easily defeated by Daredevil. Stivak yelled at Ainsley Wescott, the current leader of the Rocketeers. He blamed Wescott for the mission's failure, but gave him one more chance to retrieve the Torpedo Armor. Stivak subsequently had a meeting with a few other members of the Corporation, explaining to them that the goal of his plans was to conquer the United States of America. Having discovered Stivak's role in the Corporation, Torpedo (Brock Jones) broke into Stivak's office. Stivak was absent, but he monitored the situation from a distance through hidden cameras. Stivak send his Rocketeers against Torpedo, and they easily defeated the outnumbered hero. Stivak had his new captive transported to his own mansion in Westchester. Stivak and his men were unable to get the battlesuit off the captive hero, despite their constant efforts to do so. An attempt to torture Torpedo backfired and the captive broke free. His initial physical attacks on Stivak angered the senator sufficiently to try to fight back, instead of letting the Rocketeers fight for him. Torpedo knocked Stivak into the ranks of the Rocketeers, and then fled before the mansion's self-destruct mechanism had a chance to kill them all Stivak survived the explosion, and pulled himself out of the mansion's ruins. He decided to frame Torpedo for the attempted assassination of a senator (Stivak himself). Stivak and Veda spied on Captain America as he left the S.H.I.E.L.D. Barbershop Headquarters. Veda was gleeful that one of the team members in the then-new S.H.I.E.L.D. Super-Agents was a double-agent of the Corporation. Stivak was not particularly pleased. His goal was to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D., and a single infiltrator was only a small step towards that goal. Veda called Stival from the Avengers Mansion. She informed him about the recent developments in Captain America's life, and Stivak informed her that he was about to send an assassin after Cap. Veda phoned Stivak to report that Cap had survived a failed assassination attempt, and that he was currently visiting Washington, D.C.. Stivak tasked Animus to attack Cap there. Through Veda's latest report, Stivak learned that Cap was about to return to New York City. Stivak tasked Animus to follow the returning hero, in preparation for another attack. Stivak arranged a meeting with Veda at his office, apparently having their first meeting in person since she started tailing Captain America. Stivak informed her that she had become a liability for the corporation. S.H.I.E.L.D. had taken an interest in her, and its agents were investigating Veda's own mysterious past and that of her alleged mother, Agent R (Betsy Ross). Veda tried to assure Stivak that she was his loyal friend, but he disintegrated her with a hidden weapon in his office desk. As she died, Stivak assured Veda that her murder was authorized by the Corporation's board of directors, and that he wished there was a way to prevent her death. Afterwards, Stivak arranged for a custodian to clean up Veda's ashes. Stivak and another senator visited the Gamma Base, and had meetings concerning its current operations with the

fields.notes: In early appearances, Stivak goes by his middle name, "Kligger". Stivak mentioned that he was acting on behalf of the Corporation's board of directors, and there are a few vague mentions of his own superiors within the ranks of the organization. However, the identities of these higher-ups are unclear. Justin Hammer was identified as an associate of the Corporation, with no clarification whether he was an ally or a member in his own right. The Corporation provided funding for Silvermane's operations and for Silvermane's branch of Hydra, but it was unclear whether Silvermane was a member of the organization or a convenient pawn. Fu Manchu had clearly declined offers of alliance or membership by the Corporation, telling the Corporation members that they were beneath him.

eugene walker.name: Eugene Walker
eugene walker.origin: Eugene Walker was a 14-years old mutants. He joined the Xavier Institute some time after it reopened. Together with his friends, View and Quill, Eugene tried to steal answers for exam from Shadowcat's desk, but they were caught by her. She asked Gambit to talk with them and after spending a day with Gambit they were all awestruck. Eugene decided to become an X-Man in the future, while Quill wanted to become a thief, and View wanted to become both thief and an X-Man. On M-Day only 27 of 182 students of the Xavier Institute retained their powers. Majority of the depowered students left the Institute safely, but when the last 42 of them were sent out on the bus it was destroyed by the Purifiers. Eugene was among the students who lost their powers, but it is unknown if he managed to leave or was killed by William Stryker and the Purifiers.

eugene wildeman.name: Eugene Wildeman
eugene wildeman.first_appearance: Prime vs. The Incredible Hulk Vol 1 0
eugene wildeman.origin: Eugene Wildeman was a scientist who was a former colleague of scientist Bruce Banner aka the Hulk. Over time, Wildeman experiment on several teenagers with gamma radiation, turning them into mutated monsters. When Wildeman tried to lure in a girl in a rough neighborhood to experiment on, he was confronted by Prime, a superhero from Earth-93060. Prime then got into a fight with the Hulk, believing that Prime was attacking Wildeman. Hulk realized his error just as Wildeman sent his test subjects to attack Hulk and Prime so he could collect samples from the two heroes. Wildeman eventually revealed that he experimented on himself as well and transformed into a green-skinned giant. Wildeman was quickly defeated by Hulk and Prime and reverted back to his normal self. He was then arrested by the police.
powers: Gamma Transformation: As a result of exposure to gamma radiation, Wildeman developed the ability to transform into a superhuman giant, presumably gaining several hundred pounds of tissue. His form gives him:

eurypylus.name: Eurypylus
eurypylus.origin: Eurypylus was the son of Telephus, the grandson of Heracles, King of Teuthrania, and a great warrior. Along with an army, he came to aid King Priam of Troy against the Argives. He led the Trojans, killing Machaon, son of Asclepius, in battle. In another battle, he met with Neoptolemus, son of Achilles (who had wounded his father Telephus, then healed him, in a battle in the prelude of the Trojan War.) This fight was observed by many: Trojans, Achaeans, Gods. Neoptolemus finally beat his opponent, plunging his father's ashen spear in Eurypylus' throat. Neoptolemus gloating over the dead body of Eurypylus caused God of War Ares to depart Olympus and join the Trojans, but he was interceptedby Athena who favored the Achaeans. Before they could clash, Zeus intervened, forcing them both to withdraw.
abilities: Eurypylus claimed to have been unmatched in all of his fight, and was seemingly a great warrior.

eurystheus.name: Eurystheus
eurystheus.origin: ===Ancient Times=== Eurystheus was the son of Sthenelus, and as such, the grandson of Perseus. He succeeded his father to the throne of Mycenae, at Tiryns, and became the Great King of Mycenae. He was fated to be Hercules' hated rival from birth and cousin. He was responsible for commissioning the Twelve Labors of Hercules. At each time Hercules returned from a task, Eurystheus feared him so much that would hide in a giant bronze jar. He tried to explain to her he was doing Hera's will, but Alcmena pierced his eyes and Hyllus beheaded him. Hera came to the lifeless body and resurrected him, and Eurystheus sewed his head back. ev carley.name: Ev Carley
ev carley.origin: Ev Carley was a diver aboard the S.S. Recovery, a salvage ship exploring an area of the ocean that had not been salvaged in over three years. In 1939, when his colleague Rod Nelson was investigating a shipwreck, Nelson found a knife that had not rusted, a sign that someone had been down in the wreck recently. His chief mate, finding the story almost impossible to believe, sent Nelson back down with Carley. Investigating the wreck, the two men spotted the young Prince Namor. The boy, seeing all surface dwellers as enemies of his people, and not certain that they were even human due to their diving suits, cut the the cables providing air, telephone communication and gas for their torches and slew both men. He took their corpses back to Atlantis and presented them to the Holy One (Thakorr). Namor was praised by him and his mother Princess Fen. Princess Fen commanded to take the dead bodies of Nelson and Carley, and show those corpses to their people, as the first victory in their war of revenge against the surface dwellers.

eva belyakov.name: Eva Belyakov
eva belyakov.species: Human with Inhuman lineageCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids exposed to Terrigenesis
eva belyakov.origin: Eva Belyakov was an Inhuman granted enhanced strength through Terrigenesis. She also wanted her daughter Katya to be undergo the change, but Jiaying, seeing a darkness in Katya, refused to allow her to be exposed to the mists. Believing her daughter's birthright was denied to her, Eva stole Terrigen Crystals from the Inhumans and went on the run with her daughter. The mists gave Katya the ability to leech off a person's emotions with the simplest touch, giving her control over her victims. Since she was so young, Katya's powers drove her insane, and her mother became one of her victims. By 2008, they made their way to Bahrain, where they had attracted the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Phil Coulson approached her in an attempt to get her to turn herself over to them, but Eva violently rejected the offer and attacked Coulson. A team of thugs under Katya's control grabbed Eva and her daughter and took them to a nearby building. A team of S.H.I.E.L.D. agents soon followed to rescue Katya, who they believed to be a hostage. One agent, Melinda May, found Eva and killed her with a broken piece of furniture.

evald skorpion.name: Evald Skorpion
evald skorpion.origin: Dr. Evald Skorpion was a frequent enemy of Adam Brashear. The day Galactus first came to Earth, Adam and his son Kevin tracked down Skorpion's activities to a subterranean base in Egypt, from where Skorpion planned to use a portal to the Neutral Zone to tear reality apart due to dimensional feedback. When Kevin punched Skorpion, the villain fell into the console which controlled the portal, shorting the system. The portal expanded, transported Kevin to the Neutral Zone, and caused Skorpion to disintegrate. thumb|left|Human form His soul was captured in a crystal by the Maker many years later. He gave him a body genetically engineered from a gorilla and a scorpion, and became the forefront in W.H.I.S.P.E.R.'s "Life-Minus" experiment. Using a high-dimensional frequency ray implanted in his tail, Skorpion, now known as the Neohedron, was able to turn people's head into crystals for the souls of the dead to control their body. He was released in Paris to begin the expansion of Life-Minus. When A.I.M.'s New Avengers attended the situation, they were able to revert the effects of Life-Minus in the innocent people and shatter Neohedron's crystal with Songbird's scream, seemingly sending Skorpion's soul back to the dead. Skorpion returned during Nyx's universe-spanning night. He allied with the Technocracy and tried to end humanity only to be casually defeated by Monica Rambeau.

evan mcbride.name: Evan McBride
evan mcbride.origin: ===School Shooting & Fear of Mutants=== Evan's early history is unknown, but he was a regular student to Costa Verde High School. He and his friend, Teddy, were the school's social outcasts. They would spend their days stirring public disturbances to gain attention. One day, Evan decided to make an example out of school's jock, Nick, by scaring him and the class with a pistol at lunch. Evan wanted to go out on a rampage and gain infamy. When Vice Principal Diller tried to get the gun out of his hand, Evan shot and killed him, causing him to gain national media attention. Teddy decided to stop him, but Evan shot him too. To Evan's surprise, Teddy was impervious to bullets; he was a mutant. To his own displeasure, while watching the news on a phone, reporters identified him and Teddy as mutants, something Teddy never wanted be associated with. To his second surprise, Teddy's sister, Liz revealed she was Firestar. While Firestar defended they have done nothing wrong, Evan decided to shoot Liz; she retaliated and blew out the cafeteria. Evan's fate is uncertain, but he was in front of Liz when she blew out the wall, suggesting he was killed.
weaknesses: Attention seeker

evandre.name: Evandrè
evandre.origin: Evandrè was one of the Amazons living in Themiscyra, on the Thermodon River, in Anatolia. Along with eleven other fellow Amazons Polemusa, Derinoè, Bremusa, Antandrè, Clonié, Hippothoè, Harmothoè, Alcibiè, Derimacheia, Antibrotè and Thermodosa, Evandrè accompanied Penthesilea who went to Troy in the last years of the Trojan War in order to cleanse her soul after the accidental murder of her sister and queen Hippolyta. The Amazons were acclaimed by the crowd and welcomed by King Priam and his family. There, Penthesilea swore that she and her Amazons would kill Achilles and repel the Argives back to their coasts, despite the accusation of arrogance from Andromache, widow of Hector whom Achilles had slain. The next day, they went to battle as the vanguard of the Trojans who were galvanized by Penthesilea. Priam prayed for help to Zeus, but saw an eagle grasping a dove and interpreted it as the fact Penthesileia would not return alive. Thersites alarmed the Argives, and they met the Trojans in the battlefield. There, Evandrè was killed by Meriones, along with Thermodosa. Witnessing the death of her Amazons, Penthesilea entered a fury, and was herself eventually killed by Achilles. Evandrè and the other Amazons were buried beside Penthesilea.

eve android.name: Eve (Android)
eve android.origin: Eve is a Synthezoid created by the High Evolutionary in Counter-Earth, modeled after the Vision. After the members of the Avengers Unity Division were scattered across Counter-Earth when searching for Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch, the Vision found himself in a technologically highly-advanced dormant city, where he was lured to encounter Eve, who had been waiting for him for a long time. Vision fell in love with Eve, who, according to himself, completed him. In a short time after their first encounter, they started creating offspring to inhabit the empty city Eve was living in. Fearing the survival of their offspring could be under risk by the Evolutionary's mad plans, Eve planned to leave the Counter-Earth on a spaceship. Vision tried to convince her to raise their children on Earth, but she refused. On the last second, Vision left Eve and decided to help the Unity Division in their final fight against the High Evolutionary. Eve later contacted Vision, who had now returned to Earth, and showed him images of the world she had found for the children.

Vision fell in love with Eve, who, according to himself, completed him. In a short time after their first encounter, they started creating offspring to inhabit the empty city Eve was living in. Fearing the survival of their offspring could be under risk by the Evolutionary's mad plans, Eve planned to leave the Counter-Earth on a spaceship. Vision tried to convince her to raise their children on Earth, but she refused. On the last second, Vision left Eve and decided to help the Unity Division in their final fight against the High Evolutionary. Eve later contacted Vision, who had now returned to Earth, and showed him images of the world she had found for the children.
