evelyn cream.name: Evelyn Cream
evelyn cream.origin: Evelyn Cream, an agent of the Spookshow, was dispatched to investigate and cover-up the re-emergence of Miracleman. Interrogating terrorist Steven Cambridge, Cream promised not to kill him, and did so anyway. Deducing from Steven's information that Miracleman was secretly Michael Moran, he contrived a situation wherein Moran would be unable to get away or safely transform, in order to shoot him in the gut with tranquilizers. While Evelyn was ordered to kill Moran, he instead kidnapped him, reported a fake name to his superiors, and offered his services to Miracleman, believing that he could befriend and influence the superhuman. Cream guided Miracleman to the bunker where Project Zarathustra was conducted, betraying his superiors in favor of their creation. When the two learned the truth of Project Zarathustra and its director, he managed to calm Miracleman from a berserk rage and convinced him to leave. He later approached Sir Dennis Archer and convinced him to prevent the Spookshow from taking further action against either of them. Moran later enlisted Cream's help finding his wife, who had been kidnapped by Gargunza. Confirming that Kid Miracleman had not re-emerged, he next contacted Dennis Archer. Desperate to avoid Miracleman's wrath, Archer suggested his former employee search for the only other person who knows Miracleman's identity: Emil Gargunza. Tracking Gargunza to South America, Evelyn followed Miracleman to Gargunza's compound, where he briefly reunited Michael and Liz, before he and the temporarily-powerless Moran were chased into the jungle by Gargunza's Miracledog. He gave Moran his gun and split up with him to hopefully attract the creature away from Miracleman's lesser half. In his final moments, he realized the folly of trying to curry the favor of superhumans, as Miracledog chased him down and bit his head off. Years later, after Miracleman had taken over the world and established his pantheon, the Qys death god Mors resurrected Cream, as he had many others in his Underworld. Miracleman put his old ally in charge of a fake City where the inherently-treacherous intelligence community were confined for their own safety under para-reality programming. When one such agent attempted to escape the City, Cream approached her at the border to explain the purpose of the City. Disillusioned with her life as a spy and thus capable of being rehabilitated, Cream promised not to kill her, and allowed her to leave.
abilities: Cream had a thorough classical education, and was able to speak multiple languages well enough to read foreign texts untranslated. He was also a trained assassin and spy.

He never let this insecurity show, but had complicated feelings about being the assistant of a godlike White man. Plagued by recurring nightmares about being an escaped slave in a deadly jungle, he tried to brush off these fears as "hysterical mysticism," but his mind would return there both times he followed Miracleman into battle.

evelyn ives.name: Evelyn Ives
evelyn ives.origin: It seemed that Evelyn Ives was a beautiful girl created by the illusionist and the famous hypnotist Bart Cobb as a means of a prank to be played on the new kind and submissive neighbor Willard Peebles. Cobb arranged for Peebles to meet Evelyn and hoped that he would fall in love with her, and in fact he did, to the point that Peeble decided to marry her. At the wedding, Peebles' neighbors acted as witnesses, while Cobb was intent on continuing the prank by making Evelyn disappear while they were leaving for their honeymoon, but suddenly they saw a rocket take off with Peebles and his wife Evelyn on top and Cobb who could not make her disappear discovering, from what was written on the rocket, that Peebles was an alien from Mercury and was considered the greatest wizard in the universe, and Evelyn had become real.

evelyn stanzler.name: Evelyn Stanzler
evelyn stanzler.origin: Evelyn Stanzler was a Justice Department agent who appointed Assistant District Attorney Matt Murdock to prosecute Clint Barton during his trial for the murder of Bruce Banner. Stanzler planned on manipulating Murdock and Judge Rappaport into making the jury reach Barton's conviction, with the intention to use the trial's outcome to promote the reinstitution of the Superhuman Registration Act, as she expressed it to the D.O.D.'s Walter Strakofsky. With the help of Barton's lawyer, Mr. Rikleen, Murdock found out about Stanzler's conspiracy and proceeded to ensure Barton had a fair trial, which resulted in his acquittal, to Stanzler's annoyance.

evenor.name: Evenor
evenor.origin: Evenor was one of the autochthons (primeval quasi-deities), the "offspring of the soil", and an Atlantean god known as Lord of the Water-Spirits. He was also the father of Cleito, mothered by Leucippe. When Neptune claimed Atlantis, he married Cleito, and they fathered the ten first kings of Atlantis, ten gods who ruled in the centuries between 18,500 and 18,000 BC. It was said that the land Atlantis prospered from the presence of the autochthons. As the guardian of the City of the Golden Gate, after Atlantis sank in the Great Cataclysm, Evenor was sworn to guard the Shroud of Cleito, an holy relic, in the City of the Golden Gate. He tried to prevent Namor from taking it and sullying it, and damning him in the name of the Ten. Namor finally accepted Evenor's wisdom.

ever.name: Ever
ever.origin: Ever was apparently one of the younger generation of Morlocks, exiled to The Hill dimension after Mikhail Rasputin saved them from the flooding of the Morlock Tunnels. When Callisto tracked the terrorist splinter group of Morlocks called Gene Nation back to Earth, she presented a hologram of the Nationals that included Ever in their ranks. For some reason, however, Ever was not among Gene Nation when they were captured by Callisto and the X-Men. Ever befriended Alex Summers when Havok decided to fight more aggressively for mutant rights as leader of the new Brotherhood of Mutants. They briefly hijacked a commercial airliner before getting removed by the X-Men. When Havok recruited his former brainwasher the Dark Beast in order to keep an eye on him, Ever retreated into the shadows. Instead of interacting with the untrustworthy McCoy and Fatale, he watched them from a distance on Havok's behalf. Once Ever learned McCoy was experimenting on innocent civilians, he reported the news to Havok.
powers: Unique Physiology: His entire body's composed of compacted grey matter, granting him varied and potent psionic abilities. Mild

everdrop of the green.name: Everdrop of the Green
everdrop of the green.origin: Highelf Everdrop was a Light Elf who, for nearly three hundred years, took care of Qaoyak, a tree that was a seedling from Yggdrasill. Every day he ensured that Qaoyak was shown love and affection since the tree radiated life, growth and joy for all who were near it, and Everdrop believed that one of the truths of the universe was that to grow love and joy in one's life, one must feed that love in the world. On the night before the anniversary of the end of the War of the Realms, Everdrop was ambushed on Qaoyak by Valg, a villain from another reality. After murdering Everdrop, Valg impersonated him during the following day's celebratory ceremony.

everett bliss.name: Everett Bliss
everett bliss.first_appearance: Captain America II: Death Too Soon
everett bliss.origin: Everett Bliss was an operative of the Government of the United States. He received orders from the President. When international terrorist General Miguel threatened to unleash an age-speeding chemical on several American cities, Bliss was sent to deal with the situation. Bliss contacted scientists Dr. Wendy Day and Dr. Simon Mills for expert advice; they confirmed Bliss that such a weapon was feasible. Bliss was reticent to deal with terrorists, as he had no way to know whether Miguel would (or could) honor his word; and at the same time, he thought that Miguel would not want to negotiate. The scientists worked overtime, but unsuccessfully, trying to develop an antidote. Bliss finally decided to not accept a blackmail, following the policy of the United States. Miguel sent a plane to spray the city of Portland, Oregon with his chemical, and then publicly announced that the antidote was available for one billion dollars. Mills stressed to Bliss the urgency of the situation, but Bliss still doubted that Miguel really had an antidote. Predicting Bliss' problem, Miguel offered a limited sample of the antidote. Dr. Day offered to travel to Portland and test it in one of the affected inhabitants. Bliss was thinking about tests in animals, but Day thought there was no time for that, and she left by plane (probably Bliss provided her the plane). Day risked her own life but confirmed that the antidote was operative; however, neither she nor Mills could produce more of it. Before Bliss could continue his telephone-based negotiations with Miguel, the terrorist was stopped by Captain America. Captain America also obtained enough antidote to heal the population of Portland.

everett donnelly.name: Everett Donnelly
everett donnelly.origin: Everett Donnelly was one of several men affected by gamma radiation-related poisoning. The supervillain Leader offered to cure them through a procedure that included decapitating the subject and attaching his head to an android body with superhuman abilities, which the Leader intended to use for his own purposes. The procedure was a success and Donnelly gained superhuman strength and the ability to generate extreme cold, earning him the alias Frost. Frost and five other cyborgs created by the Leader in a similar way then escaped the Leader's servitude, associating with each other in the group Headshop to seek revenge on the Leader. Frost was pilot of the group's ship for a time, but then resigned. For a time, Frost worked as a freelance hitman, until he was hired by Sam Striker, a casino owner in Las Vegas, as his main enforcer. Frost's previous activities, however, had attracted the attention of the vigilante Punisher, who followed his trail to Las Vegas. The other members of the Headshop also heard that Frost was working in Las Vegas, but then stopped hearing of him. Striker wanted to be the top man in the city, for which he wanted to get rid of the current top man, Michael Berengetti, owner of the Coliseum Casino, and add Berengetti's assets to his own. Striker sent Frost to assassinate Berengetti with a high-tech weapon. The hit was a success, but it attracted the attention of Berengetti's old friend, the super-strong Mr. Fixit, who went to Las Vegas to investigate what happened with the help of some also superpowered friends. Frost accompanied Striker to the Coliseum with many other thugs, where, immediately after the funeral of Berengetti, Striker attempted to intimidate the widow Mrs. Berengetti to give him her husband's valuable assets, since she had no one to protect her. Fixit entered at that moment, claiming to be the top man in Las Vegas. Striker unleashed his human goons on Fixit, and when they proved useless, Frost grabbed Fixit's wrist. Fixit discovered that Frost's strength was comparable to his own and he also had cold powers, but Fixit intimidated Striker by saying that if he didn't make his "dog" back off, he would break him. Striker, choosing his battles, decided to leave for the moment to decide what to do with this new enemy. Because Fixit was quickly gaining popularity in Las Vegas and jeopardizing his plans, Striker decided to eliminate him; and Frost agreed to carry out some impromptu action against Fixit. In reality, Fixit did not want to take over Las Vegas, but had come to investigate the death of his friend and bring the person responsible to justice, and by then he had discovered it had been Striker. Fixit allied himself with the Punisher and with detective Louisa Sanchez, of the LVPD, to lure out Striker and Frost with a fake drug buy. As part of that plan, Fixit's man Paris visited Striker in Striker's Excalibur Hotel and Casino, falsely saying that he wanted to join Striker's people because he expected Striker would defeat Fixit. To convince Striker, he told him that Fixit was going to receive a shipment of illegal drugs (provided by Punisher) at the Acme Storage warehouse over on 5th, at 10:00 p.m., and that Fixit was going to be there, so Striker could notify the police and have Fixit arrested. Paris had to go to the operation, so that Fixit wouldn't get suspicious, but Paris was counting on Striker to use his influence after him to get him out of jail. Frost grabbed Paris by the neck, threatening to kill him if he had been lying; Paris, being a tough man, simply claimed that he'll wear a scarf in his next visit. After he left, Striker decided that, instead, he would have his people attack the operation to kill Fixit, and keep the drugs and money. In reality, the drugs were just cremora, the provider "Frank Tower" was the Punisher in disguise, and several LVPD officers would be hiding in the warehouse, waiting for Striker to confess to Berengetti's murder. That night, Striker had Frost take compromising photos of Fixit with the drugs, revealed his presence, and demanded the drugs and money, or he would turn the photos over to the police. Fixit pretended to be on the ropes, and Striker began talking about how he could Fixit as he had killed Berengetti; Fixit convinced him to give details by accusing him of being too cowardly to kill him in person, and Striker admitted Frost had done the deed, identifying the gun; when the police had enough information, they revealed themselves. Frost initiated a shootout against the police, during which Striker was wounded, but Fixit and his allies had superpowers that protected the police officers. As Striker's men were losing, Frost retreated, with Fixit after him due to their previous encounter. The Punisher shot at Frost, but he was bulletproof and threw a car at the Punisher to get rid of him. fields.history: Everett Donnelly was one of several men affected by gamma radiation-related poisoning. The supervillain Leader offered to cure them through a procedure that included decapitating the subject and attaching his head to an android body with superhuman abilities, which the Leader intended to use for his own purposes. The procedure was a success and Donnelly gained superhuman strength and the ability to generate extreme cold, earning him the alias Frost. Frost and five other cyborgs created by the Leader in a similar way then escaped the Leader's servitude, associating with each other in the group Headshop to seek revenge on the Leader. Frost was pilot of the group's ship for a time, but then resigned. For a time, Frost worked as a freelance hitman, until he was hired by Sam Striker, a casino owner in Las Vegas, as his main enforcer. Frost's previous activities, however, had attracted the attention of the vigilante Punisher, who followed his trail to Las Vegas. The other members of the Headshop also heard that Frost was working in Las Vegas, but then stopped hearing of him. Striker wanted to be the top man in the city, for which he wanted to get rid of the current top man, Michael Berengetti, owner of the Coliseum Casino, and add Berengetti's assets to his own. Striker sent Frost to assassinate Berengetti with a high-tech weapon. The hit was a success, but it attracted the attention of Berengetti's old friend, the super-strong Mr. Fixit, who went to Las Vegas to investigate what happened with the help of some also superpowered friends. Frost accompanied Striker to the Coliseum with many other thugs, where, immediately after the funeral of Berengetti, Striker attempted to intimidate the widow Mrs. Berengetti to give him her husband's valuable assets, since she had no one to protect her. Fixit entered at that moment, claiming to be the top man in Las Vegas. Striker unleashed his human goons on Fixit, and when they proved useless, Frost grabbed Fixit's wrist. Fixit discovered that Frost's strength was comparable to his own and he also had cold powers, but Fixit intimidated Striker by saying that if he didn't make his "dog" back off, he would break him. Striker, choosing his battles, decided to leave for the moment to decide what to do with this new enemy. Because Fixit was quickly gaining popularity in Las Vegas and jeopardizing his plans, Striker decided to eliminate him; and Frost agreed to carry out some impromptu action against Fixit. In reality, Fixit did not want to take over Las Vegas, but had come to investigate the death of his friend and bring the person responsible to justice, and by then he had discovered it had been Striker. Fixit allied himself with the Punisher and with detective Louisa Sanchez, of the LVPD, to lure out Striker and Frost with a fake drug buy. As part of that plan, Fixit's man Paris visited Striker in Striker's Excalibur Hotel and Casino, falsely saying that he wanted to join Striker's people because he expected Striker would defeat Fixit. To convince Striker, he told him that Fixit was going to receive a shipment of illegal drugs (provided by Punisher) at the Acme Storage warehouse over on 5th, at 10:00 p.m., and that Fixit was going to be there, so Striker could notify the police and have Fixit arrested. Paris had to go to the operation, so that Fixit wouldn't get suspicious, but Paris was counting on Striker to use his influence after him to get him out of jail. Frost grabbed Paris by the neck, threatening to kill him if he had been lying; Paris, being a tough man, simply claimed that he'll wear a scarf in his next visit. After he left, Striker decided that, instead, he would have his people attack the operation to kill Fixit, and keep the drugs and money. In reality, the drugs were just cremora, the provider "Frank Tower" was the Punisher in disguise, and several LVPD officers would be hiding in the warehouse, waiting for Striker to confess to Berengetti's murder. That night, Striker had Frost take compromising photos of Fixit with the drugs, revealed his presence, and demanded the drugs and money, or he would turn the photos over to the police. Fixit pretended to be on the ropes, and Striker began talking about how he could Fixit as he had killed Berengetti; Fixit convinced him to give details by accusing him of being too cowardly to kill him in person, and Striker admitted Frost had done the deed, identifying the gun; when the police had enough information, they revealed themselves. Frost initiated a shootout against the police, during which Striker was wounded, but Fixit and his allies had superpowers that protected the police officers. As Striker's men were losing, Frost retreated, with Fixit after him due to their previous encounter. The Punisher shot at Frost, but he was bulletproof and threw a car at the Punisher to get rid of him. When a police helicopter team tried to make Frost surrender, he leaped to reach the helicopter, dropped the men and tried to escape, but Fixit f

everett thomas moira iv 8.first_appearance: Rise of the Powers of X Vol 1 1
everett thomas moira iv 8.origin: In this timeline, Orchis was successful in its mission to destroy mutantkind, leaving only a few scattered survivors. In time, Orchis was wholly usurped by the machines, who continued to wage war against the X-Men while using their advanced technology to summon a Dominion that could absorb them into its nigh omnipotent machine intellect. Everett became the leader of the X-Men, and began mostly copying the abilities of Charles Xavier. With his body ravaged by overuse of his powers, Synch became confined to a wheelchair. Knowing that the only hope of averting the machines' plan lay in resetting their own timeline, the X-Men sought to find Mr. Sinister, since his Moira Engine would allow them to reset their timeline. The X-Men managed to trace Sinister to a prison on Phobos. They were quickly intercepted by Nimrod and Omega Sentinel, who quickly overmanned the team. In need of a distraction, Everett sacrificed himself for one last synch, tapping into the powers of Apocalypse. The distraction was successful, as Shadowtiger was able to launch Wolverine into Sinister's cell. Wolverine killed Sinister, triggering the Moira Engine's fail-safe and resetting the timeline.
powers: Thanks an evolved "memory," Everett can tap into the abilities of presumably deceased individuals like Charles Xavier and Apocalypse.
weaknesses: Overuse of his powers has crippled Everett, leaving him wheelchair-bound.

everwraith.name: Everwraith
everwraith.first_appearance: Sunfire and Big Hero Six Vol 1 1
everwraith.origin: Everwraith is the astral embodiment of all the people that died during the nuclear attacks on Hiroshima and Nagasaki at the end of World War II. It initially plotted revenge against the United States of America but decades later, realized that Japan had excelled both financially and technologically; it then believed this was a result of the atomic attacks. In the Modern Era, Everwraith started to disappear, as the Japanese started to forget the anger that formed it. However before departing it wanted to leave a last gift to Japan: a new nuclear attack horror, believing this was the only thing that will make Japan grow even further. It saw its opportunity when an electromagnetic pulse released by Magneto caused the Japanese hero Sunfire's atomic-based powers to go out of control. Everwraith also kidnapped Hiro Takachiho's mother in hopes that this would put Takachiho in conflict with Sunfire. However when its plan was discovered, Takachiho ended up joining the Japanese super hero team Big Hero 6.
weaknesses: It is vulnerable to Sunfire's flames, thought whether it's fire in general or just atomic fire is unknown. It can also be rendered tangible with a type of ectoplasm.

evil deadpool.origin: ===Origins=== The origins of the being known as "Evil Deadpool" are tied to Ella Whitby, a British psychiatrist obsessed with the super-human mercenary Deadpool. She collected numerous parts of Deadpool's body that he had lost over the years, and kept them in her freezer. When Deadpool found them, he threw them in a dumpster in disgust. The parts eventually thawed and, since they all had Deadpool's healing factor, fused together into a single person. thumb|left Evil Deadpool hijacked the private plane of an American businessman and travelled to the United States around the same time the original Deadpool did. The two crossed paths for the first time after the Evil Deadpool blew up Deadpool's favorite chimichanga joint and fought until they ran out of bullets. Both Deadpool agreed for a second round at Canarsie Park. Their second explosive encounter caught the attention of Captain America, who arrived to the scene after Evil Deadpool had escaped. As the real Deadpool fended off Captain America, and tried to convince him of his doppelganger's existence, Evil Deadpool set out to show him what the world really thought of him. To this end, Evil Deadpool went to Mister Negative to find the "greasiest, shadiest, most heinous piece of wet work gig," which involved kidnapping the children of New York City's chief of police, intending to do the one thing the real Wade would never do, kill a kid. Meanwhile, Deadpool kidnapped a child in the middle of Times Square and threatened to kill him, believing that to be a course of action the Evil Deadpool would take, so threatening to do so would prompt Evil Deadpool to attack Deadpool for stealing his thunder, causing him to leave his plans behind and expose his existence in order to vindicate Deadpool. Naturally, Evil Deadpool expected Deadpool's actions, and didn't take the bait. thumb|left|Unmasked Evil Deadpool then lured both Deadpool and the NYPD chief to a warehouse at 615 South Street where the kidnapped children were being held. After rescuing the chief's kids and helping them leave with their father, both Deadpool faced-off. Captain America and the NYPD appeared on the scene, after having found the note that had lured the police chief. Right before the police opened fire at Evil Deadpool, a mysterious dart loaded with a serum hit him, and it neutralized his healing factor, causing him to die of the injuries sustained by the bullets. Deadpool desired to know how did his doppelgänger manage to die, and used Evil Deadpool's teleporter to escape, taking his corpse with him, which he ultimately abandoned. thumb|right|Apparent death However, the effects of the serum proved to be simply temporary, causing Evil Deadpool to eventually return from the dead. He was one of the several enemies of the Merc with a Mouth assembled by Interpol agent Allison Kemp, who wanted to have revenge on Deadpool for indirectly causing her to become tetraplegic nine years earlier. Evil Deadpool surprised the real Wade with his resurgence a few moments after Agent Kemp had given up on her quest for revenge, and shot him. ===Deadpool Kills Deadpool=== Evil Deadpool's chaotic nature led him to join the Evil Deadpool Corps, a conglomeration of Deadpools led by the Dreadpool of Earth-12101, with the objective of getting of every Deadpool across the Multiverse. Together with other several Deadpools, Evil Deadpool ambushed the base of operations of the good Deadpool Corps and killed most of their members while a handful of them were occupied recruiting Evil Deadpool's counterpart, the main Deadpool. The surviving Deadpools were attacked by Evil Deadpool and his teammates when they returned to the base, engaging in combat long enough to let Galactipool devour the planet they were standing in. Deadpool managed to get the upper hand in a one-on-one fight against Evil Deadpool, and beat him to a pulp, literally. Evil Deadpool eventually regenerated, but he was crushed with Galactipool's head after Lady Deadpool had killed him. Evil Deadpool resurfaced once again, having returned to the base of operations of the Evil Deadpool Corps and witnessed as Deadpool emerged victorious after fighting Dreadpool. He was among the doppelgangers brainwashed Deadpool-71986 thought about when battling Gwenpool. ===Mercs for Money=== After returning to life through unknown means, Evil Deadpool was enlisted by an omniscient Rigellian Recorder to help him achieve a mysterious purpose. The dismantled Recorder was eventually acquired by Deadpool and his Mercs for Money. examiner robot.name: Examiner (Robot)
examiner robot.origin: The Examiner was a robot built by the Sligs to test the power of the West Coast Avengers. After capturing them, the Sligs sent to an alien dimension and they were tested one by one by the Examiner. After each defeat he was rebuilt to adapt against his previous foe. The Sligs energy source was strained but they assumed the Examiner would easily defeat, Moon Knight. However, he used Khonshu to draw power from the thousands of moons in their dimension. Moon Knight tore the Examiner to shreds and overloaded the ship's batteries causing it to explode, the data the Examiner collected became muddled and combined all the Avengers powers into one being which scared away the Sligs.

excellency.name: Excellency
excellency.origin: His Excellency was ruler of Earth in the 30th Century on Earth-49121. In this future world all needs were completely automated and carried out by machines, eliminating the need for original thought. However, the Excellency came up with an idea of taking beings from the 20th Century and putting them in a zoo for his people's amusement. To this end, his Excellency sent his minion Kall to the year 1949 of Earth-616. There Kall tricked a group of prominent citizens into boarding his time machine and brought them to the future. Among those who were kidnapped were private detective Mark Mason and the Blonde Phantom. The Blonde Phantom managed to escape the zoo and transport herself to the residence of his Excellency. However, she was watched the whole way by the Excellency who invited her in. He explained to her how superior their society was and how it was impossible to defeat them. However, when he explained that the people of his future world were incapable of independent thought, the Blonde Phantom did find a means to defeat him: With hypnosis. Hypnotizing his Excellency, Blonde Phantom forced him to free their captives and pilot the time machine back to Earth. His Excellency accompanied them on the Blonde Phantom's orders in order to prevent him from trying to kidnap people from her own era again. The trip back wiped out everyone's memories except for his Excellency and the Blonde Phantom. Back in her guise of Louise Grant, she was shocked when his Excellency arrived at Mark Mason's office asking for her. What Louise chose to do with the Excellency and his ultimate fate is unknown.

exiter.name: Exiter
exiter.origin: Exitar was the cat familiar of Satana. When Satana was exiled to Earth, Exiter appeared by her side and discussed her options against the Four who had trapped her on Earth. After Satana was brutally attacked by henchmen of Jimmy Cruz, Exiter transformed into a more powerful form and quickly slew the attackers. Exiter forced Michael Heron into taking Satana into his apartment so she could consume a soul to gain her strength back. After Heron was kidnapped, Exiter followed and was discovered by Cruz who unleashed the N'Garai on him and Exiter was killed.

exo mind.name: Exo-Mind
exo mind.origin: Possibly predating the universe itself, an unnamed race of extradimensional Gods or Elders existed in an alien universe where chaos rather than order was the binding force of existence, and such a realm was dominated by suffering and squalor. These Elders created the Bloodgem in order to conquer other dimensions, intending to turn those realms into a form similar to their own. The Bloodgem served as a conduit to the energies of the Hellfire Helix, which is a point in space through which all magics and such energies pass. These energies somehow created a consciousness that is known as Exo-Mind. The Exo-Mind created Ulluxy'l Kwan Tae Syn as its guardian, as per the wishes of the Elders, who apparently needed five such guardians to complete the ritual necessary for the crossing of dimensions. However, the Exo-Mind had no interest in the outcome of the Elder's efforts. It was more interested in the struggle for its own sake, so it sabotaged the ritual to tilt the odds against the Elders for no reason other than to make the outcome more interesting. The Bloodgem was hurled across time and space, arriving in the final stages of the already collapsing universe. The Bloodgem survived the death of its home reality and was released during the subsequent "Big Bang" of the prime dimension. Thousands of years before the modern day, the Bloodgem was one of many powerful gems brought by extra-terrestrial scientists to the planet Kree-Lar. The scientists had discovered an immense stone of tremendous power, which they had split in half and dubbed the Alpha and Omega Stones. The energies released in the split killed thousands, but drew the attention of more advanced races, who came to Kree-Lar to investigate the energies. The visiting races each brought their own artifacts, seeking a common link. They found that link upon the realization that all the artifacts brought were remnants of the Big Bang. All the artifacts were joined together into the Lifestone Tree, and their combined power was used to advance the evolutionary traits of eight chosen representatives of their races, who became the Chosen Eight of Fate. These Eight protected the galaxy for two hundred years until eventually breaking up. The Lifestones were taken from Kree-Lar to prevent intergalactic pirates from stealing them, but the mission was discovered and the ark carrying the Lifestones was attacked. Its warp drive created an implosion, creating a fissure in space which thrust the Lifestones to the far corners of the galaxy. One spatial anomaly opened on the fringes of Earth's Solar System, and a number of the Lifestones fell to Earth, the Bloodstone being one of them. The Bloodgem arrived on Earth, and its utilization allowed it to be located anew by the Exo-Mind. The Exo-Mind observed the evolution of humanity through disinterested eyes, requiring a host whose existence revolved around a single purpose. The man who would become Ulysses Bloodstone was born to a small nomadic tribe who occupied Northern Vanaheim, which would later be called Scandinavia. Growing into one of the tribe's foremost hunters, he one night observed a meteorite crashing to the Earth, approximately on the year 8250 BCE. He directed his subsequent hunting endeavors in that direction, and tailed behind a cloaked figure (Ulluxy'l), who led Ulysses into the cavern which housed his advanced citadel. Leading Ulysses to the altar of the Bloodgem, the Exo-Mind empowered the nomad. Ulysses returned to his tribe, inviting them to be endowed with the same superhuman strength that he had been given, but the Exo-Mind instead absorbed the life energies of Ulysses' entire tribe, enraging him. Upon attacking the Bloodgem, the artifact exploded into multiple fragments, one of which embedding itself in Ulysses' chest. The nomad would one day become Ulysses Bloodstone, an immortal adventurer whose exploits last for nearly 10,000 years. Exo-Mind allegedly created or directed a large number of monsters for Bloodstone to fight over the years, all to keep him occupied from accomplishing his ultimate goal, slaying Ulluzy'l and avenging his tribe, thus retaining him as Exo-Mind's host indefinitely. In addition, the Exo-Mind inhibited Bloodstone's ability to cope in the abstract and inhibited his reasoning, so that he would never suspect the true reason he had been chosen to receive the power of the Bloodgem. Eventually, in the modern era, the Exo-Mind decided it wished to experience death through Bloodstone, since its own life was eternal. At the same time it decided, having experienced all it could through innocent eyes, it wished a new perspective. To this end, the Exo-Mind organized the Conspiracy to usurp Bloodstone's gem. They would gain its power by collecting the many Bloodstone fragments in exchange for providing the Exo-Mind this new perspective. One day, through intense meditation, Ulysses came to understand the existence of the Exo-Mind and its threat to humanity. Ulluxy'l was a member of the Conspi

experiment n2.name: Experiment N2
experiment n2.origin: In 1944, Mr. Sinister worked with the Nazis. Attacked in his U-boat by Namor, Sinister was impressed by the hero, and was able to collect a sample of blood during the battle. From that sample, he was able to create Experiment N2, a clone of Namor, "saving" selected people from the camps and using their blood to give life to his creation. The camps and his laboratory were soon attacked by the Invaders Namor and the Human Torch, and Sinister intended to dispatch Experiment N2 on the field, which N2 choose to do by himself, freeing himself. He was able to take down both the atlantean and the android but, much to Sinister's surprise, was defeated by the "powerless" Captain America. It is unknown if Captain America killed him and, if not, what was his fate.
abilities: Expert Combatant: The N2 Clone was "well-prepared" to take down the Invaders, except for Captain America.

explosa.name: Explosa
explosa.origin: thumb|left|Using her powers This mutant was the only known member of the Bogotá Cell of the Brotherhood. When their headquarters was raided by US military agents, she blew up the complex killing herself and most soldiers. The two survived soldiers were brought to Barksdale Air Force Base in Louisiana, but one of them died from injuries on the way. The last one was left barely alive and was interrogated by General Hammond. Soldier was in fact another member of the Brotherhood, Oswald, he gave General Hammond the letter from X, saying that Hammond, the military and the government couldn't stop the revolution. He then exploded, killing Hammond and destroying half of the base.

extreme reporter.name: Extreme Reporter
extreme reporter.origin: The Extreme Reporter began his career as a Mixed Martial Artist and fighter who failed to find success in his chosen field. His victories came from his ability to trash talk and distract his opponents until they were too disoriented and full of rage to think out their plans and attacked blindly. He built a character out of this behavior, using his hammy and over the top performances to climb in the world until he was able to begin staging his own personal sporting events as "The Extreme Reporter", which he commanded from his personal blimp over New York. During the Cross-Species Virus epidemic, The Extreme Reporter flew his blimp over Manhattan to video tape the Amazing Spider-Man as he soared throughout various races and trick challenges. While some believed the show was in bad taste in the middle of the chaos, just as many considered The Extreme Reporter a valiant man doing his best to use his job to keep the people of New York's morale up during the taxing times.

eye killers.species: Demons; vampiric in nature ; night creatures of Native American Mythology; possibly related to evil were-owl spirits, the Skili , or the Skinwalkers
eye killers.origin: The Eye Killers were a brother-and-sister pair soul-stealing demons, vampiric in nature, night creatures of Native American Mythology, possibly related to evil were-owl spirits, the Skili , or the Skinwalkers. They killed the boyfriend of one of Wong's friends. Once empowered by the Darkhold, they took the form of large birds. They were able to suck the life essence from Clea, but Dr. Strange defeated them by sending them to another dimension. Later, they attacked Storm and Naze while they were camping in the Rocky Mountains. They claimed they used to terrorize Native Americans before the white men came. The were now working for the Adversary who had promised them he could bring those days back again. During the course of battle, Storm noticed they had a weakness to fire and was able to exploit that to destroy them both.
weaknesses: Fire

eyla cire.name: Eyla Cire
eyla cire.origin: Eyla Cire was from a world of peace and technological marvels. Upon laying eyes on Cable, she was instantly enamored with his warrior-like strangeness and invited him to a dance that was interrupted by the Ranshi Empire. She sought Cable out to to convince him to kill Randall Shire, thus martyring him and bringing about her future. However, upon traveling to modern times to convince Cable, she and her father were ambushed by the Empire and Sandella who revealed the truth to Cable, that Harmony had eradicated all mutants through eugenics. After Cable negated both realities, she joined with her extradimensional counterpart, Sandella, to forge their own timeline the Sandeyla future.
powers: Through the genetic engineering of Harmony, she had peak strength, agility, and reflexes. Further, her blood contained nano machines that interacted with her world's technology.

eylen.name: Eylen
eylen.species: Spyrican mutated via exposure to cosmic rays
eylen.origin: Eylen was a member of the inner council of the Overseer, the patriarch of the planet Spyre. When four explorers from Earth attempted to reach Spyre but they had their rocketship scuttled by a cosmic ray storm that gave them powers, becoming the Fantastic Four, the Overseer dreaded the threat they could pose if they were to resume their original mission now that they had powers. To this end, the Overseer decided to harness cosmic rays himself and give powers to volunteering Spyricans in hopes to combat the Fantastic Four if they were ever to arrive. Eylen was the first to subject himself to the Overseer's procedure. Gaining the ability to control water, he renounced his previous name and adopted the identity of Elementa, the Water Witch. Along with other few superpowered Spyricans, Eylen joined the Unparalleled to become one of Spyre's protectors. Over a decade after their initial and failed attempt to reach Spyre, the Fantastic Four sought to complete their original mission. When they approached Spyre, the Overseer warned the Unparalleled of their arrival. The team intercepted the explorers and subdued them, but the Fantastic Four managed to establish that they meant no harm. However, when Mister Fantastic deduced that the Overseer had been secretly responsible for tampering the intensity of the cosmic ray storm that bestowed the Fantastic Four their powers, the Overseer ordered the Unparalleled to kill the visitors. After Mister Fantastic and the Invisible Woman slipped away, Elementa was one of the Unparalleled deployed to the streets of Hightown to defuse a rebellion from the Monster Mob, the outcasts of Spyre who had been banished from society due to the Overseer's cosmic ray exposure turning them into monsters. Once Mister Fantastic exposed the Overseer's secret role in the creation of the Fantastic Four, making him responsible for the very threat the Spyricans feared, The Thing confronted the Overseer at the Tower of Over-Site, causing its collapse. The Unparalleled, the Monster Mob and the Fantastic Four joined forces to contain the falling debris. After the Unparalleled and the Fantastic Four made peace, Mister Fantastic shared with the Spyricans a cure to temporary revert cosmic ray mutates back to normal, which helped welcome the Monster Mob back into society. However, Elementa led the pushback against accepting back the Monster Mob. Later, the Unparalleled bid the Fantastic Four farewell as they prepared to return to Earth accompanied by Unparalleled member Sky. Much after the Fantastic Four left, and Kaila came back to the Unparalleled, Spyre was under attack from Annihilus during the reckoning war. Eylen was on the scene when The Human Torch saved the planet at recruited the Unparalleled to his army of heroes across the galaxy, and later Eylen helped save the Watchers on T-37X.
powers: He can shoot high-speed water projectiles and surround an opponent's head on a water bubble. : Elementa can also ride water streams and whirlwinds for transportation.

The Unparalleled, the Monster Mob and the Fantastic Four joined forces to contain the falling debris. After the Unparalleled and the Fantastic Four made peace, Mister Fantastic shared with the Spyricans a cure to temporary revert cosmic ray mutates back to normal, which helped welcome the Monster Mob back into society. However, Elementa led the pushback against accepting back the Monster Mob. Later, the Unparalleled bid the Fantastic Four farewell as they prepared to return to Earth accompanied by Unparalleled member Sky. Much after the Fantastic Four left, and Kaila came back to the Unparalleled, Spyre was under attack from Annihilus during the reckoning war. Eylen was on the scene when The Human Torch saved the planet at recruited the Unparalleled to his army of heroes across the galaxy, and later Eylen helped save the Watchers on T-37X.

ezekiel tork.name: Ezekiel Tork
ezekiel tork.origin: Ezekiel “Zeke” Tork was a swamp-dweller who lived in isolation deep within the Florida Everglades with his wife, Maybelle, and his beloved dog, Dawg. Their secluded existence was marked by tension, as Maybelle believed Zeke cared more for his dog than for her. When the curious Man-Thing approached their home, Maybelle was so terrified by the creature’s appearance that she suffered a heart attack. Zeke drove the swamp-being away with a rifle before setting out to find medical help, leaving Maybelle behind with Dawg. During his journey, Zeke was repeatedly endangered by bizarre supernatural threats within the swamp itself, including living trees, snakes, alligators, and even the animated remains of long-dead swamp victims. Though frightened of the creature, Zeke was repeatedly rescued by the Man-Thing, which defended him from the swamp’s attacks and carried him onward after he was strangled unconscious by one of the undead. As the Man-Thing carried him through the swamp, Zeke recounted the story of his life with Maybelle and their decision to abandon society for life in the Everglades. He also explained Maybelle’s resentment toward Dawg. During their trip to the mainland, Zeke entered a diner seeking help and spare change to make a phone call, but the locals mocked and assaulted him until the Man-Thing intervened. After returning home with the swamp creature, Zeke and the Man-Thing were attacked by a spectral manifestation embodying Maybelle’s bitterness and resentment. Although the creature was destroyed, another demonic being later appeared to claim Maybelle’s soul. Dawg sacrificed his own life to save his owners, causing the demon to depart. The event finally made Maybelle understand how much the dog meant to Zeke. Shortly afterward, a doctor arrived to treat her while the recovered Man-Thing silently returned to the swamp.

ezekiel wright.name: Ezekiel Wright
ezekiel wright.origin: Assistant to a magician who taught him magic in order to view his own tricks before they were seen by an audience, Ezekiel Wright became an accomplished magician in his own right, joining a group of his fellows at a speakeasy. Though most accepted him as a fellow magician, a single, racist member had a policeman he was friends with frame Ezekiel for assaulting a woman (despite the woman assuring the policeman that the assault had been done by a white man with a European accent). Placing the handcuffs on Ezekiel, the policeman gloated and asked the woman for a date before Ezekiel used his skills to escape the cuffs, punch the policeman, then flee the scene. Utilizing the anonymity that had been forced on him for having a different skin color, he helped others who might be harmed simply because of who they were, becoming the Revenant. Largely thought a myth in the 30s, he sought out and aided the Operative in his quest to discover who murdered actress Alice Starr, whom Revenant had worked alongside during his time as a magician's assistant, helping him confront the General and save Alice's sister Sarah Starr from corrupt cops. Teaming with the Operative and Sarah (as the Aviatrix), the trio began investigating the Board across New York City, eventually tracking the one member of the Board they thought would tell them why Alice was murdered. Arriving at the man's home, they discovered him dead at the hands of new masked vigilante, the Surgeon. Rejecting the Surgeon's brutal methods, the trio continued investigating on their own, before finally tracking the General to Westchester where they confronted him, newly transformed into a werewolf, his ally, the Olympian Nox, and her brood of werewolf children. Outnumbered, the trio were saved by the timely arrival of the Surgeon and his new ally, Achilles, who helped the trio escape. Revenant later spent the night at Aviatrix's place.
powers: Able to create illusions, likely through the use of conventional magical tricks.

ezra.name: Ezra
ezra.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Heimdall was a Vanir birthed by nine mothers, the Nine Goddesses (personifying the sea). He was to be married with Siriana of the Aesir. A special wedding dress was even crafted, impervious to Heimdall's eyes. The Aesir/Vanir War put them apart, but when the war was over, the wedding wasn't made. At some point, he had a farm, in which the young Warriors Three and Thor stole mutton, only to receive a beating. ===Guardian of the Bifrost=== Heimdall was a valiant Asgardian warrior. After another attempt by the Storm Giants to storm Asgard, Odin decided to choose a warrior to guard the Rainbow Bridge Bifrost which connects Asgard (Home of the Aesir) to Midgard (Earth). He invited three warriors to prove their prowess, Agnar the Fierce, Gotron the Agile, and Heimdall. Heimdall was chosen because of his powers of perception, being able to see and hear across time and thus predicting a coming attack by the Storm Giants. After the attack was repulsed and their King captured, Odin chose Heimdall to be the guardian of the Rainbow Bridge forever. His first known failure as guardian of Bifrost came when the air spirit Vanna, who was considered unable to be caught, slipped by him on its mission to spy on Asgard for Brimer, King of the Storm Giants. Heimdall was so ashamed of his failure that he reported it to Odin at once, enabling the All-Father to catch the spy. After Thor reappeared on Earth in the human guise of Don Blake, Heimdall accidentally freed Loki from his imprisonment in a tree. Odin had decreed Loki would remain imprisoned until another Asgardian would weep a tear for him. When Heimdall passed under the tree, Loki made a leaf fall, striking Heimdall in the eye, shedding the required tear. When Loki was returned to Asgard, Odin decreed that he could not leave Asgard again, but he turned into a snake and snuck through Heimdall's legs undetected and returned to Earth again. When Thor had been tricked into turning evil by Loki and returned to Asgard to free him, Heimdall was the first person to greet Thor, but was insulted and Thor barged past him. Sensing something was wrong Heimdall immediately went to inform Odin. Heimdall has continued to stand as guardian of Bifrost often serving as the first line of defense. He has battled against Thor the times the latter has been banished from Asgard only to be quickly overwhelmed. Other times he has fought beside Thor against threats to Asgard. At one time he served as ruler of Asgard when Odin was in the Odinsleep. After one of Surtur's attacks on Asgard, Bifrost was destroyed. Heimdall used his free time to form a romantic relationship with Amora the Enchantress. Despite their mutual affection for each other Heimdall returned to his position as guardian of Bifrost when it was repaired. ===Post-Ragnarok=== Following the return of Asgard after Ragnarök, Heimdall was the first Asgardian Thor found. Using his powers, Heimdall was able to easily lead Thor to his fellow Asgardians. When Thor was banished for killing Bor, Heimdall served as one of the advisers to Balder. ===Siege=== He foresaw the attack on Asgard by Norman Osborn, but was prevented by Loki from warning anyone. He fought against Osborn's forces and later resumed his position as watchman of Asgard. ===Thunder God Tanarus=== After Thor died fighting the Serpent, he was replaced in everyone's memories by Tanarus thanks to a spell cast by Karnilla. Heimdall became suspicious when he was occasionally unable to locate Tanarus with his enhanced sight. He confronted Tanarus only to be severely beaten. He recovered enough to see through the spell and warn the All-Mother of Ulik's treachery. ===The Mangog's Attack=== When the Mangog resurfaced, Heimdall witnessed his arrival and stood as the first line of defense against the creature to protect Asgardia. Mangog broke Hofund in half and gouged out Heimdall's eyes with its teeth. Heimdall was tended by his fellow Asgardians when they evacuated the city and fled to the Moon while Jane Foster killed Mangog. ===Death=== thumb|right|Going beyond the Far Shore After the War of the Realms had concluded, Heimdall's eyesight had healed and had his sword returned to him by Daredevil. Sometime after this, Heimdall travelled to Midgard with Jane Foster, the new Valkyrie, to help her look for Dragonfang, the sword of the previous Valkyrie, which had been stolen by an unknown assailant. During the search, Heimdall was stabbed in the chest with Dragonfang by Bullseye. Despite this, Heimdall managed to survive long enough to convince Valkyrie to let go of the sword, and so she destroyed it and finally defeated Bullseye. Despite this, Heimdall's wounds were still fatal, and he ultimately died. Instead of taking him to Valhalla, Valkyrie escorted Heimdall's soul to the Far Shore; Heimdall went further beyond to explore the Mystery. ===Return=== Heimdall along with Hermod ended up in Nrgl, the Endless City, being restrained and captured by the City Dwellers

ezra asher.name: Ezra Asher
ezra asher.origin: Ezra Asher was once married to police detective Tony Vargas when she was turned into a vampire and vanished. Tony assumed that she had died and moved on. Years later, Ezra joined forces with Saint Cyrus Leviticus, a man who had fused to an alien creature and had become a murderer to feed the creature his victims' life energy. Leviticus and Ezra planned to kill countless people during Brazil's Carnival celebration so Leviticus could feed the victims' life energy to the creature and Ezra could feed on the victims' blood. When Tony Vargas investigated a number of killings done by Ezra, Ezra and Leviticus killed him to stop his interference. This enraged Vargas' old friend Wolverine and swore revenge. He let himself be captured so he could get close to the pair. Ezra fed on Wolverine several times as she liked the taste of his blood. Wolverine eventually escaped his bonds and briefly fought Ezra. When Wolverine unsheathed his claws, Ezra decided to flee. Wolverine later killed Leviticus but was unable to find Ezra. As Wolverine left, Ezra watched him from on top of a tree.

f r crozier.origin: Captain F.R. Crozier was doctor and chief science officer on a doomed arctic expedition hundreds of years ago. The ships had become frozen in the ice pack, and after his captain did not return with the half of the crew he took to search for help, Crozier was forced to lead the remaining crew in the search for escape from the vicious winter. Not wanting to die, he ingested a formula which would place him in suspended animation until the summer thawed him. What he didn't account for was the loyalty of his crew. They gave him a proper burial, thus denying him of the sunlight he would need to awaken. Crozier remained in suspended animation (apparently conscious of the passage of time) until Alpha Flight came to his grave believing it to be a suitable place of power for Narya to give birth to her son. Crozier's consciousness was able to take control of the baby. He gained the ability to control the forces of death and decay and fought Alpha until he retreated. Alpha Flight once again met up with Pestilence where they discovered that the baby's innocence was destroying him. He used his powers to control Snowbird and to destroy the body, thus freeing his spirit. Vindicator upon realizing what was going on, was forced to slay Snowbird, only to discover she was too late, Pestilence was free of a mortal form. Shortly after Snowbird's funeral, her body, still in Sasquatch form, rose up and attacked Alpha Flight. it was revealed that Pestilence had found himself a new body. fields.history: Captain F.R. Crozier was doctor and chief science officer on a doomed arctic expedition hundreds of years ago. The ships had become frozen in the ice pack, and after his captain did not return with the half of the crew he took to search for help, Crozier was forced to lead the remaining crew in the search for escape from the vicious winter. Not wanting to die, he ingested a formula which would place him in suspended animation until the summer thawed him. What he didn't account for was the loyalty of his crew. They gave him a proper burial, thus denying him of the sunlight he would need to awaken. Crozier remained in suspended animation (apparently conscious of the passage of time) until Alpha Flight came to his grave believing it to be a suitable place of power for Narya to give birth to her son. Crozier's consciousness was able to take control of the baby. He gained the ability to control the forces of death and decay and fought Alpha until he retreated. Alpha Flight once again met up with Pestilence where they discovered that the baby's innocence was destroying him. He used his powers to control Snowbird and to destroy the body, thus freeing his spirit. f t strang.origin: Colonel Strang is an entrepreneur who controlled the pressman's union and the drivers, as well as chicken stands. Strang was described as a corporate raider who attemped takeovers of companies. He was once impersonated by Wolfgang von Strucker. Later, Strang obtained parts of Kingpin's legitimate businesses. Later, the real Strang interfered with J. Jonah Jameson's work in the Daily Bugle, wanting to force Jameson to sell him the newspaper, by threatening to use his influences to stop the distribution of it. James temporarily stopped the Bugle operation, keeping his workers outside of the building (which led to Ben Urich trying to access sneakily to his own files with the help of intern Sara Harrington, who in turn discovered Daredevil's secretly identity, deciding to expose it and leading to Daredevil faking his own death). Eventually, Jameson cut his own deal with the union leaders, which put a stop Strang's plans. Strang refused to make comments to the press.

face japanese.name: Face (Japanese)
face japanese.origin: The Face face was an operative of Imperial Japan active during World War II. Ruling from his castle in the Valley of Death, the Face earned his name due to the fact that his face was withered to look like a skull. How his face became horribly disfigured remains unknown. However, as he developed a lethal gas that caused the same disfigurement in its victims it is entirely possible that he was exposed to a dose of his own gas and managed to survive. By the fall of 1944 he had a contingent of Japanese soldiers preparing massive doses of the gas to unleash against the enemies of Japan. The Destroyer happened upon a dying American soldier who had escaped from the Face who told him about his ghastly plans before dying. The Destroyer next set out for the Valley of Death where he was captured and brought before the Face who told him of his plan to send a bomber loaded with the gas to kill a massive amount of Americans. After this, the Destroyer proceeded to escape from the Face's forces, though the Face himself was shot and killed amid the confusion. The Destroyer next hijacked the plane with its killer cargo and unleashed the gas into the Valley of Death, ending its threat.
weapons: The Face had created a gas which caused its victims skin to decay and whither in much the same way as the Red Skull's dust of death.

faceless one.name: Faceless One
faceless one.origin: The Faceless One was a member of the Kt'kn, an alien race who sought to conquer the Earth. He allied himself with Prince Rudolfo and the Latverian underground in their coup against Doctor Doom, hoping to use Latveria and Doom's technology in his conquest. He discovered the original Doomsman and went to confront Doom. However, Doom was able to regain control of Doomsman and turned him against Faceless One who escaped his android body and detonated it. In the confusion the Faceless one escaped and made it appear like he had escaped in his Omni-Sphere when in reality he was attempting to use Doom's defenses against him. He was defeated when Doom destroyed his own castle. He retreated to the caves below Latveria, and recreated his android body an recruited several robots and led them on a revolt. Luke Cage was hired by Doctor Doom to defeat some that had escaped to New York but when Doom failed to pay he travelled to Latveria to get his dues. Here he joined the Faceless One in his revolt solely to get the money, during the fight Cage damaged Doom's armor sufficiently that Faceless one attempted to slay Doom. However, Cage did not want to be involved in a murder so destroyed the Faceless Ones exoskeleton and his detached head fled. The Faceless One then took over the Drydock, which was the Space Station of the 30th Century Guardians of the Galaxy. He also captured astronaut Salia Petrie and used her to also capture Ms. Marvel. Teleporting them both aboard the ship he attempted to control Ms. Marvel, however she broke free and met up with Vance Astro. The two proceeded to try and separate the Faceless One from his android body, but in the process he Injected Ms. Marvel with a paralysing toxin from his legs. Vance destroyed the android body before it could attack her and The Faceless One teleported away.

fadi fadlalah.name: Fadi Fadlalah
fadi fadlalah.origin: The legacy that Fadi Fadlalah carries dates back to fifteen hundred years ago in Baghdad. A group of rampaging monsters known as the Army of the Devil was banished and bound to ordinary objects by the sorcerer Red Owl. Jealous of the attention the wizard had earned from the populace he saved, the caliph betrayed him and ordered his execution. At the moment of his death, Red Owl sent the cursed artifacts scattering across the Earth, each ensorcelled with the spirit of a monster. On that day, Fadi's ancestors pledged to find the thousand cursed items and seal them away, and this duty was passed down through the generations. As a teenager, Fadi was entrusted his family's duty by his grandmother, and became the super hero Amulet. Originally of Michigan, Fadi moved to Jersey City to live with his grandmother and his cousins Hassan and Husayn, who ran a juice bar. Fadi first debuted in Jersey City when one of the demons of the Army of the Devil surfaced at a fair in Sussex County. He teamed up with local hero Ms. Marvel, and managed to destroy the cursed artifact, banishing the monster. Fadi continued operating as Amulet despite the instatement of the Underage Superhuman Welfare Act, which banned teenage vigilantism, and he became a target of C.R.A.D.L.E. When C.R.A.D.L.E. agents investigated his cousins' juice bar for its connection to him, Amulet intended to defuse the commotion and ran into Ms. Marvel, who intended to do the same, outside the establishment. They were interrupted by an alert of a new monster sighting, and they teamed up to stop it. Amulet decided to disclose his secret identity to Ms. Marvel, but Kamala was hesitant to reciprocate. When Ms. Marvel was attacked by the Stormranger, Amulet noticed the confrontation and came to Kamala's aid, generating magic shields between her and the villain. Fadi's powers were boosted to extreme levels by drawing energy from Ms. Marvel's friends, rendering all of the Stormranger's attacks useless, which gave Kamala the chance to fend off the Stormranger with her words. Afterward, Ms. Marvel revealed her secret identity to Amulet. During his next monster sighting, Amulet ran into Spider-Man in Red Hook, and they worked together to stop a cyklops, but the monster had killed a person before the arrival of either hero. While making acquaintances with Spider-Man, another creature under the command of a worshipper of Red Owl accidentally abducted the Web-Slinger instead of Amulet. Amulet followed the creature and destroyed the artifact binded to it, banishing it. The cultist announced the return of Red Owl, and set himself ablaze. After Spider-Man shared words of encouragement with Amulet, the two young heroes parted ways.

fafnir hellhand.name: Fafnir Hellhand
fafnir hellhand.origin: ===Origin and youth in Vanaheim=== Fafnir was a Vanirman, hailing from the northern realm of Vanaheim. In his youth, Fafnir was part of the band of Rane, the Reaver, in the North. ===Thief in Shadizar=== In Shadizar, Zamora, Fafnir was a thief working alongside Blackrat. One night, after Fafnir had subdued a goldsmith, Blackrat stabbed him, and the pair stole three gold items. They were fighting over the dividing of the loot, when they were attacked by Conan, a young thief at the time. Blackrat stabbed Fafnir while aiming for Conan, and was knocked out. Conan left with the booty, leaving Fafnir for dead. Fafnir recovered from the weak blow. ===Pirate of the Inland Sea=== Fafnir went on to become the captain of a crew of pirates of the Inland Sea composed of Zingaran corsairs, nomads out of Zamboula, deserters from the world's navies and even one from the Aquilonian Army. Boarding a Turanian galley, the pirates slaughtered all the crewmen, save for Conan, whom Fafnir knocked out. Though his men wanted to have Conan slain, Fafnir convinced them to spare him, if he was bound to the mast. Fafnir attempted to recruit Conan into his diminished crew, but Conan refused upon learning that Fafnir was Vanir, the enemies of the Cimmerians. ===Bal-Sagoth=== Into the storm, the ship was taken into the dreaded White Mist, where no man have ever gone and returned alive, and wrecked itself on a reef. Fafnir freed Conan before leaving the ship. Fafnir lost consciousness on a piece of wreckage, and was about to be devoured by a shark, but was saved by Conan. Stranded on the beach of Bal-Sagoth, Fafnir was defied by Conan, full of racial hatred for the Vanir. Fafnir reluctantly accepted, but soon laid down his weapon, soon followed by Conan, thus started the friendship between them. At that instant, Groth-Golka, the last of the Lizard-Gods appeared, pursuing a girl. In a remarkable feat of strength, attributed to Fafnir's invocations of his gods, Fafnir broke the monster's neck. The girl, Kyrie, was the Vanir daughter of Rane, the Reaver. Stranded on the isle alone, she was confused by the natives of Bal-Sagoth as the sea-goddess Aala. Eventually, she was exiled to the other part of the isle by her rival, old Gothan. Kyrie offered the two warriors great rewards for their help, intending to use the legend which said that when two men would come out of the sea, Bal-Sagoth would fall. In the city, "Aala" warned the people, and forced the king Ska to flee. Fafnir and Conan help "Aala" conquer back her throne, but are betrayed by her. Accidentally they bring down the statue of the local god and his temple, the whole city and the isle crumble. Floating on their raft through the Vilayet sea, they are rescued by a war ship of Prince Yezdigerd of Turan and join his war campaign. ===Turanian mercenary=== Fafnir and Conan participate at the siege of Makkalet. In the first battle, Fafnir is wounded by a flame arrow and falls into the sea. Later he is rescued by the Turans, but his left arm is infected and is amputated. Later in the siege of Makkalet, a turanian officer orders that the dead are thrown overboard, including the wounded Fafnir. Conan is enraged and avenges Fafnir by killing the officer. Then he has to flee the turanian ship, on the way wounding Prinde Yezdigerd; he then sides with Makkalet. ===Free Companions and Kozaks=== Along his adventures, Fafnir came to have be grafted with a demon hand instead of his original left arm, and was consequently known as Fafnir Hellhand. Fafnir became involved in the Free Companions and the Kozaki, led by Conan, alongside other of Conan's fellow warriors befriended along his adventures, such as Zula, Red Sonja, and Turghol. Fafnir remained with Conan, Zula and other Kozaki, opposing Turanian attempts at the annexation of the Grassy Steppers spanning from Zamora to the Vilayet Sea. They stopped a Turanian squad (tasked by Shah Amurath, lord of Akif) to retrieve the Sacred Fire of Ormuz and the bones of the sorcerer Kulan Gath for Prince Yezdigerd) on the trail of Isparana (a former Kozak herself, who had stolen the Turanian sergeant's mount after being recognized as a Kozak). The Turanians were easily slain, though Fafnir came close to fall under possession of his demon hand. Learning of the Turanian plot, Conan dispatched Zula, Fafnir, and Isparana to bring the Kozaks on, going himself to Armati to obtain the items desired by Shah Amurath. Defeated by Armati and the Turanians, Zula, Fafnir, and Isparana were closing by the Kozaks when Isparana made up a pretext to go to her baby (born from her mating with the demon Wrarrl the Devourer of Souls), only to discover her "son" had grown into the fully adult Wrarrl. Suspicious of Isparana, Zula and Fafnir parted ways, Fafnir following her while Zula went to the Kozaks. Arriving to Isparana's hideout, Fafnir help Isparana to escape by collapsing the cave over Wrarrl. Meanwhile, Conan was captured and sent to the Hanging Gardens. As Kulan Gath was r

Fafnir became involved in the Free Companions and the Kozaki, led by Conan, alongside other of Conan's fellow warriors befriended along his adventures, such as Zula, Red Sonja, and Turghol. Fafnir remained with Conan, Zula and other Kozaki, opposing Turanian attempts at the annexation of the Grassy Steppers spanning from Zamora to the Vilayet Sea. They stopped a Turanian squad (tasked by Shah Amurath, lord of Akif) to retrieve the Sacred Fire of Ormuz and the bones of the sorcerer Kulan Gath for Prince Yezdigerd) on the trail of Isparana (a former Kozak herself, who had stolen the Turanian sergeant's mount after being recognized as a Kozak). The Turanians were easily slain, though Fafnir came close to fall under possession of his demon hand. Learning of the Turanian plot, Conan dispatched Zula, Fafnir, and Isparana to bring the Kozaks on, going himself to Armati to obtain the items desired by Shah Amurath. Defeated by Armati and the Turanians, Zula, Fafnir, and Isparana were closing by the Kozaks when Isparana made up a pretext to go to her baby (born from her mating with the demon Wrarrl the Devourer of Souls), only to discover her "son" had grown into the fully adult Wrarrl. Suspicious of Isparana, Zula and Fafnir parted ways, Fafnir following her while Zula went to the Kozaks. Arriving to Isparana's hideout, Fafnir help Isparana to escape by collapsing the cave over Wrarrl. Meanwhile, Conan was captured and sent to the Hanging Gardens. As Kulan Gath was r
fields.personality: not much in not race-minded peace-seeking driven to violence by his demon hand. --> ==Religion== Fafnir invoked the name of Gods of the North, such as Bragi and Ymir's name, but also mentioned "Dagon's cellar" (possibly mentioning the eldritch horror, aquatic monster, and possible Great Old One). He also invoked Mitra's name on occasion.
powers: Fafnir Hellhand possessed a demon hand with .
weaknesses: Fafnir's demon hand could take possession of him "if [he] let it".
fields.notes: Fafnir was created by Roy Thomas and Barry Smith in the original story "Devil-Wings Over Shadizar" ( ; June, 1971). Fafnir and Blackrat were created by Thomas as a nod to Fritz Leiber's creations Fafhrd and the Gray Mouser. Adventures of Fritz Lieber's heroes were published by Marvel Comics imprint Epic Comics, in four books named Fafhrd and the Gray Mouser (October, 1990 to January, 1991) "based on the characters created by Fritz Leiber". In the story "Gods of Bal-Sagoth" and ; August and September, 1972), written by Roy Thomas and penciled by Gil Kane, freely adapted from the and Cthulhu Mythos story (published in ; October, 1931), Fafnir took the place of Athelstane, a Saxon. Fafnir fits many aspects of the character: a bulky warrior from an enemy-people to the protagonist's own race, and whom he had encountered and battled previously. Fafnir's first appearance was unmemorable enough for Roy Thomas to pass over it unmentioned in his Conan Comics Chronology, and started mentioning him only in the next chapter of the guide, recounting the events of Conan the Barbarian #17 and #18. Finally, the Appendix to the Handbook of the Marvel Universe mentions that Fafnir might be inspired by another Vanirman ally of Conan, Sigurd.

fafnir hriedmarson.species: Vanir turned by a curse into a Dragon
fafnir hriedmarson.origin: left|thumb|Human Form Fafnir and Regin were Hriedmar of the Vanir's elder sons. They lived in the Inn of Hriedmar along with their younger brother Otr, gifted at birth with the talent of a changer of shapes. A day where Otr had been sent by Hriedmar as a human-sized otter to catch a supper, he encountered the young prince Odin Borson and the time-travelling Loki. While Odin was astonished by the creature who greeted them welcome, Loki quickly killed it. His meat was eaten, and from his fur were made two cloaks. When Loki and Odin came to the Inn and listened to Hriedmar talking about his third son, Odin quickly understood that they had killed Otr. As soon, Fafnir and Regin entered in arms, recognizing Otr's fur on the two travellers backs. While Regin intended to avenge in blood, Fafnir succumbed to Loki's tempting, implying a blood price with a ransom of gold. First going with Regin, Hriedmar accepted, taking Odin as hostage. Loki went to Andvari the Dwarf, killed him and stole his gold, but not before he could curse it, who would be revealing the truth about people. After the two travellers departed, Regin was in favor of hunting them and all Asgardians down, but Hriedmar tried to appease him, before Fafnir was driven by the curse to stab them both, for him to keep the gold for himself. Hriedmar was killed, and Regin buried him, oathing the death of Fafnir and all Asgardians. Fafnir escaped with the gold and hid himself in a cave. Starving, he began to drunk of curse-magic to survive, and eventually transformed into a dragon, his outsides matching with his insides. Meanwhile, Regin crafted a powerful sword, Gram, in his need of vengeance towards his brother and all Asgardians. Eventually, he came across Sigurd, and had him slay his brother in exchange for the sword and the dragon-gold. Fafnir's heart was taken by Sigurd to be eaten, Regin having told him that eating a dragon's heart rendered impervious to death except by magic. The gold was left to be there, as no one would attempt to steal from Sigurd. Fafnir's blood formed a pool from which the King of Nastrond drank years later, becoming itself Fafnir, or rather his "twin".
powers: As a Dragon, Fafnir exhibited the ability to breath fire.
weapons: Formerly a short sword. Also used a knife.
weaknesses: Fafnir was unable to leave even for a moment his gold.

fagin.name: Fagin
fagin.origin: Fagin was a member of the Brotherhood, a militant mutant terrorist group. One of Fagin's missions involved him recruiting Mike Asher from his high school, and in the process stumbled across an unknown mutant being beaten up by a gang. Fagin attempted a rescue but he himself had to be rescued by the Brotherhood's leader Marvin Hoffman. A little later, Fagin helped convinced Mike not to commit suicide over being a mutant and was present when Asher did eventually join them. Fagin and Asher were then sent to the London Cell of the brotherhood, where they were told they would have to deal with an ex-Brotherhood member turned informant and then had to take out X-Force's Doop. In the ensuing battle with the X-Force, Fagin was killed by Vivisector.
powers: / : Bone Spikes: He can generate spikes all over his body Possible : He also probably has an accelerated healing rate to seal the wounds, caused by projecting his spikes, with no visible scarring.

fahd alireza.name: Fahd Alireza
fahd alireza.origin: ===Early years=== Fahd Alireza was a pyrokinetic being who, as Jinn, became an assassin. He was employed by Matsu'o Tsurayaba in Thailand to kill a general that had displeased the Hand. Once the task done, Matsu'o told Jinn that he would maybe call him again. He eventually meeting a woman who he fell in love with. Leaving Tsurayaba's employ, the two settled down and his wife became pregnant. ===Killing Matsu'o=== Months later, Matsu'o's killers, dressed up as Hand ninjas, attacked and killed his pregnant wife, sending Matsu'o's "regards". Enraged at this, Jinn traveled to Japan seeking to kill Matsu'o and running afoul of Psylocke, also out to kill Matsu'o. Using a telepathic probe, Psylocke found out why Jinn was out to kill Matsu'o, and in the process inadvertently revealed Matsu'o's location, something she wasn't even consciously aware of. Arriving at Matsu'o's location, Jinn prepared to kill him, but was stopped and knocked-out by Psylocke. Instants later, he intervened to stop Wolverine (who tormented Matsu'o, and had caused him to try to trick both Psylocke and Jinn to end his suffering) from killing Psylocke, then told her he choose to follow her advice, and go home bury his wife. Wolverine attacked, causing Jinn to flee out. At the end of the fight, Wolverine asked Psylocke that if she saw Jinn again, she would tell him that it wasn't personal. Jinn returned to Saudi Arabia. ===The Coming of the Juggernaut=== After hearing the call of Cyttorak (being one of those Cyttorak felt could be controlled), he went to the Temple of Cyttorak to find the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak and gain its power. He battled Rachel Summers and Iceman. When Cain Marko, the original wielder of the gem, entered, Jinn halted the fight and was frozen by Iceman, neutralizing him.

weaknesses: Adamantium sensibility: When stabbed by Wolverine, the metal on his claws burned Jinn.

fahe.name: Fahe
fahe.origin: Following a deadly encounter with their archenemy Magneto, the X-Men were briefly trapped in the Savage Land, where they became the guests of Ka-Zar’s friends, the Fall People. During this time, Colossus rescued the chieftain’s daughter, Nereel, and her friend Fahe from a dinosaur attack, after which they invited him to spend the afternoon on a “special island”. They made love which left at least Nereel pregnant. Whether or not Fahe is among the Fall People who survived Terminus’s destruction of the Savage Land is unknown.

faira sar namora.name: Faira Sar Namora
faira sar namora.origin: Faira Sar Namora was the servant of Namora. She was tasked with the mission of retrieving Namorita from the surface, and was interrupted when she discovered Lemuria being attacked by Deviants then by Evolutionaries. She appeared in the surface in order to seek for heroes, but the Evolutionaries followed and captured her, along with two heroes she had encountered, Scarlet Spider and Hummingbird. They were brought to Wundagore Mountain, for the High Evolutionary. After escaping captivity, along with Nova, who the Evolutionary had captured before, they were confronted by more Evolutionaries, but helped by the New Warriors, who had arrived in the search of Nova. During the battle, the Evolutionary tried to use a machine to kill all those who had powers, but his plan was foiled when Sun Girl blasted the device. After the Evolutionaries and the High Evolutionary left the scene, Namora stayed in Wundagore Mountain to help the New Warriors secure the place.
abilities: Trained in Atlantean combat methods.

fairy delight.name: Fairy Delight
fairy delight.origin: Fairy Delight lived in the potentially imaginary world of Nowhere in the Land of Fairies; she was a servant in the court of King Ra. When the Land of Fairies was visited by Jimmy Jupiter and his pal Knobby, King Ra charged Fairy Delight to show Jimmy around the land. She transported him around King Ra's domain in a pumpkin carriage pulled by giant mice. She showed him the various realms, such as the Valley of the Blue Bells, The Plus Forest, The China Village, and Dream Land. When they were in danger of being put into eternal sleep by the Sandman, Fairy Delight ordered Jimmy and his friends to flee. Jimmy ended up falling back to Earth. The fate of Fairy Delight remains unrevealed.
powers: Fairy Delight has various magical powers, the limitations of which are unknown. She at least had the ability to change her height from the average size of a fairy to match the size of Jimmy Jupiter.
